But they stay dull like a school boy before a naked woman. And they don't study the Rainbow anymore. On the other side is the Raven Wood. Damn tough bunch. Private army with enormous funding. At least their equipment is awesome. I have no idea what they need. That is why I don't recommend you to mess up with them. They pay good, but you know the story about 30 silver coins. Their scientists are really smart though. Discover secrets one by one. That's how it is. Any questions?

dialog.Title: I see here are laws too...
dialog.Text: You're not in a fairy tale, you know. What did you hear about these places? Did you came to gather mushrooms? They'll more likely gather you. No one saw such things but it doesn't mean it can't be. Here is all possible. The Phon can turn any terrible thing into an even more terrible crap.

dialog.Title: You talked about the Rainbow...
dialog.Text: Yeah, but there are lot of nonsense and urban legends around this phenomenon. You better ask someone else. I don't want to waste time with it. So, come on. Go to Alex. And on behalf of all Lubech: "Welcome!" The military do not favor newcomers, but I say, the only way to get there is together. I hope you'll die not as fast as most of other losers. So here is... the starter kit of survival in a hostile environment. Don't laugh, you will thank me later. Good luck!

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: The place is not better, not worse, than any other place. We strengthen it, establish supply of ammunition, hold the ground successfully... I'm the head of the process. Sometimes newcomers come here, but they does not last long. Although now, with the military, things became far from quiet... Every day new guests are coming. The scientists, stalkers, clans leaders... Unexpectedly, but good for barter. There were not such traffic ever before.

dialog.Title: The Army wasn't the first who come here?
dialog.Text: Of course not! Lubech was quiet and relatively safe city until the mutants came from swamps and forests. The "safe" is a strong word for the Zone. But people lived here, on this side of the perimeter. The police station was also used as intended. Kept peace and order, as they say... Alex and I worked here... But then we was attacked by various creatures. Someone was killed, the rest are gone. We stayed. I had to release the prisoners. Seen Shtaket? He was behind the bars for some time. And he still would have sat if the creatures did not attack.

dialog.Title: Isn't it dangerous to release prisoners?
dialog.Text: To go out on the streets now is dangerous. Shtaket have his benefits for society. He's not a maniac. He is a thief. But his connections are very helpful. Of course, he still should answer for his crimes before the law... But later, when the mutants raids will end and life will return to normal.

dialog.Title: Why should I register myself?
dialog.Text: Because if you'll die in the Zone and someone will be looking for you, we'll always be able to confirm that you were here. Convenient? And rightly so. This, of course, is voluntary procedure. But if your conscience is clear and you have nothing to hide from the law, why not register yourself.

dialog.Title: I'm leaving.
dialog.Text: Yes, go away.

dialog.Title: Темон не отмечался?
dialog.Text: Сейчас посмотрим... Да, отмечался. "Темон Добронравов". Он? Припоминаю... Высокий такой, дурно пах, будто вывалялся в мусорной яме. И голову обмотал тряпками, чтоб не узнали. Короче, типичный сталкер.

dialog.Title: Откуда знаешь, что это был Темон?
dialog.Text: Он так назвался. У нас процедура формальная и сугубо добровольная. Отсюда люди идут в сторону ДК, к воротам, в зоны повышенной опасности. Многие не возвращаются. Указывать подлинные имена -- в ваших же интересах.

dialog.Title: "Темон" тоже ушел в ДК?
dialog.Text: Да. Он здесь не задержался. Даже к Алексу не заглядывал. Поговорил с сержантом Дибенко и сбежал.

dialog.Title: Темный Сталкер не отмечался?
dialog.Text: Ха. Ха. Посмеялись. Теперь можешь идти.

dialog.Title: Хочу узнать, что у вас здесь?
dialog.Text: Для начала приветствую тебя в нашей скромной обители. Ну, в том, что от нее осталось... Меня все зовут Грек. Я тут комендант. Так что все основные вопросы решаю я. Если ты насчет работы, поговори с Палкой. Он стоит у входа, высматривает сталкеров, ищет свободные рабочие руки... Безопасностью у нас заведует Алекс. Зайди к нему тоже, кстати. Найдешь его здесь же, в одном из офисов. Он тебе расскажет, что тут у нас можно, а что нельзя...

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
A long time ago, when I was a barefoot little boy, I thought that the forest is the best thing that the nature could give us...

dialog.Title: Get lost.
dialog.Text: What a pity. Good luck to you. And most importantly, be happy!

dialog.Title: What forest?
dialog.Text: The forest is a beautiful green island of happiness in the middle of almost lifeless, concrete desert cities. Here is a similar place. Not far from the city. I want you to seek it. I even will reward you. Money is nothing. What you'll see therein, will remain with you forever.

dialog.Title: Alright. I'll take a look at it.
dialog.Text: Look through all eyes. Absorb its beauty by your heart and soul. Go and come back enlightened!

dialog.Title: Only psychos are here!
dialog.Text: Not at all. I will not show the certificate. I do not remember where it is. The fact, my memory is not fine lately...

dialog.Title: I saw the forest.
dialog.Text: And?

dialog.Title: It's a normal forest. No magic.
dialog.Text: I knew it! They said - magic. Anomalies my ass... And now you tell, there is nothing. Ghouls, devil take them! What are you looking at? Take your freaking reward, you deserve it. Ah, mother, I need a drink!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
What do you want?

dialog.Title: Do not look at me, I'm leaving.
Do you buy rat tails?
dialog.Text: Well, is valid. Do you have rat tails?

dialog.Title: I have.
dialog.Text: Give a look. Do not trifle? No. Like, a normal tail.

dialog.Title: Why do you need tails?
dialog.Text: I fry them and eat. Okay, just kidding. Are you a beginner?

dialog.Title: How did you know?
dialog.Text: Questions you ask a stupid. You are looking the military. They say that night someone climbed through the cordon. And now a bad time to run around the perimeter.

dialog.Title: Why?
dialog.Text: Mutants are selected closer to the border. On the other hand - always someone tries to get into the Zone. Military nervous. You understand, it's not good end. So go to the engineer, he was waiting at the station. Tell his, what do you come from me. And go to Ljubech.

dialog.Title: Thank you.
dialog.Text: Do not thank me. Not for you to try. You're at the wrong time, reached here, man. The military will begin to search in the tunnels, and spoil my trade. I could take you to the military, for the award, but we do not give to military beginners not accepted.

dialog.Title: Need more tails?
dialog.Text: Yes. But in your shoes, I would not stay here. Give me the tail and walk away.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Tea! It's tea time!

dialog.Title: Let's start the party!
dialog.Text: But where is all the tea? No tea?! Can you find the tea?

dialog.Title: Do you have glass holders?
dialog.Text: I have a lot. What do I do with them, I don't know - all the glasses were broken. You need them?

dialog.Title: I need three.
dialog.Text: No problem. I'll give. In exchange of three packets of the tea.

dialog.Title: Okay, wait. I'll be back with the tea.
Here is your tea.
dialog.Text: Excellent! You know... Before the Zone, I used to drink a lot of alcohol. And here I have seen terrible things, enough for one lifetime. My delirium tremens vanished. Just a tea for me now. But a really hot and strong one! Where are you going without the reward? Choose a hat!

dialog.Title: A hat?
dialog.Text: Yes! I have a Panama and a Cap!

dialog.Title: No, thanks. I don't need a hat.
dialog.Text: You don't need it at all or you want to think about it?

dialog.Title: No, take the tea as a gift.
dialog.Text: Damn, I think I've got something in my eye. Well, thanks. How generously. And now... what shall I do with all these hats?

dialog.Title: I need to think about it.
I brought 3 packs.|| Where are my glass holders?
dialog.Text: They're all here!

dialog.Title: Я от Лешича
dialog.Text: Хм… От Лешича говоришь? Лешичь пьёт чай из сорока пяти чаинок. А ты сколько чаинок кладёшь?
Плохой чай ты пьёшь! Я такой не уважаю!
Плохой чай ты пьёшь! Я такой не уважаю!
Плохой чай ты пьёшь! Я такой не уважаю!
О! Знаешь толк в чае! Уважаю!

dialog.Title: Может о деле поговорим?
dialog.Text: Пожалуй можно и о деле. Скажи, сталкер, ты в Тюрьме бывал? Впрочем, это твоё личное дело. Я не прокурор чтобы тебя о таком спрашивать. В любом случае, если хочешь хорошо заработать, то придётся для начала именно в Тюрьму отправиться. Ну, что, готов взяться за работу? Не передумал ещё? Если скажешь, что готов, то обратной дороги уже не будет. А если решишь потом соскочить с темы, то я лично тебе очень не советую это делать. Ты уж мне поверь.

dialog.Title: Я готов. Не пугай.
dialog.Text: Вот и хорошо. Кстати, я не пугаю, я констатирую факт. Ладно, давай к делу. Как попасть в Тюрьму, я тебя учить не буду. Это уже твоя забота. Короче. Как окажешься в Тюрьме, находишь Бугра. И передаешь ему всего одну фразу: "Заказ на костыли сформирован." Запомни! Сказать надо будет слово в слово!

dialog.Title: Да
dialog.Text: Это хорошо. В смысле значит, знаешь, что там да как. И, что там совсем не курорт. Но, если хочешь в деле поучаствовать и заработать, придётся ещё разок там побывать. Как туда попасть я тебя учить не буду. Это уже твоя забота. Ну, что не передумал ещё хорошо подзаработать? Берешься за дело?

dialog.Title: Берусь
dialog.Text: Вот и хорошо. Но смотри, дело серьёзное. Я тебя предупредил. Если решишь в последний момент соскочить с темы, не позавидую.

dialog.Title: Пожалуй я подумаю
dialog.Text: Хм... Ну, подумай. А я подумаю стоит ли тебе это дело доверить.

dialog.Title: Понял
dialog.Text: Вот и отлично. Всё. Можешь приступать. Чаю не предлагаю, извини. Ха-ха-ха!

dialog.Title: Точно! И загадывать загадки!
dialog.Text: Ты, вижу, смыслишь в церемониях! Откуда же взяться такому смыслу без церемоний. Было бы бесцеремонно осмысливать такое! Но, церемониться не будем, у меня есть то, что тебе нужно! Но! У тебя есть то, что нужно мне!

dialog.Title: Вот как? Что же?
dialog.Text: Зверобой! Чудесный антидепрессант с отваром высадит десант! Конечно! Скорей, давай его сюда!

dialog.Title: Э, у меня нет зверобоя. Но сейчас принесу!
dialog.Text: Да! И что это за "сейчас"?! Тут же, немедленно, безотлагательно! В моей голове, знаешь ли, ничто не в безопасности! Могу и забыть.

dialog.Title: Зверобой прибыл!
dialog.Text: Ах! Ха! Восхитительно. Просто чудесно! Ну а вот тебе загадка! "Кто не бегает -- идет? Кто не говорит -- поет? Кто с руками без плечей? Кто с лицом, но без очей?" Ухаха! Отгадай и дальше передай!

dialog.Title: Спасибо, спасибо! Я пошел!
dialog.Text: Заглядывай на зверочай! На чаебой! Бозвечой!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Уголовников в угол! И на уголь! Угадай, кто из нас уголовник, если это не я? А у меня с собой уговор - с такими чай не пить, разговоров не вести!
Hello.

dialog.Title: Show me your stuff.
dialog.Text: If you don't have Simonov's recommendation you can't see my goods. Only for special customers. And Simonov with his men are special customers now for me. No offence.

dialog.Title: Maybe we can make a deal?
dialog.Text: Nope. I don't screwing my REAL deals. And this stuff isn't mine. I'm just a broker here. They count their goods very narrowly. I've got here nice Sig 751. But they can broke my legs if I sell that shit to someone else.

dialog.Title: I have Simonov's recommendation.
dialog.Text: No way!

dialog.Title: Look.
dialog.Text: Let me see it. Hmmm... looks like real. Ok then. I've got very good gun. Sig Sauer 751. Eggheads won't use it. But I can't give you this gun. You can take it if you'll bring me some arts and Spiderkhan's legs. Simonov didn't bring me any arts, so I'm loosing a lot of money right now. But these legs can change my situation. Bring them to me, and then I'll think about selling you my Sig.

dialog.Title: I don't have so much stuff right now.
I'd like to exchange arts and legs for the gun.
Nice gun. Got another one?
dialog.Text: Yup. But I won't give it to you. One recommendation -- one Sig. You can bring me another paper, plus arts and legs, and then I'll give you another Sig.

dialog.Title: Вроде все отдал...
dialog.Text: Хм... Ты смотри-ка... Не ожидал так быстро. Ну что же, вот теперь я могу продать тебе Sig 715. Отдам, считай, со скидкой, так как иначе я бы продал его гораздо дороже. Так что 200 000 рублей -- и автомат твой.

dialog.Title: У меня есть рекомендации Симонова.
dialog.Text: Не может быть!

dialog.Title: Сам смотри.
dialog.Text: Давай сюда. Хм... Вроде не поддельные. Где взял? Не мог же Симонов сам лично дать. Ладно, раз так... Как договаривались... Вот только... Если я тебя ни разу не видел, то и арты ты мне не приносил, верно? Хе-хе... Поэтому отдать я тебе его не могу. Симонов обещал вернуться с артами, вот список моей доли... Четыре "Щита", два "Стабилизатора", три "Антиграва" и две "Резины". Еще нужны лапы Паукана. Четыре штуки. Если ты принесешь мне все это -- тогда посмотрим.

dialog.Title: А как же 200 тысяч?
dialog.Text: И 200 тысяч. Молодец, что напомнил.

dialog.Title: У меня есть нужные арты.
dialog.Text: Сейчас посмотрим...

dialog.Title: По поводу Sig 751...
dialog.Text: Слушаю?

dialog.Title: Вроде все уже принес.
dialog.Text: Точно. Чуть со счета не сбился. Хе-хе... Да не бойся, у меня все записано. Вот. Получи свой автомат.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
I can't believe it! I was robbed by a beggar!

dialog.Title: What happened?
dialog.Text: I found a valuable artefact and was going to take it to the base, but then I met this... Damn him... He asked me if I want to look at a mutant. "Funny mutant tripped itself and smashed its head off, it is in a ridiculous posture now. Probably, it died of laughter itself". I was distracted, and he hit me to the back of my head. Bang! The blow almost stunned me. I fell and heard his boastful speech as I'm not the only fool who was tricked so easily. It seems to me, this sneaker is running at full speed to the border now, to sell my art to dealers. My head still hurts after the blow. And the lights dances before my eyes. I can't catch him. Can you shoot this stinker? I have a stash left, I'll give you all the money I still have.

dialog.Title: I'll shoot him.|| Wait here, I'll be back with the artefact.
I have no time.
dialog.Text: Too bad...

dialog.Title: I'll not give you the artefact.| I've shot your beggar, but I'll take the artefact. C'est la vie, my friend. No offense.
dialog.Text: I expected that. Well, at least the bastard did not go unpunished.

dialog.Title: Here is your artefact.
dialog.Text: Thank you, friend. I thought you took the artefact to yourself, but you surprise me by such honesty. Here is your money, as I promised.

dialog.Title: I'm looking for Whites.
dialog.Text: Who? The scientists?

dialog.Title: No, they're not.
dialog.Text: Then I don't know. Some scientists passed here by huge groups. With cars, protection and the guide, who was armed with big barret gun. Very organized. It seems, they were going to round a volcano and set camp in the south... Ask Zelenkin. He doesn't go far from the tent, could see and hear more than me. I try not to stay long in one place. If some beggar didn't rob me, I would be on my way long time ago.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
I've been robbed!

dialog.Title: What happened?
dialog.Text: One bandit stole all my equipment and killed my friend! I'm gonna find this asshole. I don't need my stuff. Only this bastard's head! I can pay you.

dialog.Title: I can bring you your equipment.
About robbery...
dialog.Text: What?

dialog.Title: Bastard is dead. ||But I didn't find anything with him.
dialog.Text: Thank you, stalker. I think he stashed my stuff. I'll find it by myself.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Hello, stalker. What do you want?

dialog.Title: I'm from Dibenko.|Sergeant Dibenko sent me to bring you back.
dialog.Text: I'm not going anywhere, I have a lot of work. I need samples of spiders cocoons, but I hate these things. Can you help me?

dialog.Title: No.
dialog.Text: Well, if so, I can't give you the report for Dibenko.

dialog.Title: I don't need them.
dialog.Text: Goodbye.

dialog.Title: Where are the spiders?
dialog.Text: Not far, in the forest. The square M8. To the north from here, you'll see. Spiders females live there. They guard their laying, but you have to collect 10 spider cocoons.

dialog.Title: Here's your samples.
dialog.Text: You're back? I thought you dead for sure... Just kidding, let's see the samples. Here, I wrote this report for Dibenko. Here is the information about the work done. Tell him, that I'll be back in a couple of days. And one more thing... Do not tell him that you helped me get the cocoons. Ok?

dialog.Title: Hi. I have the mail for you.
dialog.Text: Thanks, I've been waiting for this.

dialog.Title: No problem. I like to shoot spiders.
dialog.Text: That's good!

dialog.Title: I'm from Dibenko.|Sergeant Dibenko sent me to bring you back.
dialog.Text: Here, I wrote this report for Dibenko. Here is the information about the work done. Tell him, that I'll be back in a couple of days. And one more thing... Do not tell him that you helped me get the cocoons. Ok?

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
How are you? Alive?

dialog.Title: Alive like a ...
dialog.Text: This is good ... Congratulations, brother. We can say, in the zone. I wanted to go - I think that almost ended. From Liubech it starts, and before Liubech on a trolley from the station can reach. Well, to the station - a stone's throw,

dialog.Title: And that to me? Feet like cotton ...
dialog.Text: Oh, brother ... I watch the local air is already hit your head. Then up way to the station itself is relatively safe. But I advise to get weapons so quickly. I, green shoots, drive here, not in order

dialog.Title: Where do I find a weapon?
dialog.Text: His gun I will not give, but I do not have too much. But if the colon is not thin, you can peek into the woods. Remember, shots heard in the morning? Seems to me there is someone the military killed. Maybe that remains useful. You understand, there is no guarantee. But it never hurts to check -- maybe you are lucky.

dialog.Title: Why did you not go?
dialog.Text: Who of us needed more weapons? I'll wait here and pokaraulyu. I was exhausted our transition. And you, on the contrary, it will be useful to move.

dialog.Title: Wait me. I return soon
dialog.Text: In the water does not occur, if the legs of the road.
Lets go...

dialog.Title: I found the PM, but without ammunition. | There's someone's remains. I found the PM, but without ammunition.
dialog.Text: Okay, so be it, share with you the ammunition. Yet you and I together went through the perimeter.

dialog.Title: The head is a cast-iron ...
dialog.Text: Will soon pass. Or the military ... you touched? A cordon of ... I'll have spent more on its own. Here our paths diverge. Go ahead, the station is nearby. There is a doctor. Can you buy yourself something. Are you listening?

dialog.Title: oh-ho...
dialog.Text: Heavily you hooked? When the bullets whistled through the bushes, I thought, too ashamed to say - everything, the end of the tale. No, broke. That's just go back even harder and more dangerous. I'm back to no one I drive, alone, is hardly my way,

dialog.Title: I like a little better ... | | I remember were the perimeter ...
dialog.Text: Maybe you thought about the money, and? I'm you, illnesses, not for free I drive here.

dialog.Title: I'm sorry, I have no money.
dialog.Text: Something in your liver ... I felt that it was necessary to take forward. I've been risking his neck, and you cheated, then? Get out of here. I hope you had disappeared to hell, wise guy ... Well, nothing. Zone sees everything, you will take the zone...

dialog.Title: That is 200 rubles, as agreed.
dialog.Text: Go along the way, will not folding. You'll see a green vapor - not approach, and get poisoned. Everything has gone. Do not stand there like a lantern to the pharmacy.

dialog.Title: Да. Я тут недавно.
dialog.Text: А замечательно, еще один. Что, приключений захотелось? Или просто заработать решил? В любом случае, чтоб не помер сразу же, вот тебе оружие. А то ваш брат даже оружия с собой не берет.

dialog.Title: Что мне делать?
dialog.Text: Иди вперед, на станцию. Там тебе все объяснят. И экипировку выдадут походную, если ты, конечно, на нее заработаешь.

dialog.Title: Обошел лес, но ничего не нашел.
dialog.Text: Не повезло... Плохо искал! Ну да ладно... Держи мой ПМ. Все же мы с тобой через периметр вместе прошли. До Любеча я доберусь, а там куплю себе новый.

dialog.Title: Голова как чугунная...
dialog.Text: Скоро пройдет. Или военные тебя задели...? ...Через кордон я тебя провел, дальше сам по себе. Тут наши пути расходятся. Иди вперед, на станцию, это недалеко. Там есть доктор. Сможешь прикупить себе что-нибудь. Ты меня слушаешь?

dialog.Title: Угу...
dialog.Text: Сильно тебя зацепило? Когда пули по кустам засвистели, я уж грешным делом подумал -- все, конец сказке. Но нет, прорвались. Вот только обратно идти еще сложнее и опаснее. Я обратно никого не вожу, в одиночку-то еле пробираюсь, каждый раз как в последний. Но Зона никого целиком не отпускает. В Зону все рано или поздно возвращаются.

dialog.Title: Мне вроде уже получше... ||Помню, как прошли периметр...
dialog.Text: Может ты и про деньги вспомнил? Я ведь вас, болезных, не бесплатно сюда вожу.

dialog.Title: Вот 200 рублей, как договаривались.
dialog.Text: Иди вдоль путей, никуда не сворачивая. Увидишь зеленый пар — не приближайся, а то отравишься. Все, пошел. Не стой тут как фонарь пред аптекой.

dialog.Title: Прости, нет у меня денег.
dialog.Text: Твою-то в печень... Как чувствовал, что надо было вперед брать. Я тут шеей рискую, а ты обманул, значит? Вон отсюда. Чтоб ты сгинул к чертям, умник... Ну ничего. Зона все видит, Зона тебя заберет...

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
...What? ...Who? ...Where?

dialog.Title: How are you?
dialog.Text: ...What? How? You? I... Oh... Cup of life-giving water, drink of the gods... That's all you need for life in this God-forsaken hole. And plenty of ammo... B... b... b... Boredom haunts me... Stay on your toes and... Fire! Bah! These lousy creatures runs away! I need grenades! No, wait... there are plenty of... er... "Molotov" here... But... to drink this potentially flaming stuff is much better. I can't spend it on mutants!

dialog.Title: How long have you been here?
dialog.Text: What? Where? Oh... My head... I want to dine. I see we have guests today... What a crowd! But we have no food... I eat only swill here... And it burns me from inside... Burns me to ashes... m... um...

dialog.Title: Here's food.
dialog.Text: Food! Wonder... ful... Wonder... ful... So... We have the food... ...What will you drink?

dialog.Title: How do you do?
dialog.Text: Do what? Wonder... ful. Like on goddamn shooting range. Take this morning. Drank and stood like a mountain... They will not take me alive! Hey... You want a bet?

dialog.Title: What bet?
dialog.Text: At morning... I've shot 20 of these freaks... Can you beat the record?

dialog.Title: I don't compete with drunkards.
dialog.Text: Hey... You offend me... I'm not even drunk... yet.

dialog.Title: Twenty one.
dialog.Text: No kidding... What a speed... And I just filled... glasses. Pick your...!

dialog.Title: How many you shot today?
dialog.Text: Phew... 22! And I took a head from every shot... so neatly that you can send to scientists right away. Hey? What? Impressive? And I'm not... uh ...drunk. It's all the skill. The young tries, but still he have a long way to go. Even you... can't beat it.

dialog.Title: I'll be back with the heads.
dialog.Text: Ha! You telling me... you'll shoot 23 at least and take an intact head of every dog? I'm going to count, you hear? Don't look at me as if I'm drunk. I count just right.

dialog.Title: You know which shots are mine?
dialog.Text: I remember your sounds well from the last time. The shots, the moves, the steps. I'll recognize you in a crowd now. Don't believe me? Ha-ha.

dialog.Title: This is impossible.|You have removed every dead dog's head intact? It's impossible.
dialog.Text: Ha! It's a two-drinks case to me.

dialog.Title: Twenty three.
dialog.Text: Hmm... And I counted twenty... three kills. What's the catch? Oh... It seems that you a master too.

dialog.Title: It seems that way.
dialog.Text: You tricked me, aren't you? Yeah? Oh...

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Hello, my friend. I'm... as they say... know some engineering. If you need to repair something, just ask, I'll help.

dialog.Title: Fix the current equipment.
dialog.Text: One moment! All your current equip... For% COMPLEX_COST%.

dialog.Title: Too much.
dialog.Text: Come on. Where did you find cheaper?

dialog.Title: I need some things to repair.
Changed your mind?
dialog.Text: Nope! Ahhahahahaha!

dialog.Title: Valera is sober now.
dialog.Text: I don't believe ya.

dialog.Title: Maybe later. How are you?
dialog.Text: Want some drink?

dialog.Title: Maybe you should stop drinking?
dialog.Text: Maybe. But I need someone who will stop too.

dialog.Title: We'll see...
dialog.Text: Yup...

dialog.Title: What do you think?
dialog.Text: I think that it could be real. Yes. Why not?

dialog.Title: Good.
dialog.Text: Thank you. You can take my jacket. This is the good one. Don't be fool with this smell. It's a great spirit!

dialog.Title: Bljdad is sober too.
dialog.Text: Wow. I think I need to get sober too. Bljdad... can you even imagine that?

dialog.Title: Hangover?
dialog.Text: Screw you. I'm ill. I need to get out of here. I have a son...I need to find him.

dialog.Title: Be cool.
dialog.Text: I thought he is dead. But He's not. I need to find him. Shit. I'm so stupid. No more drinking! Screw that.

dialog.Title: How could that happened?
dialog.Text: I was working at this factory long time ago. Before the anomalies and that ugly dogs. When they started to build the wall I decided to go with others. And then I've lost my son. I thought he stayed in the Zone and got killed.

dialog.Title: I know who can help you.
dialog.Text: Who?

dialog.Title: But everything is good now.
dialog.Text: Yup. But I think that God is a very bad joker.

dialog.Title: Why?
dialog.Text: I became a believer. But my son was given back to me not by God. I don't buy it. Just an unfunny stupid trick.

dialog.Title: And what you decided to do next?
dialog.Text: I went to the Zone. Illegaly. Look. I just want to know if we are making our future by our own hands...or we're just a dust in the wind... an empty ragdolls driven by higher powers...

dialog.Title: The "Whites" want to become a part of the Zone.
dialog.Text: Are you nuts? I got sober! Not drunk! The Whites are nothing but a crowd of junkies. They eat mutants and burn people alive. If you'll keep bothering me with this "whites' " bullshit I'll kick your ass!

dialog.Title: Pope still believes.
dialog.Text: I understood! God made me the guardian! I'm gonna rebuild this facility and kill all the dogs in the forest. This place is my new home!

dialog.Title: The Swampman advices you to calm down and float on a waves.
dialog.Text: Yeah! I'm going to get out here. But I'll find something unique here at first. Even for the Zone!

dialog.Title: The Prophet from house of culture sayd that we all gonna die.
dialog.Text: He's an idiot. Don't listen to his crap. Or you can get hurt for sure. Don't bother me with this bullshit. I've got a lot of things to do.

dialog.Title: How are you?
dialog.Text: You know...That's not so funny to go on a hunt without any alcohol inside. I dunno how junior can take it...when I was drinking I could rip theit ugly asses only with my arms! I don't have any guns. Only couple of old bullets. So I need an AK-107 for them. Also it would be nice to have a "Screen α" with me.

dialog.Title: I see. I will help you. I'll bring you the gun and the Screen.
About the stuff you're looking for...
dialog.Text: Did you find anything?

dialog.Title: I brought everything you asked for.
dialog.Text: Thank you! That's awesome! Oh. Take these bottles. But don't drink it. Sell it or do something else.Ah. You remind me my old friend.

dialog.Title: С порога - за рога! Загадки знаешь?
dialog.Text: Резкий какой, ты смотри! Кучу народа обогнал, наверное, чтоб первым родиться! Загадки ему, иди-ка ты. Ну, предположим, есть такие. Одна уж точно. Но взамен что-то попрошу.

dialog.Title: Давай, говори, чего уж там.
dialog.Text: Мне для работы кое-что пригодилось бы. Ремнаборы, пяток, наверное, хватит. Да ацетона штук пять, для того, чтоб СВУ мастерить, да чистить тут разное. Справишь мне эти вещи, будет и загадка и благодарность моя.

dialog.Title: Договорились, я берусь.
dialog.Text: Молодца, сталкер. Давай, возвращайся с барахлом!

dialog.Title: Ремнаборы, ацетон, все тут!
dialog.Text: Наш пострел везде поспел! Молодец, молодец. Ну, вот, вознаграждение, а вот и загадка. "Что нам с неба письма приносит?" Несложно, если призадуматься чутка. А теперь, ступай, работа у меня тут.

dialog.Title: Пусть работа спорится! Бывай!
dialog.Text: И тебе всего!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Look out! It's a rat!

dialog.Title: Are you sane?
dialog.Text: Hey, stalker, did you see that? There it is again! A rat ran! Ugh... You will not believe me. I hunted a bear and was not scared a bit. But now afraid this... this abomination... A-A-A, here it is! No, just my imagination. It's not funny! They are naked, red-eyed, disgusting bastards. Listen, could you kill a dozen of these creatures? I will be much safer without so much of them around. I can't leave my post for long and still must watch the road.

dialog.Title: No problem.
dialog.Text: Thank you, stalker, you're my saver.

dialog.Title: I'm not a saver, I just need money.
dialog.Text: Can't help with that. But I can give you my first rifle. It's still in good condition.

dialog.Title: No, I need money.
dialog.Text: Sorry, I have no money myself. I spent all of it on ammo.

dialog.Title: Ok, I can sell the rifle.
Why can't you shoot them yourself?
dialog.Text: My orders is to observe. I can't leave yet. I only have a few rounds in my SVD. They are expensive. And my PM is broken.

dialog.Title: It's a pretty grim situation.
dialog.Text: So? Will you help me?

dialog.Title: I killed your rats. Look!
dialog.Text: What is it? Rat tails? A-a-a! Throw away this stuff! What a stupid joke! But thanks anyway. Remind me what I've promised you? Oh, yes. The "Flute". That's how I call my first rifle. It also the reason for my nickname.

dialog.Title: Not bad.
dialog.Text: Yeah, I crossed half of the Zone with her. Flute can handle strong mutants, but to fight rats with her is too expensive. So I keep her covered for some time. I remember our last hunt together... It's very nostalgic.

dialog.Title: So...?
dialog.Text: I'm afraid I can't give you my Flute. I look at her and know now I'll never give her away. I'll give you a scope instead.

dialog.Title: You tricked me, buddy!
dialog.Text: Well, you know, it's not that kind of thing one can easily give away. The rats should be the ones to blame. I was confused out of fear. Take the scope. You can attach it to many weapons. Or sell it. Good thing too!

dialog.Title: Alright, I take the scope.
dialog.Text: No offence. My life will be not sweet without Flute. She is irreplaceable. I have a PM, but during a wrong care it jammed. It's a pity I didn't take a spare gun as my Mom always said.

dialog.Title: I can bring you a PM. Or take mine.
dialog.Text: No kidding? You'll give me the PM just like that?

dialog.Title: 200 rubles.
dialog.Text: I have no money. Sorry.

dialog.Title: You can have it for free.
Of course, take it.|Of course, take it, I'll buy a new one today.
dialog.Text: Thank you for such assistance. Be careful now. It will be bad if your main gun will jammed or you'll run out of ammo!

dialog.Title: I don't have it right now.
dialog.Text: You'll bring it? It would be great!
What else?

dialog.Title: Here is PM. Take it!
dialog.Text: Thanks, stalker. You saved me.

dialog.Title: What's wrong with your PM?
dialog.Text: It's now beyond repair.

dialog.Title: They still a problem?
dialog.Text: No, it's an old habit of mine. Thanks to you, I hold a line and feel my phobia walking away slowly... from time to time.

dialog.Title: I can shoot some more.
dialog.Text: Hey, I like the way you're thinking! If it's not hard for you... These filthy creatures restore their ranks rather quickly.

dialog.Title: Don't worry, I will cast them away.
I killed a dozen of the rats.
dialog.Text: Thanks! But I'm afraid tomorrow there will be lot of them again...

dialog.Title: There may be no tomorrow.
dialog.Text: You don't make it easy, you know.

dialog.Title: Эй, постой. Загадки никакой не знаешь?
dialog.Text: Знаю! "Красную лису в красной норе привязали, она никак убежать не может." А что?

dialog.Title: Ух ты, черт! Да ничего! Спасибо!!
dialog.Text: За что спасибо-то?! Крыс лучше бы пострелял!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Stalker? Did you bring the legs?

dialog.Title: What legs?
dialog.Text: So you're not the one who promised me to find and kill Spiderkhan? Well, excuse me. But you, stalkers, all look the same to me. My colleagues saw a giant spider around Lubech at M2 . "The horrible spider-khan" as they call him. We really need his leg to continue our research. Just kill the spider, bring his legs and receive medical packages. But I think, these medkits will be out of date soon and the Spiderkhan will more likely be dead of an old age than be killed.

dialog.Title: One Spiderkhan leg. Got it.
dialog.Text: Take your time. The problem is - nobody knows, whether the beast actually exist. So first you should find his lair and make sure he is real. You think, why my colleagues are searching for him for so long? They are real cowards and their eyes are not sharp. So your task is actually dual: kill the Spiderkhan or dispel these gossips.

dialog.Title: I can't take the job.|| I don't like spiders.
dialog.Text: You don't know how to cook them too?

dialog.Title: You can put it this way.
I'll travel there and scout the area.
Here is the spider leg. It's yours.
dialog.Text: Great Scott! The Spiderkhan leg! Who could have thought... Here is your reward. Bring some more! But not now, we have enough of them. Tomorrow maybe...

dialog.Title: Why do you need so many legs?|Why do you need so many of them? They are... heavy, you know.
dialog.Text: We are testing weapon and chemicals on them to increase the effectiveness of fighting against mutants. We working for your sake, stalkers... Listen, you really helped me. And I would like to thank you. Bring me 8 parts of this beas - and I will give you a special recommendation for gaining an experimental equipment.

dialog.Title: Bring 8 legs at a time? I'll do it.|Heh, what kind of "thank you" is it anyway? OK, I'll see what I can do.
dialog.Text: Remember, 8 legs at a time. No less. Or there will be no recommendation for you.

dialog.Title: Are you kidding? It's imposible!
dialog.Text: It is just a test, whether you are worthy of the recommendation.

dialog.Title: I brought you 8 legs!
dialog.Text: Great job, stalker! Here are your recommendations! I think, we'll not need so many in a future. Next time you'll bring no more than one at a time, OK?

dialog.Title: Tell me about the scientist in the cage.|I saw a cage nearby with a scientist in it.
dialog.Text: It's Patisson. He's an oddball, who tries to research live mutants. He have built this cage and sit there for almost month already. We bring him food but don't bother. Let him work while we're here. If he not finish his experiment before a winter, then we'll have to leave him here. Because he won't come out and it is impossible to get him out of there. Mutants are striking his cage every day but even they never succeeded.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Prof. Simonov, at your service.

dialog.Title: What is this place and who are you?
dialog.Text: Welcome to the scientific camp of team "Aegis", my friend. We are exploring local flora and fauna and we have a great chance to make several big scientific discoveries. Most of us are qualified specialists and the we are working all time.

dialog.Title: I won't bother you...
dialog.Text: No, no, wait...

dialog.Title: I am listening.
dialog.Text: I guess, I embellished the situation a bit. You see, we have weapons but we don't have militaries -- only low-skilled mercenaries. We managed to create a camp here and start working, thanks to the resources from the abandoned military base nearby. One stalker showed us this place. We haven't seen him for a while and I'm afraid he vanished in these dead lands while doing an important job for us.

dialog.Title: I don't have time for this.|I guess you don't need another dead stalker, right? So I go away.
dialog.Text: Maybe you are right. Good luck to you then! Good luck to all of us...

dialog.Title: I can finish his work.
dialog.Text: No doubt, my friend! I hope you don't mind if I not give you such difficult and secret assignments yet. In the end, your colleague looked more reliable than you, but he disappeared like he never existed. Ask my coworkers, they have tasks important enough, which can't be completed without skilled and lucky stalker.

dialog.Title: Tell me what is the problem.| Lets get to business, tell me what is the problem.
dialog.Text: We are surrounded by mutants: demons, blyaks, chillers, boars... Here every day is not a work but survival. Walk through the camp and ask other scientists. They surely have work for you. Come back to me after completing all tasks.

dialog.Title: Got it. I'll talk with other scientists.
I don't see any active work.|| Everyone are gloomy and tired like in a queue to the old man Charon.
dialog.Text: Well, you understood it really fast.

dialog.Title: I've helped your colleagues.
dialog.Text: Yes, I see that now our work is going better. You know what... You need to be rewarded. We have many weapons, including military samples. But hired guards couldn't use it all, so we had to trade a part of it for supplies. There is one speculator, named Sly. If you give him these recommendations, he'll give you a good assault rifle Sig Sauer 751. You can find Sly around Lubech, but I don't know where exactly, as I last met him long before the expedition. Then one stalker guided us to the Vezuvius and disappeared. Probably died.

dialog.Title: What can you tell me about your guide?|Tell me about the man who led you here.
dialog.Text: He was a true professional, an old and wise man. He was taking Barret with him everywhere, but it seems that the rifle didn't save him, because he disappeared without a trace. We have sent him with a task, about which I can't talk. Don't even ask. He moved to north-west. I can't imagine what could kill such a skilled stalker.

dialog.Title: I see.|Thanks for the paper. Now I'll try to find this Sly.
dialog.Text: Good luck.

dialog.Title: I found Sly, but he wants arts.|I found Sly, but he didn't give me the rifle. He said you owe him a lot of artefacts.
dialog.Text: Too bad... We don't have any free artefacts, sorry. I apologize, but I can do nothing about it.

dialog.Title: I'm helping your colleagues...
dialog.Text: I heard of it. They told me. That's good. I would be glad to give you the reward when you will deserve it. Keep pushing the science forward to reach a high level of respect.

dialog.Title: For how long should I push the science?
dialog.Text: If the reputation might be measured, then it would be around 27 000 points.

dialog.Title: Can we do it earlier?|So I can hit the wall with my head but you won't share your secrets?
dialog.Text: Try to understand. We don't know you at all, and there are plenty of unfair dealers here, who can trick us to gain a rare weapon.

dialog.Title: I saw a cage nearby with a scientist in it.
dialog.Text: It's our colleague, Patisson. It seems like he doesn't suffer from his situation. The winter is coming soon, we has plenty of work to do and he has to get out, but he doesn't. And he is feeding mutants. Crazy old man. He was carrying the cage with him and constructed it here. With his own hands. He is not a human but a phenomenon.

dialog.Title: You think mutants won't eat him?
dialog.Text: I think his cage is quite reliable. He is alive after all. We gave him guards, but he just send them back. He says they shoot mutants, and shooting mutants is forbidden. He surely going crazy after the accident.

dialog.Title: What accident?
dialog.Text: He had an assistant, a student from the university, who wasn't lucky with his supervisor... In general, first days he was sitting with Patisson in the cage and then he got out for some reason. Right in the time of another attack of the mutants. Of course they ate him. Patisson doesn't take weapons with him, only supplies. So his assistant became a mutant's meal.

dialog.Title: Is there anyone who care about Patisson?
dialog.Text: If he would be a valuable employee... but he is not. If you manage to convince him to leave the cage and to return to the camp, then I'll give a bonus to your salary... Wait... You're not working here... Still, I'll give you a good reward.

dialog.Title: I don't have time for him either.
He'll be back soon.
dialog.Text: I guess he won't. Patisson is famous for his... character.

dialog.Title: Is there anyone who care about Patisson?
The scientist still in the cage.
dialog.Text: What is holding him there?

dialog.Title: His crazy theory...||He believe that mutants assimilate a victim's DNA and that's exactly what they've done with his assistant.
dialog.Text: Hm... That explains a lot. So, Patisson found gens of his assistant in these mutants and now believe that... er... these mutants are his assistant in a sense. It's rather interesting. We shall keep an eye on his research, it might be helpful for the science... However, I can't give you the reward, as you didn't complete the task, but this medkit may be more useful for you than money.

dialog.Title: Maybe you tell me about it? I can help.
dialog.Text: You're good man. I have to ask you something. My collegues don't know that we have a huge debt for the artefacts. Don't tell them. I need a rare "Antigrav α". Get one for me and I'll tell you about your predecessor.

dialog.Title: I don't want even to think about it.
I've found your "Antigrav α".
dialog.Text: Let me see it...

dialog.Title: Yeah.
dialog.Text: Yup. That's what I need. So. Do you want to repeat your predecessor's great deed?

dialog.Title: So let's do this!
dialog.Text: You can disappear like him. But we can't wait longer!

dialog.Title: I'm listening.
dialog.Text: I have one theory aabout how do other people manages to get here from the outer Zone. But I need more information. I sent a stalker to make all the samples. I gave him my analisator. Special gear. Constructed with the inner Zone materials. Our Dr. Aibolit was right about these gear.

dialog.Title: Aaaaaaaaaand.....
dialog.Text: I've sent a stalker in the K2, A1, A10 and K10 areas. It needs to be very close to the Vesuvius to make the right indications. But he sent me just the K2 information. Now he must be at this way: A1 - A10 - then K10 and come back here.

dialog.Title: Did he return?
dialog.Text: You need to repeat his way. You can visit all these areas in your way. But i recommend you to go at K2 and K3 at first. You can find this stalker there.

dialog.Title: Tell me about the stalker who brought you here.
I've visited all the areas.
dialog.Text: I have first results...not good...

dialog.Title: What?
dialog.Text: Do you know about the "Phon" energy? It is averywhere. And it manages to spread wider. And it's getting....hm....more solid if we can say like that. Soon we'll be cut off the other world. We need to do something to find the exit.

dialog.Title: How bad is that?
dialog.Text: There are a lot of men here on the factory. Hundreds of good stalkers. And thousands of "natives". Just imagine that there is no exit from here. It will be like a huge freaking blast when everybody finds out about the situation.

dialog.Title: I found this journal. Your stalker had failed your job. He was working for Chereshnikov.
dialog.Text: Chereshnikov? He's a good specialist but that's too much! Please, remind him about where we are now. Somebody could die because of his pathetic theories!

dialog.Title: I've found some strange "rocks".
dialog.Text: That's not funny.....wait a second....these things are full of Phon! Where did you get that?

dialog.Title: On the couriers' bodies.
dialog.Text: I see...I see....These artefacts are poisoned. But I think that you're already know that. I don't have right equipment here.... but we have special safe boxes for stuff like that.

dialog.Title: Take it from me!
dialog.Text: Ofcourse! And burn down the corpses. That will be good for everyone.

dialog.Title: I've already burned the bodies.
dialog.Text: You did the right thing,

dialog.Title: Why?
dialog.Text: Because the dead ones attracts the living ones. They scavanging, got irradiated by the Phon, go back and infect others.

dialog.Title: But this is good. We can deal with Marauders like that.
dialog.Text: Have you eve heard the word like "Humanity"?

dialog.Title: I have some new toys!
dialog.Text: Let me see... no. That's just party toys. Nothing strange about them.

dialog.Title: I've got a message from Patisson...
dialog.Text: hmmm. Let him work. He could completely change our knowledge about the mutated.

dialog.Title: What did he find out?
dialog.Text: Well..He's been studying 'em closely. The thing is that when he was examining mutants he found traces of his ex-assistant's genes in them. Now he believes that the mutated ARE his ex-assistant, I mean, he's a part of them.

dialog.Title: Will you help him with his research?
dialog.Text: Sure! He'll get anything he needs.

dialog.Title: Помогаю твоим коллегам...
dialog.Text: Слышал, слышал. Продолжай в том же духе, сталкер!

dialog.Title: Не удалось вывести ученого из клетки.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for something?

dialog.Title: What are you doing here?
dialog.Text: Listen, just get out. I don't have time for talking.

dialog.Title: As you say.
dialog.Text: Wait... Are you going from Lubech's railway station? There was a bar desk, where you could buy some cigarettes. Do you have a box of it?

dialog.Title: Yes. Sure.
dialog.Text: O! Thanks, friend.

dialog.Title: Will you answer my questions now?
dialog.Text: Why not? Ask me something.

dialog.Title: What's so special about Ivy's cigarettes?
dialog.Text: It is hard to explain. I don't know and don't want to know how he makes it, but you won't find anything like that anywhere.

dialog.Title: What are you doing here?
dialog.Text: I'm selling some special tools. Do you need one? Only 2 Screens and 80 000. You can fix even a rare stuff with them, if your hands are good enough.

dialog.Title: I will come back later.
dialog.Text: Mmm... OK... Ah, the motherf....sorry. But this tobacco is SOOOOO delicious.

dialog.Title: I gave you everything you need.|| Where are the tools?
dialog.Text: Sorry, pal. Here you go.

dialog.Title: I don't.
dialog.Text: Aaaah...so get lost.

dialog.Title: Do you know about mutants in the new district?
dialog.Text: Get lost.

dialog.Title: Do you know about mutants in the new district?| I have been in one place. There are dead bodies of mutants laid in some kind of ritual circle.
dialog.Text: You should talk to Stepan about it. He is somewhere in this building.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Hey, stalker!

dialog.Title: What do you want?
dialog.Text: Listen up. Can you do me a favor? Be a friend, deliver this 15 rub to Tyomich? He is standing on the other side of the station.

dialog.Title: Why don't deliver it yourself?|| It is several meters to Tyomich.
dialog.Text: It is long story. Just do what I ask you.

dialog.Title: I don't have time for games.
dialog.Text: Games have nothing to do here. It is rather important. It is a matter of life and death.

dialog.Title: Ok, give me your 15 rub.
dialog.Text: Thanks! Take this money. Say, that Owl sends his regards.

And that's all? Damn... Listen, stalker. That guy, whom you gave that coin, owes Owl a lot. And these money are nothing. Owl will be upset. It is not even a half. If I won't deliver Tyomich's debt, I will be the first who get "hurt". Tyomich is deep in the Zone now and he is hard to reach. And I have a wife and a little kid. Owl will take them as hostages. What we gonna do?

dialog.Title: Not my problem.
dialog.Text: Damn... I'm really stuck...

dialog.Title: I can take care of Owl.
dialog.Text: No, bro. Thanks, but I don't think you can handle Owl. This bird is too high for you.

dialog.Title: I can visit Tyomich again.
dialog.Text: Yes, be a friend, ask him to return at least a part of the debt. These cents are not a varient. Owl will think, that we are laughing at him and kill us both.

dialog.Title: This is it. He didn't give me anything.
dialog.Text: Wait, it can't be... Tyomich didn't give anything? What will happen now...

dialog.Title: He said he don't have money.
dialog.Text: He is lying. Ivy saw him with good valuable artefacts recently. Tyomich sold them for a good price. Now his pockets are so full of money that he can barely walk in his pants. Tyomich is no trader or pusher, he doesn't need so much. He is walking just for fun. Ask him again, he must return everything. He must. Or I'll go there myself and beg him for it.

dialog.Title: I'll return to Tyomich, but this is the last time.

dialog.Text: That sounds better. But damn... I need to return it all. I just... need. And Tyomich has money. He is lying. Ivy saw him with good valuable artefacts recently. Tyomich sold them for a good price. Now his pockets are so full of money that he can barely walk in his pants. Tyomich is no trader or pusher, he doesn't need so much. He is walking just for fun. Ask him again, he must return everything. He must. Or I'll go there myself and beg him for it.

dialog.Title: Tyomich says you don't have a family.
dialog.Text: OK. Yes, it is true. I lied. But I have life. I can't run deep into the Zone like Tyomich, so I'm stuck here, on a railway station, where I can be killed by every shadow. I want to live. But things are still bad. I must deliver this debt. Or I'm dead.

And this is looking like a payment now. Ok, thank you. I hope Owl won't kill me... Listen... There is one problem. I owe Owl too. That is why I'm working for him. If I could bring a part of my debt too, that would be awesome. Can you lend me a couple of hundreds?

dialog.Title: Take 200 rubles||, while I am kind.
dialog.Text: Thanks buddy! You saved my life!

dialog.Title: Are you kidding me?!
dialog.Text: Sorry, sorry... My fault.

dialog.Title: He says he don't have money.|| He says that the artefacts were empty.
dialog.Text: Oh god. I'm dead. Now I am surely dead.

dialog.Title: How are you?
dialog.Text: And how do you think? Bad. I owe Owl too. Can you lend me a couple of hundreds?

dialog.Title: Do you know why Prochor is so angry?
dialog.Text: No and I don't care.

dialog.Title: You asked me to deliver the coin?
dialog.Text: You haven't done it yet? You... You tried to rob me? I told you! It's a matter of life and death.

dialog.Title: Sorry, bad memory.
dialog.Text: You need to deliver the coin to Tyomich. He is standing on the other side of the station. Say, that Owl sends his regards.

That's all? Damn... Listen, stalker. That guy, whom you gave that coin, owes Owl a lot. And these money are nothing. Owl will be upset. It is not even a half. If I won't deliver Tyomich's debt, I will be the first who get "hurt". Tyomich is deep in the Zone now and he is hard to reach. And I have a wife and a little kid. Owl will take them as hostages. What we gonna do?

dialog.Title: Что знаешь про смерть Темона?
dialog.Text: Попросил его деньги передать, а он их себе взял, не передал и не вернулся. Сам бы убил эту скотину, но кто-то меня опередил. И разумеется, моих денег у него уже не было.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for a job?

dialog.Title: Kisliy told me, you got ammo.
dialog.Text: I'll give you some rounds if you kill the dogs outside the post office.

dialog.Title: What kind of job are you offering?
dialog.Text: You need to look for toys at the nearby villages. These toys are valuable for rich collectors on the other side. I need Roly-Poly, a Teddy Bear, a Toy Ball, and a Rubik's Cube. I'll pay good for them.

dialog.Title: I brought you some toys.
dialog.Text: Well done! And they all are in perfect state!

dialog.Title: Do you know why Prochor is so angry?
dialog.Text: Prochor? He owes me money. And he doesn't have one. That's why he is angry. He worries.

dialog.Title: Do you have christmas tree toys?
dialog.Text: I had, but I sold them.

dialog.Title: Did you see stalker Senka around?
dialog.Text: I have no idea. You asking like they have names and clantages written above their heads. There was a stalker here recently, bought the last toys. He asked me whether I know where fir-trees are coming from. I answered him that there are some trees and E9. If you go by the power lines from Gurman, then you wont miss it. Just choose a right direction. And then he said -- "Damn, I need to go back now?" Does he look like your Senka? If it was him, than he went there. He wanted to see living fir-trees. Or want to cut one for personal usage.

dialog.Title: That's all for now... Good luck.
У меня есть пара вопросов.
dialog.Text: Спрашивай.

dialog.Title: Слышал про аварию на мосту?
dialog.Text: Что-то слышал, но мне это не особо интересно. Кислый, Кузнец, военные -- вот для них такие поставки важны. А я общаюсь с барыгами, у них свои связи...

dialog.Title: Не знаешь, как выбраться из Зоны?
dialog.Text: Шутишь, да...? Слушай как здесь все устроено. Пересекать границу нельзя -- Зона на карантине. Вокруг периметр, патрули, все возможные входы и выходы неустанно стерегут военные. Но в самой Зоне тоже есть люди. Живут, работают... Считается, что все мы -- коренные. То есть жили тут всегда, еще до аномалий и до возведения периметра. На самом деле это не так. Большинство проникли сюда незаконно и прижились много позже. Но пока ты не рвешься наружу -- военным плевать. Забудь про "выбраться". Живи сегодняшним днем. Нашел, продал, выпил. С таким порядком не заметишь, как станешь своим и будешь как дома.

dialog.Title: Как же барыги передают товар наружу?
dialog.Text: Взятки и связные. В документах помечают как "исследовательские материалы" или что-то вроде того. Оформляют через знакомых ученых, доплачивают военным на границе. Ресурсы из Зоны постоянно поступают в большой мир, передать или продать что-то за периметр гораздо проще, чем пересечь границу самому. Я знаю, о чем ты подумал. Можно ли через правильных людей купить себе поддельную личность и выйти... Все можно, не спорю. Но нужны нехилые деньги и надежные связи. Это тебе не матрешек перекрашивать.

dialog.Title: Как ты попал в Зону?
dialog.Text: Десять лет с семьей жил -- надоело. Это тупик. Нянчишься с ними, пашешь как бык... А жизнь проходит. Устал, ушел, запил. В Зоне нашел себя. Договорился с людьми, начал продавать хабар за кордон. Сколотил этим трудом небольшой капитальчик. Теперь нанимаю молодых, сам не рискую -- возраст уже не тот. Но всем доволен. Мне здесь хорошо.

dialog.Title: Что знаешь про смерть Темона?
dialog.Text: Кого? Впервые слышу.

dialog.Title: Прохор говорит, вы поругались.
dialog.Text: Значит я его и убил? Ты бредом не страдай. Ну поругались мы с одним сталкером. Он мне новые игрушки пытался продать. С большой земли. Аферист хренов. Только с дороги — уже полные карманы игрушек. Мол, в соседних домах набрал. Притащил их через все кордоны, чтобы втюхать мне здесь втридорога. И ведь узнал где-то, что я их скупаю. Подзатыльник ему отвесил и прогнал в шею. С тех пор не видел. Понятия не имею, как его звали и что с ним стало. А Прохор задолжал мне немало, поэтому клевещет. Не хочет долг отдавать и надеется, что Кислый меня выставит.

dialog.Title: У меня пакет от Сеньки.
dialog.Text: Т-с-с-с. Давай еще на весь Любеч объявим. Принес? Молодец. Тихонько мне передал, забрал мишку и топай назад к Сеньке, скорее.

dialog.Title: Я за товаром для Сеньки.
dialog.Text: Т-с-с-с. Давай еще на весь Любеч объявим. Тихонько забрал мишку и топай назад к Сеньке, скорее.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
What do you want? Get lost.

dialog.Title: Don't be so nervous. I'm leaving.
You owe a bear head.|You owe a bear head to Nechiporenko. It is time.
dialog.Text: That freaking fat prick got all he wants from the Army supplies, and here we should risk our asses to bring him even more!

dialog.Title: Hey. Don't wait for a Christmas.|| I'll collect the debt or your dead body.
dialog.Text: Easy, man. You're late to a date or something?

dialog.Title: Where is the head?
dialog.Text: Right here.

dialog.Title: Ты это, давай не задерживай, а то у меня диалог короткий, могу бабки и с бесчувственного тела снять...
dialog.Text: Да на, держи бабки, нервный какой, что на свидание опаздываешь?

dialog.Title: Ты давай лишние домыслы то не строй, твое дело маленькое, деньги отдал и свободен.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
God be with you, stalker.

dialog.Title: How can I help?
dialog.Text: Once I had a dog. Good faithful dog, my dear friend, he was and guarded me from the demonic creatures. One day he tore side of marsh-demon and changed almost in his eyes. Became bigger, meaner, eyes dizzy... With aching heart, I took the beast into the forest. So after he returned back and a dozen creatures with a lead. Now these dogs are howling at night and began to attack people. They are contagious. All villagers are reaped by them. And it's my fault. Oh, if only I killed him ... But I could not take the sin on the soul ...

dialog.Title: It is necessary to kill these creatures.|Better to kill these creatures, as they do not spread the infection.
dialog.Text: Thank you, stalker, bless you for this good deed.

dialog.Title: This should somehow involve me? | Hey, who said that I will kill ...? Oh well ...
dialog.Text: Believe and be rewarded!

dialog.Title: Contagious? I have to go from here|| And I do not advise.you to stay here.
dialog.Text: Oh, trouble, trouble ...

dialog.Title: No more of your dog alive. I killed the whole pack.
dialog.Text: Thank you, stalker. I will go, to find the remains of my dog, and bring them to the fire. Like all the other bodys.

dialog.Title: I condole with you upon your loss.
Crows require you to return debt
dialog.Text: God be with you, a stalker, how can I have money? Consider that the donations themselves save us. Only in this way and hold on.

dialog.Title: Tell me some where you hid the money. | I've already helped with the dogs, now tell me how you saved from the Ravens?
dialog.Text: I must confess that sin. I was scared the Ravens so scared that I ran through the woods, without a break. I have dropped their coin, there it is lies still, if not picked up until now. There's an anomaly, stalker, be careful if you go there.

dialog.Title: I will consider it. Thank you.
Buried the dog?
dialog.Text: No. Could not find. You really killed him?

dialog.Title: They're all the same. | How do I know - they look all the same.
dialog.Text: Ah, the stalker, the problem is ... Then let's do so. On my dog had a collar. No inscriptions, he was, but I know if I see it. If you find collars - Bring them to me. That's how we define, you killed my dog ​​or not.

dialog.Title: I can bring you to their heads?
dialog.Text: God forbid, a stalker, fear of such. Why do I need their heads? They are mutants, but still living creatures. No, bring me to their dog-collars.

dialog.Title: Brought collars ...
dialog.Text: Now let's see ... No, what a pity. Among them, my dog ​​was not ... Where is he wanders? Thank you, stalker, be that as it may, the good deed done. You do not leave us. Once the dog is not found soon the demons are back.

dialog.Title: What's new?
dialog.Text: Trouble. The dogs, which you broke up, came back.

dialog.Title: How to back? From the grave or something?
dialog.Text: Stalker, do not mess with me like that. Of course, this other dog, but the contagion is the same. Seems to me they are back here for a reason. Something draws them to the old kennels, like the creature know that their ancestors lived here. Kennels must be put to the torch, then the dogs will remain homeless and stop coming to the village.

dialog.Title: Burn all the kennels in the village. Got it.
dialog.Text: Take the lighter. I have finished gasoline, but look for in a village in cans. A drop will be found, this will be enough kennels.

dialog.Title: I burned the kennels.
dialog.Text: You did the right thing. Maybe now the rest will come in the village ..

dialog.Title: You have found your dog?
dialog.Text: No. It worries me, stalker.It seems that my dog became a strong mutant. The leader. And his doggery not get enough of, until it gets to me. The heart can feel. Need to lure him out of the shelter, no matter where he was hiding. Could you talk to hunters, suddenly they will recommend something.

dialog.Title: I killed the dog. Here's collar.
dialog.Text: So, so ... No, unfortunately. It was not my dog.

dialog.Title: Father, you're probably kidding!
dialog.Text: God be with you, stalker. There was no such thoughts.I tell you everything as is. You have killed a strong dog-mutant. I believe it was right and will protect us all from a great disaster. But my dog, their leader, is still somewhere out there, wandering in the darkness. Wandering and waiting ...

dialog.Title: Я тебе с собаками помог? Помог.|| Рассказывай теперь, как ты от воронов спасся.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Where is salute and status report?

dialog.Title: Allow me to address in the form, sir.
dialog.Text: At ease. Permission to speak freely.

dialog.Title: I want to know about the secret base|| "The Black Target", where the experiments were conducted on mutants.
dialog.Text: Maybe you want me to give you the keys to my apartment where the money are hidden? You will receive your information if you are ready to perform an emergency mission of importance.

dialog.Title: What kind of mission?
dialog.Text: There is a stalker, he owes me a bear's head. Your task is to persuade him to give the head back and bring it to me. Understood?

dialog.Title: Understood sir. May I proceed?
dialog.Text: At ease. You may go.

dialog.Title: No, not ready yet.
dialog.Text: Come back when you're ready.

dialog.Title: Allow me to address in the form, sir.
dialog.Text: At ease. Status report.

dialog.Title: Sir, I brought the Crucian's debt.
dialog.Text: Well done, soldier, keep it up. So what are you asking...? "Black Target", you say? There is no such place. But if it were, it would be built somewhere away from the perimeter, in a place such as Vesuvius, in the square Г2. But I did not say anything to you, understand? Don't go there, stalker, because it's a hell full of shit now. Textually.

dialog.Title: ...I am a civilian.
dialog.Text: Get out of here, "civilian". Civilians are not allowed to stay here. You should thank me for what I'm in a good mood today, and I will not report about you to authorities.

dialog.Title: Allow me to address in the form, sir.
I want to know about the secret base|| "Black Target", where the military trained on mutants.
dialog.Text: Who are you? And what is this dirty rumor? Get out of here before you get stormed.

dialog.Title: I'm looking for stalker "Temon."
dialog.Text: Why do you need him?

dialog.Title: He could be the murderer.
dialog.Text: Did yoy just say murderer? Well....he must be punished, then. But there's a problem, you know. Temon got me a pachage from Courier. He did well, no bullshit. And you're saying now he's a criminal. Why should I trust you, not him? Where did you come from, stalker?

dialog.Title: From Lyubich...
dialog.Text: Go home, then.Ddon't snoop around here.

dialog.Title: Tatarin sent me.
dialog.Text: So what?

dialog.Title: It was him who sent Temon to you.
You told him about the colonel.
dialog.Text: Shit! I didn't. Temon was delivering packages from Courier. He had one for the colonel and wanted to head to Tunguska. He knew he oldman would justify him in return of a good favor.

dialog.Title: So, now what?
dialog.Text: You go to Tunguska. Find Kolya Tesla nearby. he'll lead you. But only for this once! I'm not working my ass for you here. Find Temon.

dialog.Title: Yes sir!
dialog.Text: Off you go.

dialog.Title: Tatarin sent me..
dialog.Text: Right on time. Come! Excited to learn more

dialog.Title: Хочу искупить грехи!
dialog.Text: Ага, ты, значит, из этих. У которых пуля вперед мысли вылетает. Ну-ну, доигрался в Дикий Запад? Подпортил себе репутацию, а теперь совесть одолела? Вот и славно. Итак, порядок исправительных работ таков. Я тебе выдаю ремкомлект. Ты идешь к вышке ЛЭП, которая нравится и, так сказать, обслуживаешь ее по первому разряду. Потом берешь у меня комплект для следующей. Ясно? Ну, вперед, марш!

dialog.Title: Задание выполнено, тов. прапорщик!
dialog.Text: Хорошо, боец! Потрудился на славу, карму выправил. Вольно!
Hello, a fateful child.

dialog.Title: What do you know about the new district?|I was in the new district lately and saw some creepy things there: a pile of mutants bodies placed as a circle.
dialog.Text: The apocalypse is near, the mutants will rise against the people and will punish us for our sins. Men of science and their sacrilege experiments - that's the reason of our future fall. They gather in the Zone like flies, but the darkness will absorb them. Their perverted souls will break out of their bodies, transform their flesh and strike the remains of humankind. People will fall into darkness, will destroy the Mother Nature, and there will be no rest, neither on the earth, nor in water or the sky.

dialog.Title: Er...?
dialog.Text: The apocalypse is near, the mutants will rise against the people and will punish us for our sins.

dialog.Title: Here, take a coin.
dialog.Text: I'm the voice in the darkness! Soon the human world will fall and the dark times will truly begin.

There's no God here! You God is a mutant! No use begging for mercy. Devil came. We're all doomed. We'll be punished for our sinse, greed and vanity. Repent and meet demise until it's too late, cause the End is Nigh!

dialog.Title: Артур с Новым Годом поздравляет
dialog.Text: Значит не забыл Артур своего друга! Ох, как приятно... Даже слёзы на глаза навернулись... Спасибо тебе, сталкер, за поздравление от друга моего! В знак благодарности, прими от меня небольшой Новогодний подарочек.

dialog.Title: Спасибо!
dialog.Text: Постой! Задам вопрос один! Коль истину ответишь - радость тебе будет! Я видел, как мертвое родило живое, и дыхание живого истребило мертвое. Что я видел, сталкер!?

dialog.Title: Воду?
dialog.Text: Нет. Истина где-то не тут. Прощай!

dialog.Title: Дерево?
dialog.Text: Нет. Истина где-то не тут. Прощай!

dialog.Title: Огонь?
dialog.Text: О, как ты мудр! Вот твоя награда! Прощай! И не бойся пылающего в небе огня!

dialog.Title: Пулю?
dialog.Text: Нет. Истина где-то не тут. Прощай!

dialog.Title: Снегурочку?
dialog.Text: Нет. Истина где-то не тут. Прощай!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Нарушителей закона отвергаем, негодуя, ибо семя упавшее в отравленную почву, взойдет лишь плевелами!

dialog.Title: Да, расскажи о своей вере.
dialog.Text:
Слушай же, пришедший, и принимай истину в сердце своем!
Вот, был бог, и Сущее, которое он сотворил. Сущее же было зеркалом его, через которое он видел и познавал свое безграничное Я. Но, как он познавал Сущее, так и оно меняло его, ибо они суть едины порознь. И вот, он ощутил довольно перемен, чтобы передать их Сущему от себя. Новое творение отразит новое в боге и это коснется всего, что было прежде. Бог, изменившийся, теперь над нами, бог-мутант. Пойте его, братья! Пойте в унисон новому миру! Ибо, вместе с ним, и мы переменимся, став Новыми Людьми! В нас будет больше от бога, чем в прежних творениях! Те же, что согрешили против него, станут тварями, пожирающими людей и друг друга. Теми, что, вот, уже вокруг нас! Тварями, коим нет места рядом с богом! Ни также вдали от него, ни во тьме внешней, ни в иных творениях его! Они будут истреблены, и бытие их забудется, смытое водами времени. Не конец света нас ждет, но свет новый, еще более яркий! Сражайтесь за него, бейтесь, не зная усталости! Ибо многие выступят против, говоря «нет вашего бога!» Но падут, пораженные, ниц, перед Новыми Людьми. И узреют новое небо и новую землю, ибо прежние минуют!

dialog.Title: Благодарю. Я услышал тебя.
dialog.Text: Иди, но не ищи покоя. Мирное время уже на исходе!

dialog.Title: Я хочу присоединиться к вам.
dialog.Text: Желание твое похвально, но пока лишь бьет крылами по воздуху, сотрясая его. Нам нужно доказательство. Если твои слова правдивы, ты должен пройти испытания, чтобы мы увидели твое рвение. И, что куда важнее – чтобы ты сам понял, истинно ли твое желание, или ты хочешь отступить. Мы не можем ошибаться в тех, кто желает разделить нашу веру и наш путь.

dialog.Title: Что это будут за испытания?
dialog.Text: Их будет три, и каждое проверит аспект твоей веры и сущности. Первое – понимание и готовность помочь ближнему. Второе – праведную ярость и смелость. И третье – проверка желания распространить наши идеи и на твою чистоту помыслов. Они могут показаться как тяжкими, так и вполне легкими. На все воля бога-мутанта!

dialog.Title: Я готов. И уверен в своем желании.
dialog.Text: Да будет так! Тогда, первое испытание - жертвенность и смирение.Тебе предстоит превратить свои стремление и веру в слова, которые ты должен будешь донести до самых дальних уголков измененного мира. В каждом из них есть человек, который склонится к твоим словам. Найди их и позволь услышать себя. Если твои слова идут из сердца и души - у тебя все получится.

dialog.Title: Боюсь, я в сомнениях.
dialog.Text: Изгони саму тень сомнения прочь из души своей перед тем, как принять решение. Обрати помыслы к сути своей и слушай музыку перемен, что звучит в мире.

dialog.Title: Где мне искать этих людей?
dialog.Text: В Окрестностях Любеча, на Тунгуске, в Аэропорту, Везувии и Новой Земле! Твоя вера должна послужить маяком при поисках.

dialog.Title: Хорошо. Я исполню свою миссию.
dialog.Text: Да будет тебе место в Новом мире!

dialog.Title: Я донес слова истины до людей.
dialog.Text: Хвала богу-мутанту, что поддерживает нас и дает силы от веры! Ты жив, и твое первое испытание пройдено. Я радуюсь в сердце своем твоему успеху!

dialog.Title: Я готов к следующему испытанию.
dialog.Text: Хорошо! Рвение твое примерно и радует меня. Второе испытание проверит твои силы, готов ли ты сразиться с порождениями Старого Мира во имя перерождения в Новом. С тварями придется тебе сразиться, что страшны весьма, ибо напоминают людей. Уничтожай их безжалостно, ибо они суть все, что есть плохого в мире, и к тому же порождения гордыни людской!

dialog.Title: Я найду и истреблю их!
dialog.Text: Да будет так!

dialog.Title: Кара постигла мерзких отродий.
dialog.Text: Воистину, огонь в сердце твоем и руку твою направляет бог-мутант! Ты прошел второе испытание! Да будет тебе место в Новом мире!

dialog.Title: Я могу пройти финальное испытание.
dialog.Text: Оно будет необычным для тебя. Возможно, покажется слишком простым. Тебе нужно будет разнести вести о нас, распространить послание. Вот, листовки с тезисами нашей религии. Разложи их в разных местах, не отдавая в руки никому, ибо мы не желаем навязывать свои взгляды. Сталкеры, равно, как и другие обитатели Зоны найдут их и услышат нас. Вначале единицы, затем множество.

dialog.Title: Я пройду этот путь!
dialog.Text: Воистину, верую в твои силы.

dialog.Title: Слово распространено. Верю, его услышат.
dialog.Text: Воистину, свершилось! Ты доказал свое рвение и силы, пройдя испытания. Теперь ты с нами, что станут Новыми людьми в Новом мире! Мы с восторгом принимаем перемены, постигшие земли людские, и битву, что предстоит, дабы унаследовать эти земли. Пусть иные вопрошают "за что это нам такие беды" или "отчего мир отторгает нас"! Мы смело идем вперед, и теперь ты с нами! Рад приветствовать тебя, брат!

dialog.Title: Что будет теперь?
dialog.Text: Когда настанет час, а может, и раньше, я буду искать помощи братьев. И твоей в том числе. Это может оказаться что угодно, ибо перемены также непредсказуемы. Будь готов как убивать чудовищ, так и заняться поиском редких растений или совершить долгое путешествие. Но все это после, а пока ты заслужил отдых. Рад, что ты нашел в себе силы для того, чтобы присоединиться к нам.
Got some cash?

dialog.Title: Here you are. Keep the change.
dialog.Text: Thank's bro. I wanna grab some coins and get something to eat on the railway station. I'm so freakin' hungry... Oh, I've got a proposition for ya. I've heard about fried mute puppyheads. But there is no heads there right now. I asked Dima for some food, but he refused to sell it to me. I need you to kill some of these bastards and bring me 10 of their heads. I'll cook it and give some for ya. Deal?

dialog.Title: Hey. Hold the puppyheads.
dialog.Text: Super. Now I'll cook it......shit!.....this smell.........Well, we won't die......maybe not now...and not from hunger. Here's your cut.

dialog.Title: Зачем тебе мясо?
dialog.Text: Как зачем? Затем же, зачем и всем -- есть его! Ты, кстати, сам не голоден? Если у тебя мясо есть, то могу его на нашем костре поджарить. Только, как делить будем? Вот если бы ты добыл кусков пять мяса, тогда бы мы с ребятами его поджарили, ну и поделили бы по справедливости -- тебе два куска и нам по одному.

dialog.Title: Мне бы фейерверки
dialog.Text: Добро! Неси мясо и буде тебе фейерверк!

dialog.Title: Держи мясо
dialog.Text: Отлично! А вот и твоя доля. Держи!

dialog.Title: Я мясо приёс. Гони фейерверк.
dialog.Text: Отлично! Давай его сюда.

dialog.Title: Так быстро?
dialog.Text: Ха! Так сам видишь, сколько народу в Любече и все голодные. Вот мясо к нам и несут! Только успевай его жарить!

dialog.Title: Фейерверк
dialog.Text: Держи! Но смотри аккуратней с ним! Очень близко не стой рядом, когда запускать будешь. Ну, бывай, сталкер! Веселись!

dialog.Title: Что-то песня не ахти как...
dialog.Text:
Сам ты... Уже немного осталось, дослушаешь и мясо будет готово!
Надо выдать преступнику печень, Но сойдет для него требуха. Мне роскошный обед обеспечен, А ему все равно ха-ха-ха! Умеют повара проворачивать дела, Что плохо лежит, не зевай-вай-вай, Только повара, только повара, Только поворачиваться успевай!
Всё! Готово! Держи свою долю!

dialog.Title: Спасибо
dialog.Text: На здоровье! Ну, ты заглядывай! С мясом желательно! Ха-ха-ха!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
What do you want?

dialog.Title: Do you have work for me?
dialog.Text: I have a job for you. One madman lives here in the swamps. We call him Swampman. Well, he isn't always lived in the swamp. This bastard had run away from us, and didn't pay. I myself have never set a foot to the swamp, that's why I look for a stalker. A stalker will be able to find a way, right? Take ten thousand rubles from him, and bring the money to me. I'll give you five thousand in return.

dialog.Title: Here your ten thousand rubles.
dialog.Text: Wait, I'll check the money.

dialog.Title: Everything is fine?
dialog.Text: Yes. Well, here is your honestly earned three thousand.

dialog.Title: Thank you.
dialog.Text: Now piss off and don't bother me anymore.

dialog.Title: Wait a minute...|| You promised five thousand.
dialog.Text: You're smart. Take your five. And don't come to me anymore.

dialog.Title: Do you have work for me?
dialog.Text: I told you never bother me again... But wait, stop you, man! Listen, there is one meanie named Priest. Maybe he is a true priest, I do not know. He's one of those... local residents, consider, almost mutant. But do not worry, he is ok... Or was... last time I saw him. This Priest has a debt of 12 thousands and is hiding somewhere in the villages right now. I can't find him myself, but you can. And if you suddenly find him, take the money from him and go back to me. Bring all twelve thousands, and the six thousands will be yours.

dialog.Title: Here your twelve thousand.
dialog.Text: Wait, I'll check the money.

dialog.Title: Happy now?
dialog.Text: Yes. Well, here is your honestly earned three thousand.

dialog.Title: Wait a minute...|| You promised six thousand rubles.
dialog.Text: Smart eye. Well done. Come again.

dialog.Title: Thank you.
dialog.Text: Well done. Come again.

dialog.Title: Do you have work for me?
dialog.Text: Somewhere on the outskirts of Lubech lives a pervert named Gourmet. Why he was given such a nickname? This moron likes to cook different dishes of the mutants. Can you imagine, eating mutants. I, as the official representative of the "Ravens Wood", can't leave this behavior just like that. In short, take some money from him. Shake him like a tree. This wise guy sells its culinary specialties, so he has lots of money. You have to pick up from him at least 50 thousands. Once you take them and bring them me, I'll give you 25 thousand. Yes, I'm in a generous mood today.

dialog.Title: Here are your 50 000 rubles.
dialog.Text: Wait, I'll check the money.

dialog.Title: Happy now?
dialog.Text: Yes. Well, here is your honestly earned ten thousand.

dialog.Title: Wait a minute... ||You promised me twenty-five thousand rubles.
dialog.Text: Am I? Are you calling me a liar? Think again... Ha-ha-ha... Just kidding. Here's your money.

dialog.Title: Do you have work for me?
dialog.Text: Not yet. Come back later.

dialog.Title: My mistake. I don't have the money.
dialog.Text: Yes, I see you didn't collect enough.

dialog.Title: My mistake. I don't have the money.
dialog.Text: Yes, I see you didn't collect enough.

dialog.Title: My mistake. I don't have the money.
dialog.Text: Yes, I see you didn't collect enough.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь

dialog.Title: Работа есть. Наградой не обидят.
dialog.Text: Что еще за работа? Я тут тоже не просто так. Вон, яйцеголовых сторожу. Да ладно, шуткую я! Уже на стенку лезу от тоски. Долги выбиваю из местных, как уличный бандит, а руки чешутся по драке. Вон, Тэклберри не теряется, хоть и псих. Уже какую-то войну затеял. А я что-то никак не соберусь. Ну да, ладно, отвлекся. Так что у тебя?

dialog.Title: Надо уменьшить криминальную прослойку.
dialog.Text: Насколько? И кто заказчик? Если ты, то задаток будет нужен. Если нет, тогда давай, подтверди, что не воздух трясешь.

dialog.Title: Верхнего предела нет. А вот бумаги.
