dialog.Text: Смотри, этот умник быстро медальоны на атомы разберет, так что скорее всего, новые понадобятся. Если что, подходи, обращайся.

dialog.Title: Let me see what you have for sale

dialog.Text: I'm selling and buying stuff. C'mon, don't stand here if you're not going to do business.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Wait, I still have a business here.
Yes, I need to go outside.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Wait, I still have a business here.
Yes, I need to go outside.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Wait, I still have a business here.
Yes, I need to go outside.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Wait, I still have a business here.
Yes, I need to go outside.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Hello, stalker. Do you need something?

dialog.Title: I'm looking for a job.
dialog.Text: There is one task. We need samples for research. There are mutants in the laboratory, which we called "grey spiders" due to changes of human nature made to them. Someone should come down to the lab and take samples of their legs. We want to compare them with spiders that live in forests and swamps and to highlight the changes. But the lab now is in chaos. In addition to spiders, there are many different evil things, I do not know how they got there... So, I recommend a well-prepared group. We don't need new deaths on our conscience.

dialog.Title: No. Not interested.
dialog.Text: Well, okay. We'll find someone else.

dialog.Title: I'll return with the legs.
dialog.Text: Excellent. I wait here.

dialog.Title: I brought spider's legs.
dialog.Text: Nice timing. We wait appropriate samples for a long time now. Here is for your efforts.

dialog.Title: Any tasks? I'm sure spiders are miss me.
dialog.Text: There is a task. To move the science as they say. We all appreciate your work. It's obviously, you are pro in legs cutting. But this task is much more difficult. We want you to bring legs of spiders from different places. Can you do it?

dialog.Title: I'll bring them.
dialog.Text: I am waiting.

dialog.Title: No, I need to do something else.
dialog.Text: Too bad.

dialog.Title: I brought you legs.
dialog.Text: What legs?

dialog.Title: I gave them to you already.
dialog.Text: Yes, right. Good work.

dialog.Title: I need more work.
dialog.Text: Good. Now we need claws of the young bear for the important research. And we need at least a couple of intacted ones as there are several different stages of the mutation in them. Are you in?

dialog.Title: I'm in!
dialog.Text: Wait... Sorry, this is a mistake. Buch has promised me to bring them already. I absolutely forgot about it. So... We don't need so much claws at once, so settle this matter yourself. Or wait until we shall need them again.

dialog.Title: No way!|No way... flank your bear. Try to kill this giant on your own!
dialog.Text: As you wish.

dialog.Title: Here, I brought you claws. ||It was really fascinating. Especially when I nearly had my ass bitten off. Anyway, take your claws and research them as much as you want.
dialog.Text: You can't imagine, what a great contribution to science you've done! Here is your reward, stalker.

dialog.Title: Is there any more work?|| Can't sleep so want to kill something, tear it apart and bring these slimy parts to you. Again.
dialog.Text: I have to disappoint you. We don't need any parts now. You should visit a place -- the chemical waste dump at Н14. There should be our collegue, doctor Voronin, nearby. Talk to him and ask about the progress in his assignment. Then come back here.

dialog.Title: It was a damn hard walk.|| Me and Voronin were nearly killed. I helped him to repel the attack. He said, that he not finished his work yet and he will return only by tomorrow.
dialog.Text: Thank you. Tomorrow then. OK, let's wait.

dialog.Title: Is there any other work?
dialog.Text: We have another one, quite hard, but I think you can do it. We will give a special device to you. It is working automatically, so don't touch it or you'll break it. This device registrate special energetic waves, which come from the mutants in their moment of death. You need to kill the following monsters: a spider, a dog, a boar, a rat, a bear, a verlioka and a blyak. So... will you agree? The reward will be worthy, of course!

dialog.Title: OK. Give me the device.|I love to kill mutants, of course. Give me the device.
dialog.Text: Here.

dialog.Title: No, I won't do it!|You want to kill me or what? No, I won't take this job!
dialog.Text: As you wish.

dialog.Title: I've had enough of those mutants.
dialog.Text: Good job! Your reward is right here.

dialog.Title: I need some more.
dialog.Text: Sorry, low budget.

dialog.Title: I brought 15 spider's legs from the Courier.
dialog.Text: Excellent.
Yes?

dialog.Title: Fine by me.
dialog.Text: That's good.

dialog.Title: So, when?
dialog.Text: They promised next month. But you know our politicians.

dialog.Title: Is there any work?
dialog.Text: Unfortunately, we don't have any more tasks for you. Maybe later. We wait for a money receipt from our financing source. There will be more tasks after that. You've proofed yourself well.

dialog.Title: Ok.
dialog.Text: You can't kill a bear by yourself, so seek for companions first.

dialog.Title: It's a long road. Later.
dialog.Text: As you wish.

dialog.Title: I could use a good walk.
dialog.Text: Excellent.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
I'm listening.

dialog.Title: Good day. I'm from Dibenko.|| I need a report about the situation.
dialog.Text: Hey. Of course. Everything is fine here. But I thought I saw a bear behind the gate. I did not check. The orders were to observe only.

dialog.Title: Sorry, my mistake.|| You, soldiers, all look alike.
dialog.Text: You little...! Get out of here!

dialog.Title: I'm from the Courier.|| He asked me deliver the package to you.
dialog.Text: Just in time, give it here.

dialog.Title: I brought the vacuum tube.
dialog.Text: That's it. Give it to me.

dialog.Title: I'm here to take the vacuum tube.
dialog.Text: The radio is on the table. Go there and take it. When you visited all posts, find Basmach, he will give you new tubes. I need one set of them.

dialog.Title: Good day. I'm from Dibenko.|| I need a report about the situation.
dialog.Text: Nothing to report. We saw and heard no one. Can't say we miss them, but it's almost boring.

dialog.Title: Good luck.
dialog.Text: Take care.

dialog.Title: Maybe we can find a solution?
dialog.Text: Leave before I'd kick your ass outta here.

dialog.Title: I need out.
dialog.Text: No way. We neither let in nor let out. We secure this area. Too many mutants lately. To pass you'll need a special permission from sergeant Dibenko.

dialog.Title: I need out.
dialog.Text: I have an order from Dibenko. You can pass. Don't die out there.

dialog.Title: What's new?
dialog.Text: Nothing.

dialog.Title: All clear?
dialog.Text: What do you want?

dialog.Title: I've got questions about the Zone.
dialog.Text: I'm busy now.

dialog.Title: Tell me about the Culture Center
What is the Zone?
dialog.Text: I said I'm busy! Are you deaf or dumb?

dialog.Title: You don't seem busy.
dialog.Text: That's it! Clear the way.

dialog.Title: Why so unfriendly?
dialog.Text: What are you snooping around here? I'm on duty! Pprotecting the gates and radio equipment.

dialog.Title: Got it.
dialog.Text: Clear the way or I'll clean your clock!

dialog.Title: Have you herad about crash on the bridge?
How can I get away from the Zone?
How did you get in here?
Know the joke about the quard and a stalker?
Oh..And what if comes to the push?
Are you on duty when sleeping?
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Hello, stalker, what do you need?

dialog.Title: Dibenko sent me.|| I need a report about the situation.
dialog.Text: Why the sergeant sends citizens here? I have no right to share information with a stranger.

dialog.Title: Well, no problem. I'll tell him|| that his soldier does not know anything, did not see anything, because he is sleeping under the tree.
dialog.Text: Hey! Wait a minute. Alright. Tell the sergeant, that all is quiet in our square. No incidents.

dialog.Title: Good luck.
dialog.Text: Yeah. Do not stumble on your way back.

dialog.Title: I brought the vacuum tube.
dialog.Text: Well, it's about time. Where is it?

dialog.Title: I'm here to take the vacuum tube.
dialog.Text: Okay. The radio broke again. You'll find this rubbish near the watchtower, on the table. When you'll visit all posts, go to Basmach, he will give you new tubes. Bring me a new one.

dialog.Title: Hey. I am from Dibenko.|| I need a report about the situation.
dialog.Text: No news here. As they say, it's too quiet.

dialog.Title: I need out.
dialog.Text: The Courier said, you are allowed to pass. But if you want to walk out, you need to prove that you are not poor and can survive in the Zone. Do you have 500 rubles at least?

dialog.Title: I'm working for the Courier.
dialog.Text: If so, you need to work harder. He tells me himself, who can pass and who can not. And he never mentioned you.

dialog.Title: I need to leave the city.
dialog.Text: You can't. Only the Courier's people are allowed to pass through these gates. And I don't remember you among his workers.

dialog.Title: I have a mail from the Courier.
dialog.Text: Great. Give it to me.

dialog.Title: I'm here to find Temon.
dialog.Text: Ah, that creepy scary imbecile. He's working for Courier now. I haven't seen him for a while. I think he got killed somewhere.

dialog.Title: Scary creepy imbecile.|| Why do you call him like that?
dialog.Text: Ah, he was very nervous. I told him, that I can let him out of the city only if he works for the Courier. He yelled at me. Tryed to threaten me. Well, I kicked his ass. Then he got the Courier's job and left. Imbecile.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Hello, stalker, now tell why you came here.

dialog.Title: I am from Dibenko.|Good day. I need a report for Sgt. Dibenko. I am from him.
dialog.Text: Good, good. If you're from Dibenko, then listen. Tell this jerk, that if more supplies will not be sent here, we shall all be at least six feet under.

dialog.Title: Why? It seems quiet to me.
dialog.Text: It is now quiet, that's true. But I saw a herd of mutants at night. They didn't attack yet, but I don't know how much time we have. Maybe they're still decide with what sauce we would better be as a supper.

dialog.Title: Got it.
dialog.Text: Aha. And… Well… You may skip the "jerk" part... That's a minor, unimportant detail.

dialog.Title: I'm here to take the vacuum tube.
dialog.Text: It's about time.The radio is on the table, next to yonder fellow, which stands against the wall. Take the tube. When you'll visit all posts, go to Basmach, he will change broken tubes for new ones. Don't forget to bring me a new tube. Do not install it by yourself, you need a special skill here.

dialog.Title: I'm from Dibenko.|I need a field report for Sgt. Dibenko. I am from him.
dialog.Text: Somehow we still hold it. So far so good. As long as they do not forget about supplies.

dialog.Title: Tatar sent me.
dialog.Text: Here are new reports. It's a military secret, for god's sake, so keep it quiet.

dialog.Title: I need out.
dialog.Text: You helped Sanek the Skilled... I can let you pass, but the mutants will eat you in five meters behind these gates. You'll be dead and be free and I'll face the grand long paper work. There will be many explanations, apologies, the tribunal maybe... You know. But, let's say, 500 rubles partly cover these risks.

dialog.Title: I need out.
dialog.Text: You may pass... But don't tell anyone that I've let you.

dialog.Title: Consider his head already on a dish.
dialog.Text: Stop joking around. There is one crazy cook near Lubech... We call him "Gourmet", because he loves mutants and knows how to cook them. But I don't understand such perversions.

dialog.Title: Is there other work for me?
dialog.Text: There is one work, for a steep stalker like you. They saw a wild boar outside the city, nearby. They say, it heading to the city. Walk around, find this pig and feed it with bullets.

dialog.Title: There is huge number of dogs near the stadium.
dialog.Text: Not good. It's fine for your kind though. More dog heads to loot. I've heard other guards saw the Trapper behind the gate. It's a famous dog specialist, but it seems his knowledge doesn't help him anymore... Why is so many of these creatures around lately? There is no end to them. Inside, outside and now the stadium... Soon they will eat us all. And will not choke!

dialog.Title: You were right, I found the ammo.
dialog.Text: See, we both win. Listen, I've been ordered to shoot these dogs and send samples to our scientists. But they need large bitches, you know, not these little puppies which runs around the neighborhood. I've seen a couple of big ones in the yard. We need to pass the samples to the doctor Zinoviev. He works in the old police building. Can you do it?

dialog.Title: Take them.
dialog.Text: Thanks, pal. Here is your money.

dialog.Title: 700 rubles? No problem.
dialog.Text: You need a legend... I heard rumors that the stadium is noisy lately. You check it and tell me what is happening there. If someone asked -- I hired you for the job.

dialog.Title: Well... Tell me.|| I hope there is more than one pack!
dialog.Text: The abandon base, to there Blacksmith had sent you for sure, was the military base for some time. There are lot of supplies left. Blacksmith tells that there is nothing there. But he himself sold a lot of goods from this base.

dialog.Title: Here are dog ears.
dialog.Text: Great! Give them to me.

dialog.Title: I need to leave the city.
dialog.Text: Forget about it. Behind these gates there are more beasts than you can count... Only loonies go there: scientists, mercenaries, illegal stalkers, bandits... Dibenko will tear my head off, if I let you through.

dialog.Title: I brought the vacuum tube.
dialog.Text: Give it to me. We have no communication here. It's not right at all.

dialog.Title: I'll be back later.
dialog.Text: Okay, but the gates stay closed.

dialog.Title: You may take the ammo back.|Sorry, if I offended you. Here, take the ammo back.
dialog.Text: Thank you, buddy! Now I'll tell you a secret as promised. The abandon base, to there Blacksmith had sent you for sure, was the military base for some time. There are lot of supplies left. Blacksmith tells that there is nothing there. But he himself sold a lot of goods from this base.

dialog.Title: Got it. I'll search more closely.
Blacksmith said you'll give me ammo.
dialog.Text: Yes, I still don't have time to shoot these creatures. Hey, leave it to me, and, in return, I'll tell where you can find even more ammo. Blacksmith himself takes the ammo there.

dialog.Title: Ok...
dialog.Text: Be smart, stalker. Believe me, you don't want to go there.

dialog.Title: I need to leave the city...
dialog.Text: I heard you helped Sanek the Skilled... Look, I can let you through, but the mutants will eat you in five meters behind these gates. You'll be dead and be free and I'll face the grand long paper work. There will be many explanations, apologies, the tribunal maybe... You know. But, let's say, 700 rubles partly cover these risks.

dialog.Title: Dibenko let me...
dialog.Text: Yes? I didn't hear anything about it. But we have serious radio problems here. So maybe he send orders to another post.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
What do you want?

dialog.Title: Are you a sentry here?
dialog.Text: Yep, it's me. The man who has to deal with everything. First. that accident with the trucks, then the train bumpted into an anomaly, what a crazy day! And I'm sick and tired of damn mutants!

dialog.Title: Mutants?
dialog.Text: Mutant rats. As big as cats. Haven't you seen 'em? I wouldn't believe either, hadn't I seen 'em myself. Listen, I got an idea...what if you kill at least couple of rats for me? Do a favor, man, I'll pay you back.

dialog.Title: I have some questions about the accident.
dialog.Text: Speak up, man. Do it quickly, have no time for small talks.

dialog.Title: What happened to the trucks?
dialog.Text: I saw a bright flash then heard terrible rumble. When I went out I saw a real mess. Fire, smoke, people screaming and bustling.

dialog.Title: I'm leaving.
dialog.Text: Good luck.

dialog.Title: Where were people going?
dialog.Text: There's only one road and it leads to Lyubech, don't ya know? Tracks deliver food, equipment and medications there almost every day. But what really surprises me is that the track was transporting civilians. That's weird.

dialog.Title: Did anyone survive?
dialog.Text: Sure...but most of 'em died. Not everybody are that lucky.

dialog.Title: I'm wounded, need help.
dialog.Text: The doctor near here. Can you walk to him by yourself? You certainly look like you can. Don't bother me with your scratches! You're not the only one who is wounded...

dialog.Title: I shot the rats.
dialog.Text: You did? Appticiate that. To be honest, didn't expect you'd cope with it. No offence. Easier say then do, if you know what I mean. Thanks again.

dialog.Title: My pleasure...
dialog.Text: Listen my advice, find Charon the gaffer. He will help you get to Lubech on a handcar. It was possible to reach the city on foot, but now, with all these mutants and anomalies, I would not recommend to walk alone. Of course, you can stay here. But someone will come for this truck. Believe me, you don't want to meet the military.

dialog.Title: My pleasure...
dialog.Text: Listen my advice, find Charon the gaffer. He will help you get to Lubech by a handcar. It was possible to reach the city on foot, but now, with all these mutants and anomalies, I would not recommend you walk alone. Of course, you can stay here. But someone will come for this truck. Believe me, you don't want to meet the military.

dialog.Title: Where I can find Charon?
dialog.Text: Charon is living in the hut, near the north tunnel. Find the marsh. You won't miss it. Do not step into the water. Some years ago we wouldn't go to the hut and call him from the shore -- Charon used to come out himself. But he is cloth-eared now, therefore the shout is useless.

dialog.Title: Where I can find Charon?
dialog.Text: Charon is living in the hut, near the north tunnel. Find the marsh. You won't miss it. Do not step into the water. Some years ago we wouldn't go to the hut and call him from the shore -- Charon used to come out himself. But he is cloth-eared now, therefore the shout is useless.

dialog.Title: Charon is dead.
dialog.Text: Dead? You got to be kidding me, man! Are you sure? Such a nice fella he was... Listen to me, you'd better hurry up and leave this place. Find a man named Kochegarov near the north tunnel, he'll take you to Liubech. When you reach the place, find Blacksmith and Kolya Kisliy. They'll help you with everything.

dialog.Title: I visited him already. He's dead.
dialog.Text: What a loss... I had a bad feeling, but I didn't think everything will turn out like this. It's a pity, he was a good man. Damn the mutants! Look... The situation has not changed. Each extra hour you stay here can turn into a new disaster. You are not the only one who is risking. You still can leave unnoticed, before all the noise around the accident will cease. But when the soldiers will arrive... Let's just say, all possible exits will be closed by that time. There is a handcar near my station. Take it. Say to Kochegarov, I allow you to use it. Go to Lubech. Don't stay here for long. And after you'll get to Lubech, find Blacksmith. He is well-known and respected man among stalkers. He will help you.

dialog.Title: Thanks, man.
dialog.Text: Not at all. By the way, talk to people here before leaving. They may give your a job and pay well for that.

dialog.Title: Thanks.
dialog.Text: It's not for your sake, it's for me and my men. You've brought big problems here. And I try to minimize all collateral damage.

dialog.Title: I have some questions about the Zone.
dialog.Text: Sure ask away.

dialog.Title: May I stay here?
dialog.Text: Do you really think it's a good idea? The accident created kind of a scandal. The military will soon be here. It's a bad sign, man. Do you wanna be questioned? That's not very likely. I don't wanna have troubles eitther.

dialog.Title: But I did no wrong...
dialog.Text: Nobody cares, man. How did you get here? Do you have a permission to be here? No? I knew it. It's illegal so the military will either arrest you and just get rid of you, believe me.

dialog.Title: How to get out of the Zone?
dialog.Text: The sounth tunnel is blocked so you can't take a train, it bumpted into an anomaly and got stuck. You may try walking through the wood, but I woudn't do that alone. Anyway you need a guide who'll show you the safest route. The best choice now is to head for Liubech.

dialog.Title: What is the Zone?
dialog.Text: You don't know about the Zone? Seems all those precautions, which the authorities have taken to suppress the rumors, finally gave results. I naively thought, there is no human being on Earth, who knows nothing of the Zone. However, this is not my thing -- to gab about it. Any scientist or hunter will talk about the Zone with great pleasure. They usually like to discuss it, to build theories of its origins, and to scare or cheer up newbies. Ask stalkers if you want to know more. You can find them in Lubech. And a note from me: the Zone is a world of wealth and wonders, but it does not forgive mistakes. There is no more richer and more dangerous place in the world.

dialog.Title: Why should I go to Liubech?
dialog.Text: Because all roads lead to Liubech. Do you wanna make a fortune or get a job? Do you need food, weapon or artifacts? Do you wanna get out of here? Go to Liubech.

dialog.Title: Remind, who can help me?
dialog.Text: Charon the gaffer. He will help you get to Lubech on a handcar. It was possible to reach the city on foot, but now, with all these mutants and anomalies, I would not recommend to walk alone. Of course, you can stay here. But someone will come for this truck. Believe me, you don't want to meet the military.

dialog.Title: I have questions...
dialog.Text: No time to twaddle. Rat mutants are near. We need to banish beasts until they became even more...

dialog.Title: You said someting about a train...
dialog.Text: The military used the train to deliver supplies to Luybech. Usual routine had it been until recently. See that flame in front of the train? That's an anomaly, appeared from nowhere and damaged our roadway. You'd better stay away from it!

dialog.Title: I'm starving
dialog.Text: You can always buy food for money. But if you're broke, go and get some on your own. You'll love hunting.

dialog.Title: Hunting?
dialog.Text: Kill as many beasts as you want. All you need is to make a fire and fry meat well. You'll like it, I'm sure. To make a fire you'll need to collect wood and buy some matches.

dialog.Title: I think I'll try.
dialog.Text: Listen, I heard there are mutant dogs in the square Б2-3. They must have slipped in through the hole in the fence. Their meat is damn good if roasted! Listen, if you go hunting, get me some dog meat. You'll see, I''ll return the favor!

dialog.Title: OK. I'll get you some meat.
dialog.Text: Deal! Remember, they're mutants, vicious creatures! Take your eye off them and you're dead! Stay sharp!

dialog.Title: OK. I''ll bring some
dialog.Text: Still waiting for meat!

dialog.Title: I brought you meat.
dialog.Text: Much obliged! Didn't expect you'd be so good at hunting. You did well. Here, take this shot-gun. Leaves much to be desired but for the short haul, that'll be enough. Later you may find somehing better.

dialog.Title: Я подумаю
dialog.Text: Ну, подумай.

dialog.Title: Спасибо
dialog.Text: На здоровье!

dialog.Title: Я принесу мясо
dialog.Text: Отлично! Только ты помни, что здесь не какие-то дворовые шавки, а мутанты! Чуть зазеваешься и порвут, как Тузик грелку! Аккуратней там!

dialog.Title: Как собирать артефакты?
dialog.Text: Хм. Да ты, как я погляжу, шустрый малый! Только прибыл в Зону, а уже за артефактами собрался! Молодец! Сразу чувствуется, что из тебя стоящий сталкер выйдет! Ну, слушай. Артефакты, это порождение аномалий. Следовательно, и искать их нужно в аномалиях. Сразу предупреждаю, дело это опасное! Делаешь так -- находишь аномалию, потихонечку к ней приближаешься, и внимательно смотришь в самый её центр. Если видишь, что там находится какой-то необычный объект, это и есть артефакт. И вот ещё что -- не все аномалии видны. Когда приближаешься к подозрительному участку, бросай перед собой камень. Аномалия среагирует на попавший в неё предмет и ты её увидишь. А вообще, я бы тебе не советовал сразу начать зарабатывать на добыче артефактов в Зоне. Это правда очень непростое и опасно дело! Пообвыкнись, поизучай Зону, накопи опыта, а уже потом и за артефакты принимайся. В Зоне есть уйма возможностей заработывать не только добычей артефактов.

dialog.Title: Как достать артефакт из аномалии?
dialog.Text: Это самое сложное и опасное! Надо как можно быстрее проскочить через аномалию и успеть схватить артефакт. Главное, не замешкаться! Чуть замешкаешься, считай, что ты труп! Перед походом за артефактами, обязательно запасись медикаментами – аптечками, бинтами, антидотами и так далее. Без них лучше даже не пытаться в некоторые аномалии лезть. Но это ещё не всё. Важно сохранить добытый артефакт! Понимаешь, дело в том, что артефакты, находясь вне аномалий, очень быстро теряют свои свойства. Ну, а кому нужен простой булыжник? Никому. Вот и получается, что чем меньше остаётся свойств в артефакте, тем дешевле его можно продать.

dialog.Title: И как быть?
dialog.Text: Как быть? Использовать для хранения артефактов специальный контейнер. Он так и называется – контейнер для хранения и транспортировки артефактов. Его учёные придумали. Ну, а потом уже и здешние сталкеры научились его собирать практически из подручных материалов. Сам-то контейнер состоит из двух частей – стабилизирующей жидкости и ёмкости, которая этой жидкостью заполняется. Чтобы сделать контейнер и "стабраствор" необходимы разные ингредиенты. О них ты узнаешь, когда изучишь инструкцию по сборке контейнера. А пока запомни вот ещё что – при каждом открытии контейнера, "стабраствор" из него быстро испаряется. Поэтому, контейнер можно использовать только до тех пор, пока в нём есть "стабраствор". Как только он заканчивается, толку от контейнера - ноль. Так что следи внимательно за тем, сколько осталось "открываний" у контейнера.

dialog.Title: Понял
dialog.Text: Да, вот ещё что забыл сказать. В полевых условиях, так сказать, собрать можно только контейнер на хранение одного артефакта. Для создания контейнера, в котором можно одновременно хранить несколько артефактов, нужны специальные условия и инструмент. А в Зоне подобное есть только у учёных. Собственно у них можно достать такой контейнер, если знать, с кем договориться. Но стоит такой контейнер не дёшево!

dialog.Title: Запомню
dialog.Text: Кстати, хочешь попробовать артефакт добыть? Я могу дать тебе контейнер. Но услуга за услугу -- я тебе контейнер, а ты мне артефакт добытый. Мне прибыток небольшой, а тебе польза – научишься артефакты собирать.Тут недалеко есть аномалии. Справа от сломавшейся электрички, в квадрате А2-2. Только ты в аномалию, которая прямо перед локомотивом стоит не лезь! Убьёт! Ну что, по рукам?

dialog.Title: Согласен
dialog.Text: Отлично. Держи контейнер.

dialog.Title: Согласен
dialog.Text: Отлично. Держи контейнер. И вот, возьми ещё аптечку. Всё-таки первый раз в аномалию полезешь. Может пригодиться. Ты только в аномалию, которая прямо перед электричкой находится не лезь! Убьёт зараза такая! Там справа от электрички есть аномалии. Они как зеленоватый туман выглядят. Вот в них, вроде, не так опасно лезть.

dialog.Title: Я принёс артефакт
dialog.Text: Ну, поздравляю с первым добытым артефактом! Молодчина! Оставь себе контейнер в подарок от меня. Толковый сталкер из тебя выйдет!

dialog.Title: Новости есть?
dialog.Text: Новости? Да в Зоне каждый час какие-нибудь новости появляются! Ты почитай Доску Объявлений, там все важные новости и найдёшь.

dialog.Title: Доску объявлений?
dialog.Text: Удивлён? Честно говоря, я тоже поначалу не очень улавливал, зачем её сталкеры во всех ключевых местах Зоны расставили. Однако, теперь я сам ей постоянно пользуюсь! Очень удобная штука оказалась! На ней можно узнать о том, где и как заработать, кто какой товар продаёт или покупает и, что важно – можно самому объявление разместить. Например, назначить награду за голову своего обидчика.

dialog.Title: Как это?
dialog.Text: Как? Да очень просто! Вот, например, какой-нибудь бандит пальнул в тебя и поранил. Отвечать тем же? Но тогда испортишь отношение к себе со стороны других сталкеров. Ведь в Зоне подобное поведение не приветствуется. Что делать? А вот что. Идёшь к Доске Объявлений и размещаешь на ней объявление с указанием имени обидчика и вознаграждения за отмщение. И будь уверен, очень скоро накажут мерзавца! Кстати, можешь и сам, разыскивая и наказывая обидчиков других сталкеров, неплохо подзаработать. Благородное и одновременно прибыльное это дело, скажу я тебе! Такие объявления в разделе "Охота" вывешиваются.

dialog.Title: Удобно
dialog.Text: Ещё как! А если, например, появляется у тебя необходимость продать что-то или наоборот купить, то это в разделе Торговля находится. Подходишь к Доске, выбираешь нужную тебе вещь, смотришь, где она выложена на продажу, сколько стоит, если всё устраивает, то прямо тут же и оплачиваешь. Затем спокойно идёшь и забираешь её в том Хранилище, в котором она была выложена на продажу. Хранилища, это такие заведения в Зоне, что-то типа камер хранений. В них сталкеры свой хабар оставляют, чтобы лишний вес на себе не таскать. Ну, а если сам продать что-то решишь, то двигаешь в любое Хранилище, выкладываешь свою вещь на продажу и всё – информация о ней на всех Досках в Зоне появится. Останется только дождаться, когда кто-то её купит и забрать деньги из того же Хранилища.

dialog.Title: Лихо!
dialog.Text: Ха! Я же говорю, очень нужная вещь оказалась эта Доска Объявлений. Кстати, на ней сталкеры даже карту расположения всех Зон разместили! Причём с пояснениями, из какой, в какую и как быстрее в нужную Зону добраться можно. Так что, настоятельно рекомендую тебе изучить Доску Объявлений. Вон она стоит, на пироне у ограждения.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Heavy military crate, fell out from the truck.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Stiff corpse, wrapped in rags. Through holes in the boots, one can see eaten heels.

dialog.Title: Inspect the corpse.
dialog.Text: It seems this was Charon. There are visible traces on the neck... Looks like long and thin fingers. Charon died in his sleep from asphyxiation. And then the body were pulled down from the sofa to the floor, where it was gobbled by the rats.

dialog.Title: Inspect the corpse.
dialog.Text: There are visible traces on the neck... Looks like long and thin fingers. The man died in his sleep from asphyxiation. And then the body were pulled down from the sofa to the floor, where it was gobbled by the rats...

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
What do you want?

dialog.Title: Is it your draisine?
dialog.Text: Nope. It's Charon's. He lives in a small hut. I'm just covering him while he's busy. I can't give you a ride without sentry's permission. Talk to him first.

dialog.Title: Who is Charon?
dialog.Text: Local hermit. Talk to the station sentry. He and Charon are some kind of buddies. Often divide profits together.

dialog.Title: Charon is dead.
dialog.Text: Damn... Mutants gobbled him too? Damn these shit-rats... Listen, if you need the handcar, you should talk to the station sentry. If he allows you to rent it, I won't mind.

dialog.Title: Charon is dead.
dialog.Text: Damn... Mutants gobbled him too? Damn these shit-rats... Listen, if you need the handcar, you should talk to the station sentry. If he allows you to rent it, I won't mind.

dialog.Title: The sentry allowed me to use the draisine.
dialog.Text: Didn't he mention the"Teleportation" anomaly? It was seen on the way right after the tunnel. Are you sure you wanna go this way? There is another way through the wood.

dialog.Title: Yes. Let's get going!
dialog.Text: I warned you anyway.

dialog.Title: Take me to Liubech.
dialog.Text: Are you sure?

dialog.Title: I found the knife.
dialog.Text: Wow! Thanks, man!

dialog.Title: Anytime.
dialog.Text: Now I'm ready to sho you the way. Do you still wanna go to Liubech?

dialog.Title: Not now.
dialog.Text: Got it. Let me know when you're ready.

dialog.Title: Charon is dead.
dialog.Text: Dead?! What a loss...Our days are numbered, I'm telling you. What are you doing here? You need a draisine, right? Ask the sentry at the station. If he allows you to use it, I'll give you a ride.

dialog.Title: Through the wood?
dialog.Text: Sure, we can go on foot. Although it's also dangerous. Not many people know the safe route. Charon did. But now he's dead...

dialog.Title: Do you know the route?
dialog.Text: Of course! But before I show you the way, do me a little favor. Charon was my good friend and now I miss him a lot. Once he gave me a knife he made himself. I gambled the knife away. It must be somewhere in Charon's house or nearby. Find it and bring back to me. And then I'll show you the way to Liubech. Deal?

dialog.Title: No way! Go and get it yourself.
May we talk?
dialog.Text: Sorry, man. I don't talk to strangers.
Bloody mutants...

dialog.Title: What happened?
dialog.Text: Rats...Bloody rats caught us with pants down! Tolyan and I were watching the military last night. Silently, cautiously... Then rats came out of nowhere and gave us away. Bloody soldiers opened fire...Tolyan was shot dead...I'm here

dialog.Title: I'm sorry.
dialog.Text: I want those bloody bastards to be dead as well! Rats, I mean...I wish I could kill 'em all, but I'm wounded now and I left the pistol in Tolyan's backpack.

dialog.Title: What about the soldiers?
dialog.Text: They're gone for now. But surely they'll be back again to see about the accident. I must have left earlier but now I wanna get back at the rats. Hadn't they come, Tolyan could be here with us...

dialog.Title: I'll see what I can do.
I killed the rats...
dialog.Text: Thanks... As soon as I get better, I'll bury Tolyan myself before I leave. You found his pistol? Take it, you deserve it. I have nothing to pay you for your help anyway. But you know... You can sell the rat tails. The local trader is paying a good price for them. The young rats tails doesn't interest him, but someone saw the large beasts to the north-east of here. Their tails would be just right size.

dialog.Title: Ok thanks, I'll check it out…
dialog.Text: If you are bitten by rats, don't forget to talk to the doctor. You can always buy additional ammo from the trader over there. And here is the last tip: even the most reliable equipment deteriorates over time. If you need repairs, and you haven't the repair skills, talk to the repairman.

dialog.Title: Do you also want to get rid of the rats?
dialog.Text: Sure. They didn't use to attack so close to the safe zone! Now there are everywhere.

dialog.Title: I can shoot more. It's easy for me.
dialog.Text: Thanks again... I remember when I came to this station the first time, some strange dude was here. A skilled stalker ex facte. But when I asked him for help, he ignored me. And you helped me without hesitation. I'm glad that there are still good people in our world.

dialog.Title: What happened?
dialog.Text: Shooting happened. But I won't bother you. We must protect the station first. Talk to the station sentry. He gave us shelter, so we all owe him. I too would help, but I still haven't recovered from the wound. Come back later if your still alive.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Stay away!

dialog.Title: I'm leaving...
dialog.Text: Get away!

dialog.Title: What happened?
dialog.Text: You were on that truck too, right? Listen, man...It's not my fault, OK? I didn't ask what was on the truck, you never ask questions when you're given orders. Only when the accident happened I realize our cargo was people. Don't ask me why we had to deliver people to the Zone. I've no idea! I..I wish I could just forget all that shit.

dialog.Title: Where are other soldiers?
dialog.Text: Don't know! When I came round nobody was alive. All I know that my people would have never left me here. I'll wait for them...They'll come back I'm sure...

dialog.Title: Where were you taking those people?
But WHAT happened to the truck?
dialog.Text: I said I don't know! What else do you want me to say? Piss off, man! Listen, I'm sure you need a weapon, right? So take one from the box behind me and shut up!

dialog.Title: I got a weapon.
dialog.Text: Don't come near me!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
What do you need?

dialog.Title: You're buying rat tails?
dialog.Text: Maybe. You have some?

dialog.Title: No.
dialog.Text: So why you ask? Do you know what happens with stalkers, who ask stupid questions?

dialog.Title: I have some.
dialog.Text: Let me see... It looks fine to me.

dialog.Title: You need it?
dialog.Text: Yes, I'll buy.

dialog.Title: Why do you buy tails?
dialog.Text: I roast and eat them! It's a joke... Newbie?

dialog.Title: How did you know?
dialog.Text: You ask stupid questions. If you arrived on the truck, which burns nearby, I don't envy you. You've got out of the frying pan, but right into the f... I mean "into the fire". Not a good time to jump over perimeter fence.

dialog.Title: Why?
dialog.Text: Mutants almost reached the perimeter. And on the other hand -- there is always someone who sneaks into the Zone. The military is getting nervous. It will all end badly. Here is a good piece of advice: don't stay here more than you need.

dialog.Title: Thanks.
dialog.Text: Don't thank me. The soldiers will interrogate the locals, scour tunnels and spoil my trade. I could hand you over to them, for a fee, but we don't screw newbies. On the other hand...

dialog.Title: Need more tails?
dialog.Text: Yes. But if I was you, I would run as far away as I could. Give me the tail and naff off.

dialog.Title: What?
dialog.Text: ...Some dude came here yesterday. He didn't barter with me, but talk to my neighbor about some ammunition. I saw his backpack. There was an art-safe, a container for safely storing artefact. He probably was a courier or a transporter and was going to ferry some goods across the border... I will hand him over for sure.

dialog.Title: I'm leaving now.
dialog.Text: Wait. I saw you go to the hut, in the swamp.

dialog.Title: So what?
dialog.Text: You saw bald rats or brownies there? Let me put it straight. Do you have a rat tail? Bald rat tail? I can buy it.

dialog.Title: I haven't, but I can get it.
I found the tail.
dialog.Text: Let me see... It looks fine to me.

dialog.Title: Take it.
dialog.Text: Good. Here is your money.

dialog.Title: No and I don't have time.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Look at you, man! You alright?

dialog.Title: I need to go now...
dialog.Text: That's right! The perimeter security probably already know about the train wreck. Very soon there will be more soldiers than trees in the forest turning up here!

dialog.Title: Where am I? What happened?
dialog.Text: You're alive, man. That's the most important. Others weren't that lucky. Do you remember anything? Where were the trucks heading for?

dialog.Title: To Liubech.
dialog.Text: I see... The military go there almost every day. You're not one of them, am I right? You look more like a tourist. Listen, there is one more survived, a soldier sitting over the fire. Talk to him carefully, he doesn't seem very friendly. Then get to the station. It's not far from here. The sentry will help you.

dialog.Title: Do you know a cause of the truck wreck?
dialog.Text: ...Uh... Good question... And a good food for thought. I told you, it was "bang!" Maybe a sabotage? I think, something hit the bridge... Listen, if you're all right, can you ask the people if anyone needs help?

dialog.Title: What about you?
dialog.Text: Me? No I'm good thanks. I'm not from your truck, I would just scare them. I see a soldier who was riding on your truck, he may arrest me for nothing... The station is nearby. At the station, there is a repairmen and a doctor... If something happens, you can call them. They probably already know about the crash. The entire region must know... The "bang" was loud enough.

dialog.Title: Thanks man.
dialog.Text: Not at all. Oh, yea, almost forgot. If you're hungry, buy something at the station. Go! I'll wait stay here.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Yes, I need to go outside.
Wait, I still have a business here.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Yes, I need to go outside.
Wait, I still have a business here.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Do you have heads? I mean, puppies heads. 10 pieces, I do not take less.

dialog.Title: Why you need them?
dialog.Text: I have a business, souvenirs, ashtrays... You only need to know that I pay money for them. I take lots by 10 pieces. But we need only the heads of puppies, they have appropriate dimensions.

dialog.Title: I brought you heads.
dialog.Text: Give them to me, I'll check the size.

dialog.Title: У меня пара вопросов.
dialog.Text: Давай быстрее.

dialog.Title: Слышал про крушение грузовиков?
dialog.Text: Каких грузовиков? Ничего не слышал. Грузовики -- редкость. Привозят припасы для военных. Если что-то с ним не так -- это их забота. Не моя.

dialog.Title: Как выбраться из Зоны?
dialog.Text: Выбраться? Зачем? Я по ту сторону -- никто. А здесь у меня своя торговля, свой бизнес. Я еще разбогатею, вот увидишь. Головы псин неси, не пожалеешь.

dialog.Title: Как же передаешь товар наружу?
dialog.Text: У барыг своя сеть. Отдаю кому надо, получаю деньги. Остальное -- не твое дело.

dialog.Title: Как ты попал в Зону?
dialog.Text: Пришел пешком. Собрал деньжат, заплатил одному сталкеру, он меня провел тайными тропами.

dialog.Title: Нельзя ли теми тропами обратно...?
dialog.Text: Обратно нельзя. Там плохие места, аномальные. И проводник тот давно сгинул. Наверное, сам хотел обратно пойти да не дошел...

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Come on already, no time for chit-chat. The price is same.

dialog.Title: What do you mean?
dialog.Text: You don't know? Rat tails, tails of mutated rats -- excellent material for souvenirs.

dialog.Title: Got it. I'll bring them to you.
I brought tails.
dialog.Text: Give them to me, here is your reward.

dialog.Title: Я от Палки. Товар при тебе?
dialog.Text: Ты? От Палки? Чем докажешь?

dialog.Title: Я слова знаю.
dialog.Text: Слова? Блин, где-то у меня бумажка была со словами... Кгхм... "Сегодня кристально чистое небо...".

dialog.Title: Но чей-то зов меня беспокоит...
dialog.Text: Угу. С тебя пять сотен.

dialog.Title: Но чей-то зев меня раздражает...
dialog.Text: Так. Никакого Палку не знаю. Впервые слышу. Проваливай.

dialog.Title: Но чей-то сон меня тревожит...
dialog.Text: Так. Никакого Палку не знаю. Впервые слышу. Проваливай.

dialog.Title: У меня нет денег.
dialog.Text: Тогда нафиг ты приперся? Еще словами мне этими мозги снес. Живо дуй за деньгами. Как будут -- возвращайся. Умник, блин.

dialog.Title: А не много ли? Есть 300.
dialog.Text: Блин... Ладно, давай триста.

dialog.Title: Держи.
dialog.Text: Так. Залежалась ваша партия. Впредь деньги не задерживайте. А то мигом другие покупатели найдутся. Пусть Палка свои проблемы решает сам и не светит меня кому попало. Короче... По этому делу ко мне больше не ходи. Товар оставят в парке, под скамейкой. И впредь посылки будут только там. Если вообще будут... А то с такой оплатой я еще подумаю.

dialog.Title: Держи 500.
dialog.Text: Так. Залежалась ваша партия. Впредь деньги не задерживайте. А то мигом другие покупатели найдутся. Пусть Палка свои проблемы решает сам и не светит меня кому попало. Короче... По этому делу ко мне больше не ходи. Товар оставят в парке, под скамейкой. И впредь посылки будут только там. Если вообще будут... А то с такой оплатой я еще подумаю.

dialog.Title: Ну и...?
dialog.Text: Так. Залежалась ваша партия. Впредь деньги не задерживайте. А то мигом другие покупатели найдутся.

dialog.Title: Не кипиши. Там проблемы с военными.
dialog.Text: Пусть Палка свои проблемы решает и не светит меня кому попало. Короче... По этому делу ко мне больше не ходи. Товар оставят в парке, под скамейкой. И впредь посылки будут только там. Если вообще будут... А то с такой оплатой я еще подумаю.

dialog.Title: Зачем тебе мясо?
dialog.Text: Как зачем? Затем же, зачем и всем -- есть его! Охотник из меня аховый, а вот барахлишко по заброшенным домам поискать, это я умею! Тут на днях подфартило -- нарыл целый ящик патронов 9х18! Правда они малость отсыревшие... Но это лучше чем совсем без патронов! Я бы их себе все оставил, но я всё равно не охочусь... А голод не тётка -- пирожка не подсунет! Короче, ты мне два куска сырого мяса, а я тебе коробку патронов. Идёт?

dialog.Title: Принёс мясо
dialog.Text: Ну, показывай!

dialog.Title: Держи
dialog.Text: Отлично! Держи патроны. Если ещё понадобятся, то у меня этого добра пока хватает! Только мясо успевай таскать! Ха-ха!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Hi. If you about a sale of mutant parts, talk to my friends. I don't trade. I help to carry the goods and I watch for it, while they in the city.

dialog.Title: Why you need them?
dialog.Text: I have a business, souvenirs, ashtrays... You only need to know that I pay money for them. I take lots by 10 pieces. But we need only the heads of puppies, they have appropriate dimensions.

dialog.Title: I brought you heads.
dialog.Text: Give them to me, I'll check the size.

dialog.Title: Расскажи про падение вертолета.
dialog.Text: Тут было целое шоу! Ни с того, ни с сего, начал вращаться, задымил, потом рухнул. Я такое только в детстве в кино видел... Один пилот выжил! Но Белые -- психи из дальней деревни -- выволокли беднягу из кабины и увели с собой.

dialog.Title: Куда?
dialog.Text: Откуда же я знаю. К себе в деревню, наверное. Не повезло пилоту, отлетал свое. Забудь про него. Его уже напичкали наркотиками, обратили в свою веру, отрубили руки-ноги, достали внутренние органы, съели или скормили ему же... Что-то одно наверняка, а может все сразу, в любом порядке. Но если решишь продолжить поиски, обратись к Гурману. Он покажет дорогу в места, где эти отморозки живут. Он с ними даже дела вел. Но Гурман сам с головой не дружит, чему тут удивляться...

dialog.Title: А где Гурман живет?
dialog.Text: Тебе нужно на север. В северо-восточный угол квадрата Ж10.

dialog.Title: Есть пара вопросов.
dialog.Text: Давай быстрее.

dialog.Title: Кто такие Белые?
dialog.Text: Фанатики. В основном коренные. Впрочем, слышал, пришлых тоже принимают... Поклоняются аномалиям, проводят дикие ритуалы, жрут всякую гадость: тараканов, мышей, части мутантов... Не брезгуют каннибализмом. Они живут за болотом, на северо-востоке. Точнее сказать не могу. Спроси Гурмана.

dialog.Title: Белые сбили вертолет?
dialog.Text: Вряд ли. Но похоже они знали, что вертолет упадет здесь. Зона для Белых -- дом родной. Они появление и движение аномалий предсказывают всяко точнее, чем метеорологи погоду. Могли оказаться в нужном месте в нужное время не случайно.

dialog.Title: Что знаешь про упавший вертолет?
dialog.Text: Тут было целое шоу! Ни с того, ни с сего, начал вращаться, задымил, потом рухнул. Я такое только в детстве в кино видел... Один пилот выжил! Но Белые -- психи из дальней деревни -- выволокли беднягу из кабины и увели с собой.

dialog.Title: Что знаешь про упавший вертолет?
dialog.Text: Только я про него и знаю. Мои друзья были в городе, остальные также подошли позднее. Поэтому я один видел падение.

dialog.Title: Что случилось? Где пилот?
dialog.Text: Услуга за услугу. Тебе нужна информация, мне нужны мои витамины.

dialog.Title: Какие витамины?
dialog.Text: Из супермаркета. Я без них жить не могу. Есть неподалеку один заброшенный супермаркет. В юго-восточном углу квадрата Ж11. Я знаю, что витамины там были... до нашествия мутантов. Но сейчас туда без приличного ружья не пробраться. Ты похож на человека, который может за себя постоять. Принесешь мне мои витамины, расскажу все что видел.

dialog.Title: Пилот мог попасть в беду.
dialog.Text: Это точно... Но знаешь, сталкер, в чем отличие между салагой и старожилом Зоны? Салага рвется геройствовать, ему все время нужно что-то делать, кого-то спасать... Он готов бегать с поручениями за копейки или за идею. Уверен, тебя попросили найти этого парня. И едва ли обещали достойную награду. Пилот тебе не друг и не родственник. Ты его даже не знаешь. Но готов из кожи вон вылезти, только бы узнать больше о Зоне или убить больше местных страшил. Я предлагаю тебе то же самое: сходить с поручением, посмотреть на мутантов.

dialog.Title: Мне не нравится твой тон.
dialog.Text: Старожилы Зоны, напротив, никуда не торопятся. Они живут здесь. Выживают. Они знают цену информации. Они не работают за копейки, но берегут их и не забывают подсчитывать.

dialog.Title: Я могу заплатить тебе.
dialog.Text: Можешь. Но мне нужны витамины. А тебе нужна информация. Прости, сталкер, я не стану упускать такой шанс.

dialog.Title: Я принес тебе витамины.
dialog.Text: О, да. Мои витамины...

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Yes, I need to go outside.
Wait, I still have a business here.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Yes, I need to go outside.
Wait, I still have a business here.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Hello, young man. Can you spare some coin to help an old stalker to see another day or two? I may tell you a secret...

dialog.Title: Here 10 rubles.
dialog.Text: Many thanks. Such kindness is a rare sight in the Zone. Be kind to another and the Zone won't offend you. On the contrary, you will be rewarded. There are lot of strange places with strange things, but not all of them are a sake of the devil. Some things are gifts of the Zone. The benefit. You just have to know where to look. Take these houses for example. The Zone gave them new life, you know. The old TV's sets? They're not human creations, not anymore. They're alive like trees or flowers. You get parts from them - it's a grass or a branch you break. And the next day TV became whole, unbroken. Because the Zone grows it up... See the point? It's easy money. You'll bring parts from three TV sets and I'll share with you the profit. Agree?

dialog.Title: Are you drunk, stalker?|You're better wraped it up with a booze. Because you talk nonsense.
dialog.Text: You offended me, kid. I told you the secret, with all the heart, but you... Eh, youth... And I wanted you to take in a share.

dialog.Title: I'll go to have a look at this miracle.
Here are radio parts.
dialog.Text: Great. I already agreed about everything, and I have your share right here. Give me the parts.

dialog.Title: Do you know other fruitful places?
dialog.Text: The wardrobe. Long time ago I hid there a padded jacket. Well... a "hid" is a strong word. More like "forgot". I hung up it in a wardrobe while went outside to look around, but then I've tried to return I saw that the house has changed. I found myself in completely different interior, no padded jacket or the wardrobe. The Zone confused me. Then, two days after, my companions come to me with my a jacket. "Yours?", they asked. "Mine!" was my answer. They: "And this one?" I looked: all patches, all holes on a place. Even dirt lies in identical layers. Suddenly I realized. My jacket became a part of the Zone, it took root and now yields the fruits, the same padded jackets. So I've started to sell it. But as you see, I don't go further the station anymore. If you'll find and bring me a padded jacket, I'll share the profit. And tomorrow you can find one more.

dialog.Title: I've found your jacket.
dialog.Text: Here is your reward. Let me have it.

dialog.Title: Do you know why Prochor is so angry?
dialog.Text: Because he is not good man. I saw he tortured an infant rat once. He said, that this animal will crawl into an anomaly and become a mutant. But is it a reason enough? There are ways. He could hide it in the train, send it outer the Zone. Why the torture? Prochor is such a cattle.

dialog.Title: Do you know other fruitful places?
Мне нужна твоя телогрейка.
dialog.Text: Ага. Штаны, шапка и мой мотоцикл. Бредом не страдай. Закончилось чудо. Вчера отправлял за ней сталкера. Тот вернулся ни с чем. Только посмеялся надо мной.

dialog.Title: Хм...
dialog.Text: Но хорошо, что ты вернулся. Тебя Кузнец спрашивал. Не забудь к нему подойти.

dialog.Title: Я нашел твою телогрейку.
dialog.Text: О! Выходит, был неурожай! Отличная новость! Быть может, телогрейки снова будут расти.

dialog.Title: ...Да, может. Не забудь ее продать.
dialog.Text: Ну, разумеется. Мне же надо на что-то жить. Чувствую, скупщики тоже обрадуются.

dialog.Title: Это шутка Кузнеца.
dialog.Text: Тсс... Я догадывался, сталкер. Я же не тупой. ...Да, он пошутил. Это жестоко. Но его торговцы мне платят. Я могу жить на эти деньги, им на потеху. Пускай. Давай так. Я сделаю вид, что этого разговора не было, и продолжу рассказывать свои истории. А ты отнесешь телогрейку Кузнецу, пока он ничего не заподозрил. Пусть снова повесит ее в шкаф.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
What do you want?

dialog.Title: Blacksmith said you have a spare gun.
dialog.Text: Blacksmith likes to talk. I have. But it's not spare. It's mine.

dialog.Title: What do you need for it?
dialog.Text: Relax. I'll give you the pistol, no charge. But you need to adjust it. There are lot of rats lurking outside the station. Try the pistol on them. And in exchange I'll ask you to find a pair of my friends, who gone missing in Zone some time ago. If you'll ever meet stalkers Mitka and Spit, help them and bring me some news from them. Without any radiocommunications I start to worry about them.

dialog.Title: Agreed.
dialog.Text: If you have questions, ask Ivy the barman. He can answer any question. You'll find his frequenters nearby: the Old Stalker and Misha the Hunter. Misha knows everything about mutants and weapons. And the Old Stalker gladly tell about Zone, about artefacts and always can give you some good advice. He'll ask few coins though or a full glass at least.

dialog.Title: Blacksmith said, you need this.
dialog.Text: Oh, this... It's Blacksmith's old joke. We have anomalies here, near the station. And one can find there a non-working artefact. We call it "the Broken Screen". It has no useful properties, and nobody will give money for it.

dialog.Title: What a stupid joke.
dialog.Text: Easy, man... I'm not a part of it. I can give you my old AMGD, Artefact Magnetic Grip Device for all the trouble. It will help you to collect arts from anomalies. How about it?

dialog.Title: Never mind...
dialog.Text: You should keep your mind sharp or you'll won't last long.

dialog.Title: The pistol is ok.
dialog.Text: What about you? A rat bite you? Even if it just a scratch on a foot, some rats can poison you and your foot will be cut off. Or few hours after there will be nothing to bury. So, here, take this medkit... One more thing. The Blacksmith looked for you for some reason...

dialog.Title: I'm looking for more ammo.
dialog.Text: I have some ammo, the poisoned ones. Local crafters learned how to make them. It's effective against mutants. I will give you some, but with a term, as usually. Local traders asked me to find a volunteer who can kill several mutant dogs in the village. These creatures are bad for business. Bring me two heads as a proof. Are you in? There will be a reward, of course. And the ammo we talked about... Pechkin will give them to you.

dialog.Title: I'm busy right now. Maybe later.
Prepare the reward. I'll do it.
I brought you the heads.
dialog.Text: Good job. As I promised, here is the reward.

dialog.Title: You did have doubts, didn't you?
What are the artefacts?
dialog.Text: I don't know much about them. Most of them has special abilities, which makes you rethink your attitude to nature laws. Some artefacts produce energy and some absorb it. Not all of these abilities are discovered, but we already found some ways to use them. The price for them is rather high. Some of them are better to be kept, as they are useful for a stalker. For example, they may enlarge your metabolism. The problem is that all artefacts are appearing in anomalies. And anomalies may easily turn you into dust. So, making money with artefacts is quite hard.

dialog.Title: So why you need them?
dialog.Text: I owe Shtaket a lot. He found a nice armor for me once. It is almost invisible and it protects you like a concrete wall. I promised to give him a great quantity of artefacts, but the anomaly got me... I heard Shtaket promised a good reward for my head. By the way, can you deliver these artefacts and tell Shtaket that I will bring more soon? It is quite hard for me to leave the station, but you seems to be a good guy.

dialog.Title: You've borrowed the PM to me...
dialog.Text: You need to adjust it. There are lot of rats lurking outside the station. Try the pistol on them.
What do you need?

dialog.Title: I've been robbed!
dialog.Text: By who? Ah. That's won't bring me anything. I'll deal with it.

dialog.Title: Sanek the Wise could help us.|Got some screens? I could speak with Shtaket for you for some screens.
dialog.Text: Nah. I can't give you anything. I have only broken screens. It's a rare artefact here.

dialog.Title: Ok. I'll see what I can do.
dialog.Text: It would be nice.

dialog.Title: I gave the arts to Shtaket|| but there is a price for your head. Sorry.
dialog.Text: Damn! That's not good...Shtaket wouldn't cancel his orders. I'll try to speak with Blacksmith. He is a reputable man. Nobody would go against him.

dialog.Title: About your debt...||Sanek The Wise said that he'd talk about you with Shtaket.
dialog.Text: The Wise? Yup. It could work. He's an old Shtaket's friend.

dialog.Title: I have some news about Mitka.
dialog.Text: Cool. I'm listening.

dialog.Title: He doesn't remember you.| He's a hunter in Tunguska. He doesn't remember you.
dialog.Text: Damn. This is sad. He has always been something like that. It's good that he's safe and sound. Take your cash. It's a bonus. And keep your gun.

dialog.Title: Thanks. It's sad story with Mitka.
dialog.Text: I think that it could be an anomaly, that boiled his brains. I need to think about it.

dialog.Title: I have some news about the Spit.
dialog.Text: Cool! I'm listening.

dialog.Title: He's a trader in the New Lands. ||Ammo-for-arts. He send his greetings to you.
dialog.Text: Ahhh. I knew that. Freakin' old pusher! My man! Take this for the good news.

dialog.Title: Repeat, what did you ask me to do?
dialog.Text: Hey? What's happening with your memory, bro? I have a couple of my friends who missed in the Zone. If you find Mitka and Spit, say hello to them. And I wanna get some messages from them.

dialog.Title: I have a couple of questions...
dialog.Text: Questions, huh?

dialog.Title: Have you heard about the bridge accident?
dialog.Text: Yup. It was the supply trucks...and this is very bad. It could be mutants, anomaly... anything!

dialog.Title: Where did the trucks heading?
dialog.Text: Trucks were heading riiight here. There was food, ammo, weapons, medicines...There are couple of military posts in two kilometers. Not long ago there were a lot of mutated bastards near Lubech. They've tried to breach in town. Then our soldiers killed almost all of them. So that's how our military posts were founded. Also I've heard, that there were some people in one truck. All dead now.

dialog.Title: Never heard about it.
dialog.Text: I don't believe in it myself. I've heard about lonely jackasses, who goes here by their own. But a whole truck!....I think this story is a bullshit!

dialog.Title: Good luck.
dialog.Text: Take care.

dialog.Title: These people are alive!
dialog.Text: What? Why do you think so?

dialog.Title: I've seen a couple of stalkers from the trucks.
dialog.Text: And how did they passed the posts?

dialog.Title: You may not believe me, but it's truth.
dialog.Text: Hm... If you say so... there are a lot of newbies here. You want to say that these men are all from those trucks?... Sergeant Dibenko was very suspicious at the day before the accident. Maybe he knows something.

dialog.Title: And where are the soldiers now?
dialog.Text: They went to the north. But some of them stayed here to protect the town. Dibenko is in the old militia post. Go find him and speak about the trucks. Say that you're stalker. He likes stalkers.

dialog.Title: Ok.
dialog.Text: But don't tell him what I've said to you. Say about Prochor's book and his notes about the trucks. Or about the passengers. He must not know about my suspicions.

dialog.Title: And what are your suspitions about?
dialog.Text: Hm... I don't like that people smuggling. Through MY railway station! And why were they transported here? For what? Experiments? Slavery... I don't like that.

dialog.Title: So. There are some pluses in this accident.
dialog.Text: I don't think so. No supplies for us and no life for these people. They wouldn't survive down there.

dialog.Title: I was there...
dialog.Text: Are you kidding me? And how did you passed the post?

dialog.Title: I don't remember...
dialog.Text: So stop telling me this bullshit.

dialog.Title: There were a lot of soldiers.
dialog.Text: Ahhh... I hope there is no conspiracy.

dialog.Title: And what was their final location?
dialog.Text: Right here. There was food, ammo, weapons, medicines...There are couple of military posts in two kilometers. Not long ago there were a lot of mutated bastards near Lubech. They've tried to breach in town. Then our soldiers killed almost all of them. So that's how our military posts were founded. Also I've heard, that there were some people in one truck. I wonder there are they now...

dialog.Title: What do you think about it?
How did you came here?
dialog.Text: Oh! It was very long ago. We were like piligrims. Me and the Blacksmith. New stalkers are stupid and don't care about anything but the cash. So they don't live long. I'm happy about it. I'm not a monster but I've tired of all of this jarheads.

dialog.Title: Do you want to leave the Zone?
dialog.Text: Here is my home. I'm good here.

dialog.Title: What do you know about Temon's death?
dialog.Text: He was lurking here just like a roach. Asking everyone about everything. Very annoying person. Then he asked me about spare gun. I told him, that it needs some fixing. But he only laughed and went to the militia station. And then we found his dead body in a trashcan. He was shot with a shot gun. Very scary wounds. We burned his corpse. There is no morgue here, so we let the fire to do all the job. And you aren't the first one who wants to know about Temon. Sanek the Wise was here not long ago. And he was very angry with Temon's death. So, always check your gun before going somewhere.

dialog.Title: Has he something interesting with him?
dialog.Text: I don't think so. If he had then marauders took it from him. Only Makarov pistol. Old and broken. I took it back.

dialog.Title: Do you want to find his murderer?
dialog.Text: I could... for Sanek. But there are a lot of jarheaded idiots, who dies like ants everyday. And there are a lot of bastards, who kills 'em. For cash, stuff, arts and even for their crazy pleasure. Don't listen to Sanek. Temon has been killed at his way from here to the militia station. Not here. Not on my territory!

dialog.Title: Why?
dialog.Text: I dunno! But that is not a secret that we burn our garbage. So, maybe someone wanted to hide his corpse and wait till we burn it. Stupid, but there are a lot of fools here.

dialog.Title: Sanek the Wise will help you...|Sanek the Wise promised to speak about you with Shtaket.
dialog.Text: That's cool. Very good!

dialog.Title: Can you help me to find Temon's murderer?
Do you want to find his murderer?
dialog.Text: I could... for Sanek. But there are a lot of jarheaded idiots, who dies like ants everyday. And there are a lot of bastards, who kills 'em. For cash, stuff, arts and even for their crazy pleasure. Don't listen to Sanek. Temon has been killed at his way from here to the militia station. Not here. Not on my territory!

dialog.Title: Why?
dialog.Text: I dunno! But that is not a secret that we burn our garbage. So, maybe someone wanted to hide his corpse and wait till we burn it. Stupid, but there are a lot of fools here.

dialog.Title: I'm new here...
dialog.Text: Did you talk to Blacksmith already?

dialog.Title: Nope...
dialog.Text: So go see him. Every newcomers must speak with Blacksmith. He's right at the entrance. Come back when you finish with him.

dialog.Title: What do you need for it?
dialog.Text: Relax. I'll give you the pistol, no charge. And in exchange I'll ask you to find a pair of my friends, who gone missing in Zone some time ago. If you'll ever meet stalkers Mitka and Spit, help them and bring me some news from them. Without any radiocommunications I start to worry about them.

dialog.Title: Agreed.
dialog.Text: If you have questions, ask Ivy the barman. He can answer any question. You'll find his frequenters nearby: the Old Stalker and Misha the Hunter. Misha knows everything about mutants and weapons. And the Old Stalker gladly tell about Zone, about artefacts and always can give you some good advice. He'll ask few coins though or a full glass at least.

dialog.Title: Who asked about me?
dialog.Text: Blacksmith. You haven't talk with him? You should. He has some business for you.

dialog.Title: The Whites want you to leave the Zone.
dialog.Text: The Whites. Most people just hate 'em. As for me...those guys are far more reliable than the military. But, you know, Zone is not a place for those who don't fit here. The White, I assume, weren't born here, right? They were one of the first comers, just like Blacksmith. They want to push other people out of here, I can understand that. But we won't leave. If needed we'll fiight but we won't leave. It's out of the question.

dialog.Title: Уважаемый, а как бы мне патронов раздобыть?
dialog.Text: Ты их че, жуешь что - ли? Мы с собой много не брали, тут и отстреливаться- то особо не от кого. У Кузнеца спроси, может у него еще остались? У меня точно нет. Если и у него нет, тогда дуй к ближайшему торговцу, один в бывшем здании милиции торгует.

dialog.Title: Куда ехал ?
dialog.Text: Сюда. Это поезд с провизией, оружием, медикаментами для солдат... Военные посты всего в паре километров, на севере. Совсем недавно тут, на вокзале, тоже было много военных, но когда мутанты ломанули в Любеч, началась операция по выдворению тварей из города. Здешние отряды рассредоточились, укрепились в старой ментовке да в ДК. Меня оставили за старшего. Кузнец мне помогает. Плохо, что припасов не будет. Начнутся заморозки — передохнем как зяблики. Я бы людей отправил к месту крушения, но там, говорят, уже все догорело да стервятники-мародеры прошлись. Еще прошел слух, в паре вагонов какие-то безбилетники ехали, но все до последнего погибли.

dialog.Title: Артур поздравляет с Новым Годом
dialog.Text: Ух, ты! Не забывает Артур своих друзей! Если его встретишь, то от меня непременно поздравь с Новым Годом! Спасибо тебе за весточку от друга, сталкер! Прими и ты мои поздравления, и небольшой Новогодний подарочек.

dialog.Title: Спасибо!
dialog.Text: Пожалуйста! А вот если отгадаешь загадку, то достанется тебе ещё небольшой приз. Слушай. У мутанта много лап, из них: две правые и две левые, две лапы спереди и столько же сзади. Сколько всего лап у мутанта?

dialog.Title: Одна
dialog.Text: Эх, ты! Не угадал! Четыре! Ха-ха!

dialog.Title: Шесть
dialog.Text: Эх, ты! Не угадал! Четыре! Ха-ха!

dialog.Title: Две
dialog.Text: Эх, ты! Не угадал! Четыре! Ха-ха!

dialog.Title: Четыре
dialog.Text: Молодец! На мякине не проведёшь! Держи подарочек - фейерверк! Повеселись в Новый Год!

dialog.Title: Восемь
dialog.Text: Эх, ты! Не угадал! Четыре! Ха-ха!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
I'm Shtaket. I know stuff about this place. What do you want? I can tell you about local pushers. Or maybe you're looking for a job?

dialog.Title: Blacksmith asked to tell you...
dialog.Text: What is it?

dialog.Title: The cargo will arrive today. All in old place.
dialog.Text: Why today? We agreed on the day after tomorrow? Is it some kind of a trick? I can't collect money so soon...

dialog.Title: Blacksmith said you'll pay me.
dialog.Text: Pay to you? To delivery man? No, bro, as you see, I myself need all the money I can get. You can have these ammo clips though. If you still aren't happy, talk to Blacksmith.

dialog.Title: I'll take them.
dialog.Text: Here.

dialog.Title: I need money.
dialog.Text: So do I. Look. I know some crazy-ass taxidermists from the feral grounds. They want a nice bear head. Big cash! Bring me one. And I'll give you the money. Except my slice, of course.

dialog.Title: No. Not this kind of money.|| I don't need any job right here.
dialog.Text: Ok, nevermind then.

dialog.Title: No problem.
dialog.Text: Kill 5...maybe 8 of them.

dialog.Title: No. Dog is a best friend!
dialog.Text: Have you seen local dogs? That bastards can nip your legs off.

dialog.Title: Here another 10 rubles.
dialog.Text: Cool!

dialog.Title: Here another 10 rubles.
dialog.Text: He-he-he...

dialog.Title: No.
dialog.Text: So, you need to go out of the building. You'll see a gate in the fence. Go through it, then to the left, then to the right. Understood?

dialog.Title: Next.
dialog.Text: Trade fraction chief has been seen in the tunnel near the Palace of Culture. I don't know the reason why this fatass is here. But he knows everyone. I think he's gonna make a great deal. Rare stuff for example.

dialog.Title: Thanks.
dialog.Text: I have some info. Cash, that's what I need. 10 rubles.

dialog.Title: I'm gonna save him.
dialog.Text: Run and help him. Or he'll got killed.

dialog.Title: Where is my cash?
dialog.Text: Here you are.

dialog.Title: Where is my money?| Give me my cash!
dialog.Text: Yeah. Take it.

dialog.Title: Have you seen a hunter?
dialog.Text: Almost forgot. A couple of hours ago I saw my good friend, who used to take other people down. If you know what I mean. He went to the railway station.

dialog.Title: Next.
dialog.Text: There is one old man, who wants to retire. In the New Land. He is selling his stuff. I've heard about him. Ice cold bastard. He's got almost every kinds of ammunition.

dialog.Title: Thank's!
dialog.Text: Hey! I can tell you one little secret.

dialog.Title: Here 15 rubles.
dialog.Text: Thank you very much.

dialog.Title: Yup! I want to ask you something.
Nope. Take the arts.|| Let it be honest and clean.
dialog.Text: Ok. You're boyscout. So, enough about this bastard. Let's do some business. I have one pal, Sanek the Wise. He makes very good souvenirs. And good money, by the way. But he told me that his leg is injured. And he has a looooot of things to do. So, go help him. He'll give you cash.

dialog.Title: I brought you the bear head.|| Your bear tried to rip MY head off. Bad Teddy! Here's his chump.
dialog.Text: I'm impressed.

dialog.Title: Got my cash?
dialog.Text: Yup. Here it is.

dialog.Title: Got some job?
dialog.Text: I have one special contract for you. You need to find 4 different artefacts. And I'll thank you. A big "thank's" with several zeroes.

dialog.Title: Got it. I'll come back with those artefacts.|| Don't forget my cash.
dialog.Text: C'mon, come back soon.

dialog.Title: Not now. I don't have time for this.
About those arts...
dialog.Text: I'm listening.

dialog.Title: Here the "Stabiliser α". Take it. Hold it. Love it.
I gave you all artefacts.
dialog.Text: Cool. Nice job! Four different artefacts.

dialog.Title: Nothing.
dialog.Text: Hey. Stop bothering me with your "nothing". Bring me the artefacts!

dialog.Title: I need a nice and unexpensive gun.
dialog.Text: Oh. Maybe you'll take my plasma-laser-nuclear railgun? For free! Ha-ha... Ok... I have one not very rusty gun. Here is the deal: you kill the dogs around Lubech and I'll give you the weapon.

dialog.Title: I killed some dogs. Now give me my gun.
dialog.Text: Take it.

dialog.Title: And what else do you have?
I brought you the Kisliy's artefacts.
dialog.Text: Kisliy? It changes nothing. I've announced a bounty for his empty head. You can give me this arts. And I won't seek for him for a couple of days. But somebody is looking for him already. I have a feeling. Also we can pretend that we didn't talk about it. It's all the same for Kisliy, anyway.

dialog.Title: I don't have any cash for you.
Tell me about local pushers.
dialog.Text: Pushers... they can buy from you dog heads and tails. Good souvenirs for the Big Land. There are couple of pushers. At the kindergarden there are some bums. But they aren't rich. So you can bring body parts to the Palace of Culture or here. Here are some good prices. But the best prices for mutant heads are on the railway station. You'll need to walk there though. There is also Gourmet's place. It's in the village near Lubech. But there are a lot of danger anomalies.

dialog.Title: I'm listening.
dialog.Text: Gossips can't bring you the real money.

dialog.Title: What about Kisliy?|| I'm nervous.
dialog.Text: Oh. I can't cancel anything. But I can tell you, if I'll see somebody suspicious in Lubech... the bounty hunter, for example...

dialog.Title: Ok. Tell me if you'll see something.
Here is the young bear head.|| It was cool to kill him.
dialog.Text: Next time bring me something bigger than that.

dialog.Title: Take the bear head.|| That bastard was hard to kill.
dialog.Text: Cool. Give it to me.

dialog.Title: Where can I find him?
dialog.Text: He near a post, in square И12. It's to the north-east from the square and to the right of Lenin statue and the Palace. You know the area, don't you?

dialog.Title: I need money, so let's pretend|| I never told you about him.
dialog.Text: Fine by me. But I'm short on money right now. So you need to find Metrofan. He is in the old Palace of Culture building. It's in the square З12. I'll send him a message and he'll give you the money. One street to the north from here, you'll se the square. Turn right on the first floor, there you'll find him.

dialog.Title: Need a help?
dialog.Text: Not me, but I have a pal, Sanek the Wise. He makes very good souvenirs. And good money, by the way. But he told me that his leg is injured. And he has a looooot of things to do. So, go help him. He'll give you cash.

dialog.Title: Tell me about local pushers.
dialog.Text: Not so fast. Show me some money.

dialog.Title: Morozov wants his package back.
dialog.Text: Ah yes! His package is outside. Take it and bring it back to him. But do it as fast as you can.

dialog.Title: There was a bomb in that box? Man, what a F***?
dialog.Text: Ah. It was a mistake. Sorry. I hope nobody get hurt.
