dialog.Text: What an old donkey. Nothing does work for him... Come back later, I have to think about it.

dialog.Title: The academic still in the cage. ||Any other ideas?
dialog.Text: So, I suggest to take drastic measures. If Patisson does not take the hint, we'll stop supplying him with the food. Officially, we don't support him for a long time, but my compassionate colleagues fed the old man anyway through intermediaries. Such stalkers as you, for example. The irony is -- most of the food Patisson gave to mutants. I'll talk to my colleagues, make them understand. And you must not give him any food. Let's see how this bird will sing in a couple of days. He is weak, exhausted and suffering from marasmus, instead of working like the others. We'll break him sooner or later.

dialog.Title: Hunger does not affect the scientist.|Does not seem that hunger affected the scientist.
dialog.Text: Yes, this stubborn donkey keep it up. But still...

dialog.Title: If there will be ideas, let me know.
The scientist is still in the cage.|| Any other ideas?
dialog.Text: He probably thinks that we can't leave him without water. But he is mistaken. He will not see a drop. It will not be easy, but I can convince Simonov to the need for such measures. And you can go to the Whatman and tell him to hold the water... But it will be better if I tell him. The rest will have to agree with us. Again, don't give him anything. Let's see whether Patisson will stand it two more days.

dialog.Title: Isn't it too cruel?
dialog.Text: I don't ask you anything. If you do not want to look for Whatman, I'll find another way to tell him my plan. Just go your way and do not mess with my affairs. We'll do it ourselves.

dialog.Title: I don't want to participate.
dialog.Text: No problem. We will do it ourselves.

dialog.Title: Your scientist stands his ground.
dialog.Text: Yes, I admit, Patisson won this round. We do not need his death on our conscience. Bring him water and food. But don't tell it's from me.

dialog.Title: I have enough running around.
dialog.Text: Don't you want to save the old man from dehydration and starvation? I thought I was an evil one here.

dialog.Title: Give it to me, I'll take it to him.
Your scientist stands his ground.
dialog.Text: It's all because someone continued to bring him water. But I again warned and threatened everybody... Let's see if Patisson hold on another day...

dialog.Title: У меня есть научный труд Патиссона...
dialog.Text: Где ты это взял? Дай сюда! ...Вот ведь старый лис! Похоже, что его "бредни" не лишены смысла. Это здорово меня подставит... Я поступил с ним жестко, и это было оправданно, пока мы пытались вернуть в лагерь старого маразматика. Но теперь выходит, что я чуть насмерть не замучил гения! Проклятие!

dialog.Title: Нет. Я отдам это Симонову.
dialog.Text: Ты...! Ты с ним заодно...?!

dialog.Title: Что мне за это будет?
dialog.Text: Чертовы сталкеры... Все у вас продается-покупается. Ничего не делаете даром... Хорошо. У меня есть доступ к кое-каким запасам. Я могу умыкнуть для тебя "Экран α". Что скажешь? "Экран α" за кипу ничего не значащих бумаг. По-моему, весьма недурно. Уверен, это будет самый халявный в твоей жизни артефакт.

dialog.Title: А я тебя. Косметичку не терял?
dialog.Text: Что за эксцесс! Быстренько, на полтона ниже! Ты за работой тут? Откуда узнал?

dialog.Title: От Сизифа. Я в деле.
dialog.Text: В деле и хорошо. Косметичку, ишь ты! Должно быть, интересно, что за дела у меня с такой фирмой? А все просто. Они так тесно с фармацевтикой завязаны, что, считай, одно и то же. Я же как раз примерно тем и занимаюсь. А они, не задавая лишних вопросов, за периметром мои исследования форсируют. Ну а я, само собой, отсюда им понемногу помогаю. Симбиоз, слыхал о таком?

dialog.Title: Конечно! Ты им гада, тебе помада!
dialog.Text: А не пошел бы ты... Завязывай, понял?! Я тебе не из, хм, этих! За делом пришел, так давай к делу переходить! И не смей тут всяческие намеки отпускать в мою сторону!

dialog.Title: А то что? Поцелуешь?!
dialog.Text: Ненавижуууууу!!!! Чтоб ты сдох, сталкер, в самой жуткой аномалии, чтоб тебя Паукан сожрал, чтоб тебе верлиока все, что болтается, отхватила!!! Чтоб тебя бляки щебнем набили!!!

dialog.Title: Только косметичкой не бей!
dialog.Text: Откуда же ты такой, гад, взялся на мою голову?!! Я же просто деньжат зарабатываю, куча людей на такие компании работает, а ты тут стоишь, дурака валяешь?! Кретин!! Имбецил!!!

dialog.Title: Эй, остынь! Пошутил и все. Слушаю тебя.
dialog.Text: Вот! Так-то оно лучше. Вообще работенка не из юморных тебе предстоит. Компания требует лапы пауков нескольких разновидностей. Я сперва думал, что логичнее было бы железы или что еще. Однако, у них на лапах как раз есть железы, выделяющие некие опознавательные ферменты. Вот они-то и есть причина твоей охоты!

dialog.Title: Тааак, я уже понимаю.....
dialog.Text: Да, именно. Нужны лапки. Королевских пауков - пятнадцать, Ужасающих пауков - пятнадцать, и, наконец, лапы Паукана - десять.Кроме того, нужны языки глупых бляков. Тоже сфера биохими, так что просто достань их. Я лично даже не стал пытаться вникнуть. Специфика, знаешь ли, не моя. Нешуточное задание, понимаю. Но это сделает тебя богаче, а некоторым особям женского пола, возможно, придаст уверенности в себе! Так что смазал лыжи и вперед, за добычей!

dialog.Title: Смотри, не плачь, тушь потечет!
dialog.Text: Был бы ствол под рукой, в тебя бы столько свинца засадил, что можно было бы вместо якоря использовать!!! Вот ей-же ей, убил бы!!

dialog.Title: С таким сопрано уж в кабаре ждут!
dialog.Text: Арррррргхххх!!!! Нанял бы убийцу, останься деньги на такое дело!! Да только ты, ничтожество, даже пули не заслуживаешь!!! На кол тебя! Четвертовать и блякам скормить!! Уйди, противный!!! Довел!!!

dialog.Title: Ухожу! Букет и конфеты по почте пришлю!
dialog.Text: РРРРРРРРР!!!!!!

dialog.Title: Все понятно. Ну и материалы у них!
dialog.Text: Красота требует жертв. Ладно, хоть не человеческих, в данном случае!

dialog.Title: Так, вот лапы. Кучу сами разберете.
dialog.Text: Ну и славно! Хорошо, что живой вернулся. Давай сюда трофеи, вот награда, как компания и обещала.

dialog.Title: А что еще они там используют?
dialog.Text: Тебе лучше не знать, сталкер. Поверь, лучше не знать. Иначе у тебя может развиться фобия относительно накрашенных женщин. Так что просто не думай об этом.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь

dialog.Title: Лапы Ужасающего паука!
dialog.Text: Ты просто герой, сталкер.

dialog.Title: Паукановы лапищи, глянь-ка.
dialog.Text: Вот это да! Замечательно!

dialog.Title: Языки бляков. Забирай скорее.
dialog.Text: Необходимая мерзость, увы! Но ты молодец.
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Wait, I still have a business here.
Yes, I need to go outside.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Wait, I still have a business here.
Yes, I need to go outside.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Damn! What's going on? Why am l so unlucky? One thing after another ... continuous problems. Either broth or spoil. Only losses. Aw, Snap ... stalker! Healthy. How is it? Okey?

dialog.Title: Normal. Heartburn?
dialog.Text: Better, thank you. I wonder, could you do me a favor? And I also do smth for you

dialog.Title: It depends on what kind of favor...
dialog.Text: Listen. The point is. I have a friend, he buy arts on a rather large price. That is, we'll earn a lot of money. Your job - find artifacts and I'll be the mediator. Of course, currently deduct interest, but ... you will have the profit also!

dialog.Title: No thanks, suspicious ...
dialog.Text: Well it is your decision. I will find anyone else

dialog.Title: Sounds great.
dialog.Text: Bring me three arts -- three "Screen α". Where and how, I do not care. Fetch them here. I do take care of them. And all will be well. Deal?

dialog.Title: Hmmm....So... I am...
dialog.Text: What are you? Got arts? No? So let's go! Bring me artifacts!

dialog.Title: Fine. what about you?
dialog.Text: To tell the truth, not very good. Recently not all right something . One thing after another ... I hate canned. Would you believe or no I have heartburn from them! Soon I will have gastritis. Ah ... I want to appear in the dining room, and eat there solyanochku or borscht... Listen, stalker! Make a minute good work!

dialog.Title: What favor?
dialog.Text: Bring me boar meat. it must be nearby and I'll thank you. How is it, huh? I read some notes ... of a "foodie". I want to roast hog`leg by his recipe. Legs will be enough... Well, bring me for a coin?

dialog.Title: No, I can not yet.
dialog.Text: That's a pity

dialog.Title: Take meat. Enjoy ...
dialog.Text: You are a clever boy, I see. If anything, you can contact me for a clever work

dialog.Title: I brought the artifacts. | As agreed, I brought the artifacts.
dialog.Text: That's done. To succeed you're going! I've prepared something for you, hold on!

dialog.Title: You are deceiving me?
dialog.Text: God be with you all to be honest, in all fairness! A bargain is a bargain!

dialog.Title: New task?| may be you have something for me?
dialog.Text: Yes, I have one job. This time it will be even more profitable, but huckster wants more artifacts.

dialog.Title: Tell me more...
dialog.Text: Need three "Screens α" and two "Pillows α". Payment at this time will be in rubles. In your best interest to move. More artifacts -- more money.

dialog.Title: No, thank you. || I was consumed by vague doubts.
dialog.Text: As you wish

dialog.Title: Nothing yet
dialog.Text: Look, I already agreed with the man, he's waiting! Come on, harry up!

dialog.Title: I took the arts. | As agreed, I took arts. Here you go.
dialog.Text: Great, man. I will give arts to huckster, so come to me later.

dialog.Title: I came for the payment
dialog.Text: What payment? Stalker, I don't know you

dialog.Title: We had a deal ||, Igave you arts and waiting for my money
dialog.Text: What deal? I repeat, I don't know you! Everybody come to me and say that I know them and ask for money. I'm human, man, I can't help everybody financially. Have you see a bandage Red Cross on me? Humanitarian assistance can not do. Go away!

dialog.Title: I will meet you again | Okay, Bald. Earth is round.
dialog.Text: eah. Scared. Go and enjoy yourself.

dialog.Title: I see you remember me
dialog.Text: You know,it was mistake. It happens. Well, judge for yourself, everybody come and demand something and it was dark when you came, and that's ... And I didn't know that such important people in your friends ... Hold on! Sorry, mate, I did not sell everything in time. Now I do not dare to deal with him do it youself.

dialog.Title: Brought three "Screen α".
dialog.Text: Give them to me!

dialog.Title: What about the reward?
dialog.Text: Come back later. I don't have money yet

dialog.Title: Brought "Pillows".
dialog.Text: Give them to me!
What?

dialog.Title: Ты с Юрием знаком?
dialog.Text: Это который Грязный? Ну не лично, так, за глаза. Слышал о нем, скажем. А что такое, кто спрашивает?

dialog.Title: Тот, кто может тебя свинцом угостить.
dialog.Text: Тю, а что потом с тобой будет? Знаешь? Тебя же по всему Любечу собирать будут, сталкер! Ты давай не геройствуй тут!

dialog.Title: Да я уже умираю. И тебя с собой захвачу!
dialog.Text: Так. Ты хорош мне зубы заговаривать! Что за камикадзе ты такой? С чего за Юрия говоришь?! И ты это, не приближайся!

dialog.Title: Рак у меня. А Юрий друг. А ты, если что, труп.
dialog.Text: Блин! Да ты погоди, псих! Постой! Убери ствол! Давай поговорим! Ну?! Можно же как-то все утрясти, нет?!

dialog.Title: Смерть не утрясти. Чем докажешь что понял?
dialog.Text: Б-блин! Б-блин!!! Э-это в знак м-моей искренней признательности за донесение до меня ценного совета! Вот, забирай! И Юрию скажи, что я понял! Все понял!

dialog.Title: Ладно. Пока верю. Смотри, везде достану!
dialog.Text: Д-да я разве ж стану грешить-то так!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Come here. Sit down.

dialog.Title: Who are you?
dialog.Text: I am Metrofan. The owner of this bar. Not bad as it looks. It's a very good idea to make a bar inside the house of culture. Shtaket argued with me, but I don't care. People need to drink sometimes.

dialog.Title: I need a job.
dialog.Text: You can shoot or you can explore. What do you want?

dialog.Title: I'd like to shoot.
dialog.Text: So go kill some spiders and bring me their legs. Pretty simple.

dialog.Title: I'd like to explore some new places.
dialog.Text: There is a village far from here. Ryabinushka. It was a pretty place with good country and farm houses. And it could be good place for a new base. So you can go there look well and try to remember all interesting things about this village.

dialog.Title: I thought that I can't leave the town.
dialog.Text: Yup. But you can find the way out. Security is under Dibenko. He's in the old militia's office. You can also find Shtaket there. A big fat pusher. He can give you the pass. Also you can work with Courier. And you can find my good friend Sanek.

dialog.Title: I'll try to explore this village.
I need some information about this place.
dialog.Text: So listen to me. This is Lubech. It was pretty not long ago. But now there are a lot of ugly mutated bastards. And your main goal now is surviving.

dialog.Title: I can't find Shtaket.
dialog.Text: You need to find the militia's office.

dialog.Title: I need a job.
dialog.Text: You can help me with one thing,

dialog.Title: How?
dialog.Text: My good friend, Yura Barabashka, is missing. He was at the Ж13 area. Near the stadium.

dialog.Title: Ok. I'll try to find him.
I thought that I can't leave the town.
dialog.Text: Yup. But you can find the way out. Security is under Dibenko. He's in the old militia's office. You can also find Shtaket there. A big fat pusher. He can give you the pass. Also you can work with Courier. And you can find my good friend Sanek.

dialog.Title: I've found your friend.
dialog.Text: And?

dialog.Title: I helped him.| He was in his garage, lost all his loot. So I helped him.
dialog.Text: Cool. Thanks. Take some cash.

dialog.Title: He has lost his loot.|| He is in his garage.
dialog.Text: So help him. Make some present for your karma.

dialog.Title: Nah. I don't have time for this.
dialog.Text: Take it as I promised.

dialog.Title: I thought that you need this information.
dialog.Text: I need his debt. But if he don't have money so I don't have it too.

dialog.Title: He can do it at his own.
I don't have time for it.
dialog.Text: So find some time please.

dialog.Title: He can do it without my help.
I was at Ryabinuska. Very pretty.|| You gonna like it.
dialog.Text: I knew that! Thanks!

dialog.Title: Here's 10 legs.
dialog.Text: Give it to me.

dialog.Title: Here are your 30 legs.
dialog.Text: Give me that.

dialog.Title: Shtaket sent me.
dialog.Text: I've got your cash. So, what your conscience tells you about Kisliy?

dialog.Title: Not your business...
dialog.Text: If you'll help my friend I won't tell anyone about your sins.

dialog.Title: What friend?
dialog.Text: Sanek the Wise needs your help. He makes great souvenir stuff for the Big Land. But says that he is too cool for hunting. I think that he is too old for that. Anyway. Help him.

dialog.Title: And where is your friend?
dialog.Text: He's in the И12 area. You can go right at the Lenin's monument. Sanek is near the tower.

dialog.Title: Got it. I have a question.
Nah. He's too cool to make it by his own.
Sanek? I've heard about him. From Shtaket.
dialog.Text: So, you know the deal. Will you help him?

dialog.Title: I've already did.
dialog.Text: Great, man! Ok then.

dialog.Title: Jura is safe and sound.|| He'll give you all his debt.
dialog.Text: Good job!

dialog.Title: I can bring another 10 spider legs.
dialog.Text: Hmmm. Ok. Why not? It would be nice.

dialog.Title: I can bring another 30 spider legs.
dialog.Text: Wow! The real dealer! Bring it.
What else?

dialog.Title: I've seen there some strange mutant corpses.|| Seems like some cult killed em for their hell rituals.
dialog.Text: Damn! Looks like The Whites. Again. Damn! Crazy ass bastards!

dialog.Title: The Whites?
dialog.Text: Freakin cultists. The pagans. But they weren't so agressive. There is a new patient in our medical post. Stepan. Find him. He might saw something.

dialog.Title: Торговля.
dialog.Text: Да что ты сразу! Я ж по-доброму, по-хозяйски. Да и что уж там скрывать, ты явно не Бред Питт. Ты лучше расслабься, откушай тушеночки, запей чем-нибудь погорячее. У меня, благо, все есть.

dialog.Title: Ты кто?
dialog.Text: Я Метрофан, хозяин сего прекрасного заведения. Не евроремонты, конечно, но уютненько.

dialog.Title: Все есть, говоришь? А может, занятие мне подыщешь, а то я тут замаялся уже?
dialog.Text: Да сколько угодно! Могу предложить пострелять пауков – лапы мне их очень пригодятся. А могу тебя и в пешее путешествие отправить. Что больше по душе?

dialog.Title: По мне - так вполне приличный притон. Покажи мне харчи свои.
Прогулялся до Рябинушки. Да там прямо совковый рай. Есть на что посмотреть.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь

dialog.Title: He is your friend.|| He asked how you're doing.
dialog.Text: I have no time, do not bother me.

dialog.Title: Kisliy send his regards.|Are you Mitka? Kolya Kisliy send his regards.
dialog.Text: Kisliy? Never heard of him.

dialog.Title: Who are you?
dialog.Text: Mitka. Yes... Mitka... I'm hunting.

dialog.Title: Who?
dialog.Text: Does not matter. Go away
Shh... They are close...

dialog.Title: Старика с барретом не видел?
dialog.Text: Нет... Только мельком... Они как призраки. Но когда рядом -- держись. Просто так меня не отпустят. Отовсюду видят. И ждут. Один неверный шаг -- мигом шлепнут.

dialog.Title: Сколько их?
dialog.Text: Их два. Старик и баррет.

dialog.Title: Эм...
dialog.Text: Ты поможешь мне? Я охотился на них. Но теперь я сам -- их загнанная жертва. Я отсюда никуда не сунусь. А как прижмут -- рвану на Новую Землю. Да... Там спокойнее. Нужны артефакты. Два. "Проводник", чтобы совершить переход. И "Грелка", чтобы согреться. Ведь там очень холодно.

dialog.Title: Я принес тебе артефакты.
dialog.Text: Да?

dialog.Title: Да, они уже у тебя.
dialog.Text: У меня? Да, да... У меня. Я теперь спокоен. Но я больше не вижу их. Кажется, они ушли. Жаль.

dialog.Title: Ушли? Куда?
dialog.Text: Не знаю... Но когда они вернутся... я буду вне опасности...

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Good day.

dialog.Title: Hello. I'm looking for a job.
dialog.Text: Right. Do you have any weapon?

dialog.Title: That's very silly question.
dialog.Text: Ok. I need a big mountain of mutant body parts. I'm kind of....

dialog.Title: A taxidermist?
dialog.Text: Right! I need a wing of that scary jumping monster for a start.

dialog.Title: A Verliock's wing?
dialog.Text: Yeeaaah! Verliock's. Will you bring that?

dialog.Title: Definitely.
dialog.Text: Cool. So I can throw away my old one. My friend brought it to me. He killed Verliock with a machine gun. I don't need the minced wing. Be accurate.

dialog.Title: Hello. Just passing by.
dialog.Text: Good luck.

dialog.Title: Here's your wing.
dialog.Text: Wow. Nice wing. Thanks.

dialog.Title: Any reward?
dialog.Text: Take it. Come again.

dialog.Title: I need some work.
dialog.Text: That's good. Now I need a good strong leather. You can kill a Sylvan.

dialog.Title: Got it. I hate Sylvans.
dialog.Text: Kill it. And bring me it's SKIN!

dialog.Title: Need some skin?
dialog.Text: Nice material! You're my best friend now, friend! Take your reward.

dialog.Title: Need some Sylvan's skin jacket?
dialog.Text: Nice material! You're my best friend now, friend! Take your reward.

dialog.Title: My pleasure!
dialog.Text: Nice skin! That's my Ripper!

dialog.Title: Can I kill another beast?
dialog.Text: Yup. Go and kill the Fiend. It has nice arms. I will attach them to another mutant's butt!

dialog.Title: Cool idea. I'll return soon.
dialog.Text: May the force be with you.

dialog.Title: No. I won't do this.
dialog.Text: Come back if you'll change your mind.

dialog.Title: Here's the Fiend's arms.
dialog.Text: The real ice cold ripper! In da house! It's pleasure doing business with you.

dialog.Title: I think so.
dialog.Text: I have another job for you.

dialog.Title: What's next?
dialog.Text: I need a big mutated head. Scary one.

dialog.Title: I will regret this...
dialog.Text: What?

dialog.Title: Maybe... BIG BEAR HEAD?|Maybe you need the BIG FREAKY BEAR HEAD?
dialog.Text: THE RIPPER! YES! MAAAAN! If you'll kill that mo*****, I'll speak with Zuy for you. We need psychoes like you!

dialog.Title: Hell yeah!
dialog.Text: Kill the Bear. Bring the Head.

dialog.Title: I need some time to get ready.
dialog.Text: But don't think too long. I need to finish my dummy.

dialog.Title: Your bear head.
dialog.Text: YEAAAAH! MY MAAAAN! THE RIPPER! THE BIG F***G HEAD!!!!!!!

dialog.Title: I appreciate that.
dialog.Text: Good luck, Ripper!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Prisoner's corpse.
Look's like missing pilot. There was a notebook under the bed.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Prisoner! You walked over the patrol line! If you'll try to go to the exit you'll be shot to death! By the way...don't you want to atone your crimes?

dialog.Title: Я могу искупить свою вину?
dialog.Text: Можешь. Докажи, что ты осознал свою вину и встал на путь исправления! Потрудись на благо общества!

dialog.Title: Что за труд такой?
dialog.Text: Идешь к вагонам, находишь рядового Серова. Он тебе все популярно объяснит.

dialog.Title: Хорошо, поработаю
dialog.Text: Вот и молодец!

dialog.Title: Да
dialog.Text: Хм... Все верно. Печать и водяные знаки на месте, подпись Серова тоже присутствует... Ну что же, сталкер, поздравляю! Ты искупил свою вину перед обществом! Ты свободен! Ну, а соскучишься по камешкам - добро пожаловать, их у нас всегда в наличии!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Keepers will save you!

dialog.Title: You too.
dialog.Text: Why are you here, stalker?

dialog.Title: I want to find some job.
dialog.Text: I have one mission for you.

dialog.Title: What should I do?
dialog.Text: Hmm, you look like a pretty strong guy with good equipment. But can I trust you? Come so. Let's see if you are good enough and then I will find a job for you. To south from here wild boars live and bring a lot of troubles. Kill one of them and take its leg. Leg of young wild boar will be enough. If you stay alive we will give you better job. At the same time we will have the leg for dinner. And more. Don't try to buy a boar from the merchants, to sit somewhere and then come back here like a hero. It may end bad.

dialog.Title: I listen.
dialog.Text: There are places in the Zone which emit an unusual energy. According to our theory there should be three such places which together form a mystical triangle. You have to find them all and collect data. I'll give you coordinates of the first place, but the other two you will find by yourself. I hope I was not mistaken in you and you will not fail. Coordinates of these places are very important for us.

dialog.Title: Got it. I'll search those places.
I need to go in another direction.
Tell me what's wrong?
dialog.Text: Once you have collected the data we sent a team of researchers but the mutant spiders killed them. The Master ordered to exterminate spiders without mercy! There are lot of these creatures especially in places with psionic energy... but no matter. We can not continue the studies until the holy war against the spiders will not end. The main thing is to get rid of them so we can safely explore the mounds. Go and kill the spiders mutants. Even if you can not destroy all of them at least kill a great number.

dialog.Title: I will not go. |I'd love to but the ammo are over. Maybe later.
What is it this time?
dialog.Text: Verliocks! No matter how many we killed they do not become less! This creature poisoned one of ours and now he's dying. We need an antidote and as soon as possible. He has not much time. This man is very important to us! The Veterinarian can make an antidote but he will need samples of animal tissues. I think the paws will be ok, so hurry up. Veterinarian lives here, close by. You can find him on my right, in the house.

dialog.Title: I'm listening.
dialog.Text: First kill the boar and than I will give you a new job.

dialog.Title: I'm listening.
dialog.Text: First give me the data of anomalous areas and then we'll see.

dialog.Title: All right. I will be back soon.
I'm listening.
dialog.Text: First finish your previous task.

dialog.Title: Okay, I'll do and be back.
Ready for new tasks.
dialog.Text: To your PDA I added electronic documents that must be delivered to one hermit. His name is Kosmatiy. He is in our debt. He must decrypt the documents. However, this bonehead got in most swamps and live there. I don't know exactly where, so be careful, the path to him you have to find. Do not let us down!

dialog.Title: No, I don't want to go far into the swamp.
I'm ready!
dialog.Text: Have you already deciphered the documents and took them to the Master?

dialog.Title: So what should I do?
dialog.Text: Stalker. Are you mocking us? Our man is bent from the poison and you're playing Q and A? Run to the vet for the antidote!

dialog.Title: I killed the boar. Here's the leg.
dialog.Text: Zone bless you!

dialog.Title: About the anomalous areas.|| I added all the information to your PDA.
dialog.Text: Zone bless you!

dialog.Title: Here's the antidote you asked.
dialog.Text: You have done a good deed, stalker.

dialog.Title: They say you hide the pilot here.
dialog.Text: Who is saying? We do not hide anybody. But you can talk to the Master Michael, if you don't believe me.

dialog.Title: I'm searching for stalker Temon.
dialog.Text: He is our novice. Talk to the Master.

dialog.Title: "Brother Temon" did not return?
dialog.Text: Our Master wants to speak to you about that. Go see him.

dialog.Title: У меня разряд по уничтожению мутантов.
dialog.Text: Да, парень ты крепкий. Ну, слушай сюда. В общем, говорят, в Зоне, есть курган, который излучает таинственную энергию. По нашей теории, должно быть еще два таких же кургана, которые вместе образуют мистический треугольник. Тебе необходимо отыскать все три кургана и исследовать их. Координаты первого нам известны, а два остальных ты должен найти самостоятельно. Надеюсь, я не ошибся в тебе, и ты меня не подведешь, так как информация, об этих курганах, для нас очень важна

dialog.Title: Есть еще работенка?
dialog.Text: Найдется.

dialog.Title: С пауками покончено.|Сделал, как ты просил, пауков больше нет. Можете продолжать работать.
dialog.Text: Сохрани тебя Зона, сталкер. Мы продолжим наши исследования.

dialog.Title: Мне б работенку, не шибко пыльную.
dialog.Text: Ты с предыдущей закончи, а тогда я тебе новую дам!

dialog.Title: От загадок не уберегли. Может, знаешь одну?
dialog.Text: Все может быть! Смотря, как задать вопрос и как услышать ответ! Но тут ты прав, загадку я знаю. Только смею просить тебя об ответной услуге.

dialog.Title: Постараюсь помочь.
dialog.Text: В Любече есть вор по кличке Штакет. Люди, которые должны слушаться его, последнее время перешли границы дозволенного. Войны мы бы не хотели, потому прошу тебя отнести ему письмо. От нас. Там изложены наши предложения в виде записей и аргументы в виде фотографий. Мы верим, что это поможет ему принять правильное решение. Затем приходи, и я поделюсь с тобой загадкой.

dialog.Title: Без проблем. Доставлю почту.
dialog.Text: Зона да будет благосклонна к тебе!

dialog.Title: Письмо прочитано. Мир будет.
dialog.Text: Все бы вопросы улаживались так! Миром, пониманием и отзывчивостью! Увы, часто люди упорны в своем невежестве. Спасибо, сталкер. И вот, загадка, которую ты искал. "Брат с братом через дорожку живут, а друг друга не видят."

dialog.Title: Спасибо. Теперь мне пора.
dialog.Text: Храни тебя Зона, сталкер!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who is there?

dialog.Title: Do you have a medical tincture?
I brought the empty bottles.
dialog.Text: Let me see. Not broken? Don't forget your money.

dialog.Title: I will not.
dialog.Text: Ok, thanks and bye.

dialog.Title: I brought the empty bottles.
dialog.Text: Give them to me. Not broken? You and Dumpster are working damn quickly. I don't have extra money right now. Come back later.

dialog.Title: Do not try to cheat...
dialog.Text: Yeah, yeah. I'm scared. So... I'm saving money for some furniture for my house. As soon as I have extra money I will give them to you.

dialog.Title: It's me. Where is the money?
dialog.Text: Oh, it's you... So be it, take your pennies. I still have not bought the furniture, but your dime will not help anyway.

dialog.Title: Where are my percents?
dialog.Text: What percents?

dialog.Title: For the delay.
dialog.Text: I do not understand you stalker. Take the money and go.

dialog.Title: Should I start break your furniture? |If I break your old furniture it will be easier to understand?
dialog.Text: Wait, wait...! Take your percents.

dialog.Title: I brought the empty bottles.
dialog.Text: Not broken? Do not forget your money.

dialog.Title: I brought the empty bottles.
dialog.Text: Give them to me. One bird told me that Dumpster don't receive my money. What can you say?

dialog.Title: I have agreement with him...
dialog.Text: I don't care... It is your business. Talk to Dumpster if you need. But I will send the money with another person. Reputation is important to me. And don't threaten me, bully.

dialog.Title: I brought the empty bottles.
dialog.Text: Give them to me. I will send money with a courier. You should wait.

dialog.Title: And how long to wait?
dialog.Text: As needed. If there is a problem, solve it with Dumpster.

dialog.Title: I have questions.
dialog.Text: Really?

dialog.Title: Do you live alone here?
dialog.Text: Yes. I live and I'm not complaining.

dialog.Title: And how you got here?
dialog.Text: You want to know everything, don't you? It was long ago...

dialog.Title: You came by river?
dialog.Text: Are you crazy? That one barge in the swamp are so old. Am I look like an old sea captain who drinks rum, smokes cigars, shouting "aye-aye" and "ahoy"?

dialog.Title: Well you never know... || I have heard there is an anomaly in which all aging faster. And you could be a passenger.
dialog.Text: The theory is great. But you are wrong. I came here by myself. Previously found this place for myself. After all, the noticeable barge is here. Dragged the supplies and built up, settled down... Don't trample here. If you have a business just say so. If not... then move to the south where people are friendlier.

dialog.Title: What business?
dialog.Text: I thought everyone already knows. But no... still there are stray travelers. Ugh! In short, I need herbs for infusions. You do not clap your eyes and listen. I'm making tinctures. But good plant is almost gone nearby. And it is dangerous to go far. Therefore willing to pay more for the work of others. You stalkers should be able to understand the herbs. You go to the swamps and forests in the mountains... Looking for herbs and bring them to me. If the grass is good I will pay you money. By the way, if you have interest in tinctures, can succeed. But with your ingredients and alcohol... As you know, rare ingredients are in short supply. And I take ammo as the payment for my work. Mutants like to pester. Especially at night. And from crooks like you right ammo will always help.

dialog.Title: Came on foot?
dialog.Text: No, damn it, I ride Dumbo the elephant, but they thought it was a mutant and sold him to scientists... Of course, I came here on foot! Abnormal activity, goddamn radiation-exposure... attracted a lot of hells bombers. For a long time I was looking for a path here, in the wilderness, where the peace and quiet. But it turned out that you are everywhere even here. Everybody come here. Every single day.

dialog.Title: Ok, bye.
dialog.Text: Wait. I thought you came here to do business?

dialog.Title: I see you have a stronghold here.
dialog.Text: Pretty good, eh? I built it myself. Almost died here... But now I have a whole second floor with private arsenal. I can kill almost everything from there.

dialog.Title: Расскажи об это месте.
dialog.Text: Я похож на тур-агента? Ступай в Рябу или в Новиково. Или к ученым... Сейчас они должны быть уже на юго-восточной стороне вулкана. Наверняка им есть что рассказать.

dialog.Title: Как пройти в Рябу?
dialog.Text: На юго-западе есть заброшенная деревня, Рябинушка. "Заброшенная", потому что вулкан начал вонять и тамошние жители не придумали ничего лучше, кроме как собрать свои пожитки да рвануть через болота в сторону Любеча. С тех пор их никто не видел... Сталкеры используют Рябу как место для привала. Один успешный торговец, Фин, быстро смекнул что к чему и открыл там магазин. Похоже, вулкан его не смущает.

dialog.Title: Вулкан?
dialog.Text: Да, есть неподалеку такое чудо. Сходи, посмотри... Кстати, это был намек, если не понял.

dialog.Title: Как добраться до Новиково?
dialog.Text: Я скажу, если это поможет от тебя избавиться. Иди на восток, мимо старой базы. Дойдешь до перекрестка. Оттуда до поселка рукой подать. Но советую тебе на перекрестке повернуть на юг, к радиовышке, где торговцы скупают разное барахло, которое можно найти в Новиково. В самом поселке найдешь только смерть. Это бывшая военная территория. Говорят, там проводили какие-то полевые испытания. Как водится, все пошло наперекосяк, и теперь только мутанты могут поведать правду... Хотя знаешь... Забудь мой совет. Иди сразу в Новиково. Если повезет, больше не свидимся.

dialog.Title: Что за ученые?
dialog.Text: Откуда я знаю? Я же не ученый! Большая группа... с транспортом... это вдоль болот-то! Прошли мимо Новиково и двинули на юго-восток. Судя по уровню подготовки, они собрались разбить полноценный лагерь где-то за вулканом. Развернут свои антенны, выставят охрану и будут пялиться в мониторы, время от времени загружая в аппараты новую грязь. Ее вокруг и под вулканом как... как грязи.

dialog.Title: Я ищу Белых.
dialog.Text: ... ...Не видел здесь Белых. Давно. Слышь, сталкер, ты не хочешь пойти поискать их в другом месте?

dialog.Title: Люди видели, как ты с ними вел дела.
dialog.Text: И что теперь? Убьешь меня? Посмотрим, как это у тебя получится... Ладно, каюсь, продал им бутылку настойки в обмен на информацию о кое-каких травах. Сперва, как водится, принял для храбрости... Трезвые к Белым не подходят, люди их сторонятся. А я четкую задачу себе поставил: выведать их секреты во что бы то ни стало. Белый, с которым я заговорил, оказался на удивление адекватным. Охотно мне все рассказал. Еще поведал, что они должны пройти "очищение" в жерле вулкана. Короче говоря, эти психи собирались войти в Везувий и сгореть там заживо. Видимо, поэтому они были такие разговорчивые. Если бы мне оставалось жить один день, я бы тоже был не прочь облегчить душу.

dialog.Title: Не видел с ними пилота?
dialog.Text: Кого? Нет. Да и с чего бы вдруг им водить с собой пленника, сталкер? Мозги подключи. Они же шли на смерть. Но раз ты его ищешь... Думаю, тебе стоит знать... Болтливый Белый попросил меня передать послание их наставнику...

dialog.Title: Где оно?
dialog.Text: Не у меня, разумеется. Я же не дурак -- держать при себе записку от Белых. Я ее даже не читал. Вырыл ямку на обратном пути, сложил костерок и попытался сжечь эти каракули. Но первую спичку задуло, а потом я увидел кабанов... Жирные свиньи... Бросил все как есть и ушел. Если тебе повезет, письмо до сих пор там лежит. Оно в деревяшках застряло... так что улететь не должно. Впрочем, мутанты могли его съесть или порвать в клочки. Они любят ковыряться в грязи... Кажется, это был квадрат Д2...

dialog.Title: «Лиха» хочу хапнуть. Которое вещество.
dialog.Text: Это надо же, шутника какого занесло. Только тут не все просто. «Лихо» не просто так название свое получил. Я его по дурной памяти сварил, да думал продавать, грешен. Только вот, у пары-тройки сталкеров от него мозги не то, что набекрень, вообще выгорели вчистую. Вместо антистресса решили всю Страну Чудес получить. Сработало почти как лоботомия. Один так и сидел, слюни пускал, пока его верлиоки в бефстроганов рубили. Другой сам в аномалию прыгнул. Ну, я с этим и завязал, сразу, как узнал. И сам-то думал, на черта таким ядом торговать, и вдобавок попросили очень убедительно. Сталкеры, бывалые. С оружием. А я себе не враг, вовсе нет, мужик.

dialog.Title: Твой препарат может жизнь спасти!
dialog.Text: Э, брось. Я вопросов лишних задавать не буду. Хочешь «лихо», будет тебе. На твой страх и риск. А вместо договора, в знак того, что все понимаешь, ингредиенты сам соберешь. Я тебе все запишу. Получишь препарат, сам решишь – принимать или в речку слить.

dialog.Title: Ну хорошо, по рукам.
dialog.Text: Тогда держи, здесь список. Как соберешь, приходи, я быстренько тебе обеспечу такое варево, что целый взвод маршем отправит в кислотные дали.

dialog.Title: Скоро буду!
dialog.Text: Эге, смотри не увязни там, в болотце-то.

dialog.Title: Это я. Принес ингредиенты.
dialog.Text: Эх, любите вы, сталкеры, на грабли наступать, да еще и меня толкаете! Вот, держи свое «лихо». Учти, только, если разом все примешь, улетишь, да не факт, что путь назад отыщешь. Понял? Ну давай, удачи, психонавт.

dialog.Title: Понял, благодарствую!
dialog.Text: Да за отраву не благодари, сталкер. Не надо.

dialog.Title: Эхей! Загадок нет про запас?!
dialog.Text: Тудыть-то да брусом каленым куда не надо! Шутишь или правда, за загадкой приперся? Сталкеры теперь народную мудрость тоже за хабар считают? Ну, ладно уж. Будет тебе загадка. Только ты для меня тоже кое-что сделай.

dialog.Title: Ладушки. Говори.
dialog.Text: Сущий пустяк. Пижмы мне надо пяток штук, да древесных грибов с десяток. Тут как раз отварчик варганю, хочу вкус смягчить. Давай, сталкер, дело-то плевое! Будет тебе загадка.

dialog.Title: Уже в пути!
dialog.Text: Вот и славненько!

dialog.Title: Ингредиенты, Тимоха. Вот они.
dialog.Text:
Спасибо, сталкер. Ценю помощь. Так, тут немножко денег. А загадка тебе такая:
"Нахмурится, насупится, в слезы ударится – ничего не останется."

dialog.Title: Спасибо, Тимоха, удачи.
dialog.Text: Угу.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Are you lost the way?

dialog.Title: What is here?
dialog.Text: We call this place "Tunguska". Anomalies, mutants, radiation... You can find these here in abundance, ha-ha!

dialog.Title: Tell me about local mutants.
dialog.Text: Jellies are near the dried out lake. Crawl to the shore catch the unwary stalker and pull him into cold water to the bottom. Man chokes, swells... The jelly processes him into mush, absorbs and goes in search of a new victim. Many naively believe that jelly is a sort of irrational elements such as water or fire. Do not believe. It is a predator, cunning, crafty, always hungry, ready to eat whatever and whenever it wants. On the other side are the outcasts. Stupid zombies. Always a pleasure to kill them.

dialog.Title: What are you doing here?
dialog.Text: In the life of every successful hunter of the Zone comes a point when it becomes uninteresting to shoot livestock for cash or for scientists. We want to test yourself. Put in the harsh conditions for survival. We came to the Tunguska and established a settlement in ruins. The Society of Professional Hunters. Before becoming a full-fledged member of the community each new arrival goes through special tasks. The fence protects against the risk from the lake, plains and abandoned villages. But death is waiting at every turn in Tunguska. Can't relax even in the area of safety.

dialog.Title: Tell me about the test.
dialog.Text: Hunter who wish to pass the test should kill the required number of mutants in the allotted time. He can not resort to treatment and should not leave the anomalous zone whether for health reasons or reasons beyond his control even respectful. Newcomers stay on this side of the fence and hunt jellies or zombies.

dialog.Title: I want to shoot jellies.
dialog.Text: It is too dangerous for you. Zombies are your task. We have to check out if you're good. And when you pass the test you can hunt jelly.

dialog.Title: I want to shoot zombies.
dialog.Text: Kill 20 zombies. You have half an hour. Do not use the remedies and do not leave anomalous zone. And do not die.

dialog.Title: I want to shoot jellies.
dialog.Text: Kill a jelly. One is enough. I give half an hour. Conditions are the same: no medical means and you can not abandon the anomalous zone... And come back alive. We have already lost the promising newcomers in this trial...

dialog.Title: Was the meteorite fall here?|Was the meteorite fall here over a century ago?
dialog.Text: To tell you the truth... We... do not know. GPS-equipment fails and the exact coordinates of the location can not be determined. According to some data we really are in the marshes near the Stony Tunguska. According to the other... Let's just say, the time it takes to fly from New Land here does not compare to travel distance. But we're not too worried. Our interest -- anomalies and mutants.

dialog.Title: I want to shoot the outcasts.
Это сюда упал метеорит?|Это сюда упал метеорит больше века назад?
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
What?

dialog.Title: What are you doing in a cage?
dialog.Text: Can't you see? I feed mutants. And before you will ask one more silly question... It is important scientific experiment. It is necessary to watch changes in their behavior and behind action after some components which I add into food.

dialog.Title: How long you sit here?
dialog.Text: Now every day in two shifts. Previously, I had an assistant. But he went away from the cage so they ate him. Therefore, I will not open the cage even if you'll be attacked. You're a stalker and you have weapons. And... Can't you just walk away? Because you scare my mutants.

dialog.Title: Can I help you?
dialog.Text: You? Help me? Ha! Stalker, get out of here. How many people do you know who sympathize with mutants? And how many scientists among them? Do not stand there because mutants will attack and you will kill them even from the defense or just for fun. You better not interfere.

dialog.Title: Here is the data about mutants. ||You can take them from my PDA.
dialog.Text: Where did you get them?

dialog.Title: One scientist has helped. ||I think it is useful to you.
dialog.Text: Hmm... Well... Thank you. Now you're waiting, that I'll get out of here and go back to the camp, right?

dialog.Title: You have the data. Why to sit here?
dialog.Text: Why? WHY? This data is only the first step! It did not give me anything, no answers. Only more questions. I will not move from this spot until I check everything!

dialog.Title: Actually, I'm waiting for the money.
dialog.Text: Ah... I just thought... Does not matter. Yes, of course, here you go.

dialog.Title: Doc...?
dialog.Text: What the...! What are you doing? You are parasite! You're bastard! You're killing them!

dialog.Title: I keep killing till you open the cage.
dialog.Text: I will not get out of the cage! Until I finish the job! How dare you! Interfere with my work! Get out! OUT!

dialog.Title: Sorry, Doc. Did not know that it's your mutants.
dialog.Text: Don't shoot nearby mutants. You're destroying the research.

dialog.Title: ...Doc?
dialog.Text: What the...! What are you doing? You are parasite! You're bastard! You're killing them!

dialog.Title: Sorry, Doc. Didn't know that it's your mutants.
dialog.Text: Don't shoot nearby mutants. You're destroying the research.

dialog.Title: I keep killing till you open the cage.
dialog.Text: I will not get out of the cage! Until I finish the job! How dare you! Interfere with my work! Get out! OUT!

dialog.Title: Can I help you?
dialog.Text: No! But wait... ...Colleagues are skeptical toward my work. Recently they stoped supplying food. They say that they don't have enough, but I know... They think that hunger and thirst will force me out of here. Ha!

dialog.Title: How are you?
dialog.Text: Fine... Who cares?

dialog.Title: I brought cans.
dialog.Text: Hm... Thanks.

dialog.Title: Open the cage.
dialog.Text: N...o...n...o...not... going.... anywhere....please...water...

dialog.Title: I brought food.
dialog.Text: ....Thanks...

dialog.Title: Your stubborn will kill you.|| Open the cage!
Here is food and water.
dialog.Text: I... ...Thank you... I'm sorry, stalker. I know how it looks. But the boy... my assistant... I should not take him with me. Mutants ate him. And I could not do anything. Did not open the cage... You know what I have found... in the mutant...? No remains of... No remains in their stomachs to dig. These creatures absorbed the very structure of their victim. The genes themselves. Do you understand? We always thought that animals were subjected to mutation under the Phon radiation. But what if we were wrong? What if it is a mutation itself, a certain essence, absorbs a rat and becomes rat-alike? And that boy... what was his name...? His DNA is there, in these mutants. He lives in them, he can be found there... I have to find him...

dialog.Title: You're tired, Doc. Take a rest.
Open the cage.
dialog.Text: ...Go away...

dialog.Title: Here is the data about mutants. ||You can take them from my PDA.
dialog.Text: You are a murderer! Murderer! I... I do not trust you... Keep your data away from me...

dialog.Title: Ну как наши дела?
dialog.Text: ...Я... ... Спасибо... Я виноват, сталкер. Парнишка... лаборант... Зря я его с собой потащил. Съели его заживо... твари. Ничего не смог сделать. Не открыл клетку... Ты знаешь, что я в них нашел... в мутантах...? Не останки... Не останки в их желудках варятся. Они, твари, саму суть жертвы в себя впитывают. Сами гены. Ты понимаешь, сталкер? Сожрал мутант крысу и встроил ее ДНК в свою собственную. Мы думали, это звери подверглись мутации под действием Фона. Но что если все не так? Что если это сама мутация -- нечто -- поглощает крысу и становится подобным ей? И тот парнишка... как же его звали...? Его ДНК там, в мутантах. Он живет в них, его можно найти... Я должен его найти...

dialog.Title: Я чем-то могу помочь?
dialog.Text: Ты... Нет, не можешь.

dialog.Title: Есть доказательства теории?
dialog.Text: Только наблюдения и догадки. Я веду записи...

dialog.Title: Надо показать их Симонову!
dialog.Text: Но...

dialog.Title: Если теория не лишена обоснования...|Если твоя теория не лишена научного обоснования, Симонов тебя поддержит! Он надавит на Живодерова, у тебя будет время, вода, припасы...
dialog.Text: Симонов может помочь... Да, ты прав. Держи. Здесь вся моя работа. Не потеряй. Отнеси ее Симонову...

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Yes, I need to go outside.
Wait, I still have a business here.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Hello. Do you want to use the storage service?

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Hello. Do you want to use the storage service?

dialog.Title: I brought you a letter from Morozov.
dialog.Text: It's not for me. All his belongings are confiscated. Go to the Investigator and talk to him. You'll find him in the tower.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Stalker!

dialog.Title: How are you?
dialog.Text: Do not complain. Accompany a group of scientists and they are well pay for protection. There are a lot of mutants. Nerdy fond of them. They always want to take a closer look, and even better - hands touch. But here is only one rule if you pull your hands where is not safe than you will die. So we kill mutants for them it is better for them to touch dead creaturesl. They are scientists but totally crazy.

dialog.Title: And what about you?
dialog.Text: Did you hear about "Ravenwood"? We are from it.

dialog.Title: Mercenaries?
dialog.Text: You are hurting my feelings, stalker. What is this dismissive "mercenaries"? We - multifunction paramilitary organization, we solve complex problems, helping to explore the Zone. You and I, we are stalkers and have much in common, but we do not walk alone. Damn only crazy man can go alone ... here. No offense.

dialog.Title: How many of you here?
dialog.Text: Well, in our party - four specialists, we are defensing that scientists. I am Captain Sperling. Those gloomy fellows who look like twins - Kich and Butch. And that complete psycho who are in the corner is Telkberri. He became deaf after verlioka spat in his ear when he was dreaming.

dialog.Title: I see...
dialog.Text: Listen ... You look like a smart kid who is not afraid of a couple of simple instructions.Talk with the guys may be they have some job for you. We are doing different things - contacts with locals, killing mutants ... Sometimes scientists need to bring something, sometimes - drive away the homeless. Well, you know ... We can pay you good money

dialog.Title: Helping your guys.|I am helping your guys...
dialog.Text: Not blind. Noticed. So you... I find a good reward for you. Keep up the good work.

dialog.Title: Helping your guys.|I am helping your guys...
dialog.Text: Yes, I've heard about your exploits. In short ... There is one trader, we defense him, and he sell us different things with discount. He will not even speak with you but I'll give you a special paper, which will untie his tongue instantly. Look at his stuff, choose and do not hesitate.

dialog.Title: I uderstood, thanks
dialog.Text: One problem - we have not seen him for a long time. Previously he lived in cave tunnels with the bandits but where he lives now ... God knows. Good luck.

dialog.Title: *Показать письма с угрозами*|Кто-то шлет мне письма с угрозами. Могу ли я нанять твоих ребят для защиты?
dialog.Text: У нас уже есть наниматели. Впрочем, работка здесь не пыльная, ребята часто скучают. Я бы одолжил пару бойцов, если бы знал тебя лучше. В Зоне полно уродов, способных выложить бабки, а потом пустить пулю в затылок и ограбить. Без обид.

dialog.Title: *Показать письма с угрозами*|Кто-то шлет мне письма с угрозами. Могу ли я нанять твоих ребят для защиты?
dialog.Text: Будь спокоен. Я скажу своим людям. Они найдут его. Но, как понимаешь, услуга не бесплатная. Есть у тебя 100 000?

dialog.Title: Слишком дорого.
dialog.Text: Ну, тогда извини, ничем помочь не сможем.

dialog.Title: Есть.
dialog.Text: Отлично. Даю слово, больше этот дед не будет тебя доставать.

dialog.Title: Мы договорились?
dialog.Text: Даю слово, больше этот дед не будет тебя доставать.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Yes, I need to go outside.
Wait, I still have a business here.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Yes, I need to go outside.
Wait, I still have a business here.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Welcome. The grace of God upon you, and may you suffer from his punishment if you are distracted me for nothing!

dialog.Title: Pardon me.
dialog.Text: The Almighty will.

dialog.Title: It's about the documents from Amanita...
dialog.Text: Something happened with them?

dialog.Title: Kosmatiy deciphered all. | Kosmatiy transcribed documents. But he said that it was the last service and those who come to him from the "White" now will be killed.
dialog.Text: He is in the hands of God now... Later we will deal with him. The main thing is that the documents are transcribed.

dialog.Title: I don't distract for nothing.
dialog.Text: This is true. You've proven your loyalty, strength and faith, and we suggest you to go through "way of knowledge." After passing this "path", you expand your knowledge about the Zone and will gain new mental strength. Start your own "path" in the stadium in which called "Lubech", from there go to "Ryabinushka" and return to the "Lubech" in the area of new buildings. If in your path will be enemies destroy them all! Prove that you are worthy of great power.

dialog.Title: I'll go through the path. It is an honor for me.
I already know all I need about the Zone.
I went through "way of knowledge."
dialog.Text: From now on, you can be one of us and we take you in the face of God. Welcome, brother.

dialog.Title: I am ready for new challenges!
dialog.Text: Well, listen. In the Zone lives strange creatures they are called verlioks. Find them and feel how powerful and captivating energy they emit. Kill verliocka and soak up some of that energy. It is hard to find them and to win is even more difficult. But God will direct your feet and full reward for all the work.

dialog.Title: Long life, Master
dialog.Text: I just thought about you, my faithful acolyte. You know that in the Zone there are many artifacts that help reveal your talents and to see God in, but most of these things are split into parts. Found and brought part of the artifact. Using our knowledge we rebuild it and will hold a ritual. After this artifact will help our brother, who has recently been crippled by anomaly.

dialog.Title: I will bring all parts of the artifact!
I'd like to but not now, maybe later
I brought the artifacts || which you wanted!
dialog.Text: Perfect! Give it to me so that I can put together them! Now we can cure our brother.

dialog.Title: I heard you were looking for me?
dialog.Text: Yes, recently, appeared more mutants in the district. Perhaps they are attracted by our energy. Zone is not safe place at all and we don't need additional problems in the face of a crowd of mutants near our bases. Walk around and destroy all mutants which you will see.

dialog.Title: Mutants - no problem | | you can count on me
dialog.Text: I do not doubt you. Come back with a victory.

dialog.Title: Maybe later. | Now, unfortunately, I need to do other things but when I come back - be sure I will help you.
dialog.Text: I undestand. I am waiting for you.

dialog.Title: Killed mutants. | There were many mutants but now everything is clean.
Verliocks are dead. || Next time give me machine gun against verliocks
I found the hand of the Great!
dialog.Text: O wonder! A great day! give it to me! I want to see it with my own eyes.

dialog.Title: Alas, I lost it.
dialog.Text: Get out, get out of my sight, a pagan. Are you joking at the shrine?

dialog.Title: Here it is!
dialog.Text: Hand of the Great was found! All brother get know about you. Today you surprised me.

dialog.Title: I'm looking for the missing pilot.
dialog.Text: You have gone astray. Now you wander in the dark.

dialog.Title: Kidnappers - the Whites. We have a witness.
dialog.Text: We're in the same boat which is cut off from the world. We try to work together and live together. But not all the brothers share our humanity ... Zone grows. Newcomers remain without communication, without supplies, without orders. Brothers decided it is a signal, it's time to fight back, to drive out newcomers. They went to the walls of Lubech without telling the others and without my permission. They harmed the migrant people. I was against it. Zone decides whom to admit and whom to reject. We have no right to interfere.

dialog.Title: How can I find these brothers?
dialog.Text: It will not be easy. I have driven them out of the village for a misdemeanor. Through the marshes, they moved on in the land of fire and ashes to enter into the mouth of the volcano and to atone for their sins. But I did not see the pilot with them. I'm sorry, stalker, but it is likely that your pilot is dead...

dialog.Title: One master has the crisis of faith.
dialog.Text: White Brotherhood is ready to accept the lost soul. He must open eyes and take the Zone as the only truth in the world. If the Master will come to us, we allow him pass the test, strengthen his faith, his body and his mind. There is no way out of the Zone you have to become one with it, to make it a part of yourself and become part of it. This is our way and that the only way which id predestined to man.

dialog.Title: I will send him to you.
I'm searching stalker "Temon."
dialog.Text: Do you need Brother Temon? Why?

dialog.Title: On suspicion of murder.
dialog.Text: You can find truly innocent children in the Zone . We will not give you brother Temon , no matter what he had done in his worldly life. He is now dedicated to one of us. Temon embraced the faith of the White Brotherhood and makes the path of knowledge. He is under my protection, as well as all of my flock. Forget about him. Go in peace.

dialog.Title: An old friend is worried about him.
dialog.Text: Brother Temon makes his way of knowing. As one of the initiated you have to remember this way.

dialog.Title: An old friend is worried about him.
dialog.Text: Brother Temon makes his way of knowing. You're not one of the initiated and I can not tell you where he went.

dialog.Title: Did "Brother Temon" return?
dialog.Text: I have cast outTemon from our Brotherhood. Temon lied to us. He did not accept the faith and do not let God come into his heart.

dialog.Title: What happened?
dialog.Text: I sent Temon to search verlioks but he expressed his anger and violent disagreement with my decision. He attacked me and tried to rob us. Then I told him to get out.

dialog.Title: Where is he now?
dialog.Text: A true believer would direct his foot towards the land of fire and ashes to surrender to the flames in the crater of Vesuvius and clean gis soul. But I do not know how darkness deep in Temon . He could trample all ideals and escape to the swamps as a pathetic bandit.

dialog.Title: I have questions about the Brotherhood.
dialog.Text: Listening to you.

dialog.Title: The philosophy of the Brotherhood.
dialog.Text: Zone is our home, our abode. Hear the Zone, learn to live in harmony with it, try to understand her desires and then all your wishes come true. Its growth - not the disease but an attempt to embrace the newfound child-humanity. The foolish creature, mutant are not an evidence of its aggression, but a reflection of our flaws, our imperfections. True followers of the Brotherhood are learning how to live with them subject them to himself but does not become a slave to them. Kill the creatures of self-defense, during a ceremony or by following the path of knowledge, but not for hunting and fun.

dialog.Title: History of the Brotherhood.
dialog.Text: The Brotherhood was founded in memory of the first stalker. In the first day of the apocalypse first stalker found the source and prayed for a miracle, salvation and forgiveness. Zone said he saved the human race from disaster. People in their ignorance beheld white flash in the sky and didn`t know that they are on the verge of death. But the companions of the hero left on the mainland to know where he went and why. They became the founders of the Brotherhood. Feat accomplished by first stalker should not be forgotten ever. His sacrifice was not in vain and all that you see around you is evidence of his miracles. Dissolved in the source he kept our lives.

dialog.Title: Is Zone appeared before the flash?
dialog.Text: Zone has always been on Earth. But only the first stalker was able to understand it and be the creator of the world, the Creator, God. He - the savior of the people, our Father and Protector. She - our Mother, the Source and Abode.

dialog.Title: The activities of the Brotherhood.
dialog.Text: The Brotherhood send the will of the Zone. Brotherhood - the mediator between God and the uninitiated. We are looking for unity with the Zone, accept her gifts and tolerant of her anger.

dialog.Title: Do you wanna deal with it peacefully?
dialog.Text: listen, I know you're helping the military from Lyubich. Convince them to leave the Zone. Tell them they don't fir here. Now they still have a choice. They can either show their respect to the mighty Zone, leave it forever or die. The Zone couldn't bare 'em evermore.

dialog.Title: I'm on duty here.
dialog.Text: Carry on.

dialog.Title: *Showing threatening letters*|Someone keeps sending me treatening letters. May I count on Brothers' help?
dialog.Text: Brothrhood is with you. Your enemy is our enemy. The Zone is out true and only home. That man will meet God's visitation.

dialog.Title: *Showing threatening letters*|Someone keeps sending me treatening letters. May I count on Brothers' help?
dialog.Text: Your fait isn't strong enough. We can't help you. Go and pray.

dialog.Title: Talking of new-comers....
dialog.Text: How did negotiations go?

dialog.Title: Dibenko kicked me out of the town.
dialog.Text: Too bad. At least you tried. I'll restrain my Brothers as long as I can. God bless you.

dialog.Title: Got a letter from your obedient.
dialog.Text: Well... I'm confused. Anyway it's good that those who lost their way repented and laid to rest. But I don't assume a dead pilot could help us live in peace with new-comers. Listen, I know you're helping the military from Lyubich. Convince ' em to leave the Zone. They still have a choice. They either show reaspect to the zone, leave it forever or die. The Zone could't bare 'em evermore.

dialog.Title: It's bullshit. don't you scare me.
dialog.Text: I mean it, stalker. We aren't enemies to new-comers. Their own greed will kill ' em. They must learn to live in harmony with the Zone, to be as one. If they aren't ready they must live. Noone can prevent the Zone from spreading. Those who don't see the light will live in darkness to their death.

dialog.Title: Do you wanna deal with it peacefully?
dialog.Text: You may not tak a notice, Stalker, but the Zone is alive. It's growing, changing. It's already harmed. The war won't help it. It'll harm it even more.

dialog.Title: OK.
dialog.Text: I'm concerned about the man menshioned in the message. We do know that conflist is inevitable, but we don't want it. That man... he could fuel the war.

dialog.Title: I've heard you mugged a courier...
dialog.Text: We ain't thieves, stalker, Ok? In the neigbourhood there're lots of muggers and looters, who're ready to do anything for the profit. We follow the rules of The Zone. We don't kill unless it's vital.

dialog.Title: Not all brothers share this idea, right?
dialog.Text: Right. But don't seek for enemies among your friends. The Almighty will punish all siners one day, we musn't interfere into God's will. Those, who passed away, couldn't commit that. And I believe other Brothers. But I know about gang under "Philin''s authority. They're real murderers, they often abuse stalkers, take their money. They aren't afraid of the military. Their spies are in Lyubich. They know who is the deliver and wat they're carrying.

dialog.Title: Where can I find kidnappers?
dialog.Text: Are you still looking for a pilot? Go soth-east, through swamps. You'll understand when you step on hostile land.

dialog.Title: They went there?
dialog.Text: Yes. I made 'em leave. If their fait is strong enough they'll be enlightened on Vesuvius.

dialog.Title: Может, я чем смогу помочь?
dialog.Text: Думаю, сможешь. Сегодня ночью, пауки напали на наш полевой госпиталь, убили нескольких человек, включая охрану. Нельзя позволить паукам и дальше бесчинствовать в нашем лагере. Убей их столько, сколько сможешь!

dialog.Title: Нет, пауков я убивать не буду.
А может, еще кто со мной на пауков пойдет?
dialog.Text: Извини, сейчас каждый человек на счету. Ты уж как-нибудь сам.

dialog.Title: Артефакт заряжен. Надеюсь, он действительно так силен, как вы о нем говорите.
Перебил пауков.| С пауками никогда особой сложности не возникало.
Ни Кислый, ни Дибенко не уведут людей.
dialog.Text: Я знал, что они не согласятся. Но попробовать стоило. Я буду сдерживать своих братьев до последнего... Да снизойдет на тебя благодать Всевышнего.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Hello there! I can buy your stuff for a very tasty price!

dialog.Title: I have some things to sell.
I have some questions about this place.
dialog.Text: Let me guess. You were in the swamps near Lubech. POW! And you found yourself here. This is our great anomaly teleport. If you want to come back, just go at the place you've appeared here. This is the only way back. We have a big freakin volcano. The real paradise for the scientists. It has a lot of very cool artefacts there. But the mutants and anomalies are much more dangerous here.

dialog.Title: Am I still in the Zone?
dialog.Text: Yup. But nobody knows where are we at the map. Magnetic anomalies do their best to hide this place. I heard two versions. Simonov's "Dimension theory" and Chereshnikov's "Reconstruction theory". But both are very raw and have a lot of errors. IMHO.

dialog.Title: What about Simonov's theory?
dialog.Text: Simonov thinks that the Zone exists in many dimensions at one time. All locations are binded to each other and everyone can teleport from one place to another. There are a lot of anomaly territories on our planet. But they are all part of something bigger. Just imagine, what we could do if we've found the answer for this secret!

dialog.Title: Looks like a good theory...
dialog.Text: Not so good. We can get here only from Lubech.

dialog.Title: And?
dialog.Text: Simonow wrote that there are an energy lines in our world.

This theory is more philosophical and mistique. Every object could be reproduced. Well, if this object had some contacts with the Zone. Something copies some territory and then paste it to some place. As you can see, this theory gives you more questions than answers. Chereshnikov thinks that Phon is something godly made.

dialog.Title: Everything is unreal?
dialog.Text: No. Not like that. It's like you get to the picture of another place. Like in a shell.

dialog.Title: Why this theory is bad?
dialog.Text: BECAUSE THIS IS BULLSHIT! Chereshnikov don't try to make some numbers. He don't use any facts. Just his own issues. This is a great thought! But the work is awefull!

dialog.Title: Ok. I've heard enough.
dialog.Text: Yup. Let's trade.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
I sell rounds. grenades. Even the best weapon is useless without ammo. Do you need anything?

dialog.Title: Let me see what you have for sale.
You attacked me!
dialog.Text: Sorry, man. I mistook you for someone alse. Take it easy, man! You're alive anyway, what do you want?

dialog.Title: Give me the generator. Now!
dialog.Text: Here you are, man. I could have sold it, you know. But I kept it.

dialog.Title: You didn't sell it cause noone wanted to buy it.
dialog.Text: Why so tough, man?

dialog.Title: Need a generator.
dialog.Text: Ok. It costs 40 000 r.

dialog.Title: Stay here. I'll be back with money.
Wait a minute. You said 35 000 before!
dialog.Text: I did before you tried to humiliate me. Now you got to pay more.

dialog.Title: I already paid for it.
dialog.Text: You didn't give me a thing. Listen, man. I'm a trader. I sell stuff. I won't give you a thing for free, got it? Do you want to steal from me?

dialog.Title: I don't.
dialog.Text: Good. 40 000 rubles.

dialog.Title: Deal. Here is your money.
dialog.Text: Excellent. what a minute! What's behind your back?

dialog.Title: Need a generator. How much is it?
dialog.Text: It'll cost you only 35 000 r.

dialog.Title: Ok. Take the money.
dialog.Text: Excellent. Wait a minute. What's behind your back?
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Yes, I need to go outside.
Wait, I still have a business here.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was a dark place in the past, full of mutants. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Who are you? Get lost.

dialog.Title: It's me.
dialog.Text: Why didn't you say it from the start? Sorry, if I offended you... It's just a job - to keep strangers away... You may pass.

dialog.Title: What is this place?
dialog.Text: None of your business. Here was an abandoned kindergarten in the past. Now people are gathering. Important people... Can't let strangers get inside, so get lost.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Looking for an exit?

dialog.Title: Yes, I need to go outside.
Wait, I still have a business here.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
I can take you to different places. What do you want?

dialog.Title: How much do you want for a trip?
dialog.Text: From you - nothing. I don't know you and I won't go with you anywhere.

dialog.Title: Hey! But I have some cash.
dialog.Text: Nope. Listen dude...let's make it clear. You can stab me in the back. I know that, you know that. I will be very nervous during the march. And it could be fatal in our business.

dialog.Title: How much will it cost?
dialog.Text: Nothing at all. You're my bro, bro! Everything is for free! I can take you to Lubech, Tunguska or to the Vesuvius.

dialog.Title: I need to go to Tunguska.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Hey! Who are you? Where do you think you're going?

dialog.Title: Got lost.
dialog.Text: How did you get here?

dialog.Title: I'm lost.
dialog.Text: I can take you to Liubech,Tunguska or Vesuvius.

dialog.Title: Just passing by.
dialog.Text: So piss off!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
I can take you to Lubech, Tunguska or Vesuvius if you got lost.

dialog.Title: I need to go to Tunguska.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
What do you want?

dialog.Title: I need a guide. How much do you take?
dialog.Text: Man, I don't know you. I won't take you anywhere.

dialog.Title: Even for the real cash?
dialog.Text: Yup. Don't ask me again.

dialog.Title: Can you take me somewhere? I have some cash.
dialog.Text: No cash, my friend! I'll be your guide for free. Where do you wanna go?

dialog.Title: I need to go to Lubech.
Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Stop right there! Where are you going?

dialog.Title: I'm lost.
dialog.Text: So you need to find your friends here for help.

dialog.Title: I'm lost.
dialog.Text: I can take you to Lubech, Tunguska or to Vesuvius.

dialog.Title: I need to go to Lubech.
Just passing by.
dialog.Text: Go your way.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
If you feel a little bit lost I can take you to Lubech, Tunguska or Vesuvius.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Are you sure you wanna go to the Savagewood? I can take you there. But there's no way back. Nobody ever came back from that place!

dialog.Title: Nobody?...and how did YOU come back?
dialog.Text: Ah. I've never been there. I only show the way. You won't come back alive, stalker. It's a "test" place, you know. You'll need to die there to get back.

dialog.Title: Just show me the way.
dialog.Text: I warned you, man. You can get there by different tracks. How do you want to get there?

dialog.Title: Bring me right to the middle of that mess!
Who will ever go after such spooky stories?
dialog.Text: There are a lot of suicidal morons here. I'm glad that you changed tour mind.

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь

dialog.Title: Tell me about this monument.
dialog.Text: This is the monument for Boris and Arkadiy - the pilgrims of the Zone. There won't be any stalkers without them.

dialog.Title: Why it looks like.... like it looks?
dialog.Text: The Golden Ball legend was spoken to the newbies by the pilgrims. They said that there is a Golden Ball that can make your wishes real. But it need a sacrifice. So it needs at least two stalkers to get to the Golden Ball. One must die to let second's dream come true. It was a symbol of courage, self-sacrifice and also for treachery and meanness. Now we know that there is no Golden Ball. It's a myth. But it was a great lesson for us all. So we've decidede to make this monument. To remember. To remember our pilgrims and their priceless words.
Hi there!

dialog.Title: What is the meaning of these words?
dialog.Text: "Happiness for everyone for free?.."I think they tried to show us all this world's mess. There was a story about two friends. Stalkers. One named Rederick sacrificed himself to let his friend live and make a wish to the Golden Ball. But he was so astonished that he just repeated Rederick's last words: Happiness for everyone. And let no one leave offended! But this is very naive and impossible wish. Can you see the whole irony? This is all about good people making bad deeds. Doing their worst to get the best.

dialog.Title: And what if Rederick's wish got real?
dialog.Text: That's strange...but true....but strange. Yeeeeaaah! What if a man happy if he got his piece only digging through the real shit? What if the Zone is a big lethal playground? And the winner gets the main dish! But every one of us is the winner! Because we all get something special in the end. Not much. Not the real heaven, you know but not bad place to live and rise.

dialog.Title: Ok. I need to go now.
С Новым Годом!
dialog.Text: Спасибо, дружище! Да, быстро время летит... Вроде только вчера мы с тобой познакомились, а сколько уже событий произошло! Ничто не стоит на месте, всё меняется. Даже Зона смотри, как изменилась за этот год! И толи ещё будет! Я конечно не пророк, но чувствую, что в новом году Зона нам такие перемены и приключения подкинет, каких за все последние годы не было! Эх, весёлый год будет! Вот помяни моё слово!

dialog.Title: Поживём - увидим
dialog.Text: Конечно, увидим! И не сомневайся даже! Кстати, о приключениях. Слушай, вот ты меня с Новым Годом поздравил и спасибо тебе за это огромное. Очень приятно, честно! И знаешь, возникла у меня мысль -- хочу друзей своих тоже поздравить с Новым Годом.

dialog.Title: Так в чём проблема?
dialog.Text: Понимаешь, сейчас сталкеров в Зону прибывает с каждым днём всё больше и больше. И, разумеется, все новички хотят узнать про Зону побольше. Ну и первым делом идут сюда, к памятнику Братьям. А, кто про памятник кроме меня расскажет? Вот и получается, что я тут как солдат на посту! Отойти ни на минуту не имею права. Помоги мне, а?

dialog.Title: Поздравить твоих друзей?
dialog.Text: Ага, точно. Да ты не переживай, далеко ходить не придётся. Они все в Любече обитают. Обойди их и поздравь от меня с Новым Годом. Пусть знают, что помню я о своих друзьях и дорожу нашей дружбой. А уж я тебя сюрпризом Новогодним отблагодарю, не сомневайся!

dialog.Title: Я подумаю
dialog.Text: Ну, давай, подумай. Только помни, что Новый Год уже не загорами. Дорога, как говорится, ложка к обеду!

dialog.Title: Конечно, поздравлю!
dialog.Text: Вот и отлично! Смотри, кого я бы хотел поздравить: Кузнеца, Колю Кислого, Сержанта Дыбенко, Доктора Зиновьева, Курьера, Сизифа, Саньку Бывалого, Федю Пророка, Прохора Путейщика, Мишу Охотника и Старого Сталкера. Поздравишь и возвращайся. Я тебя ждать буду!

dialog.Title: Я поздравил твоих друзей
dialog.Text: Спасибо, дружище! Самый ценный подарок, который ты можешь преподнести кому либо -- это твое время, потому что ты отдаешь то, что никогда не сможешь вернуть. Разреши и мне сделать тебе подарок! Новогоднюю шапочку, чтобы весело провести Новый Год и бинокль с ночным видением! С этим биноклем ты любого мутанта ночью за версту увидишь! С Новым Годом тебя, сталкер!

dialog.Title: Есть минутка?
dialog.Text: Извини, с уголовниками не общаюсь
Hey!

dialog.Title: Do you have Morosov's things?|| Here is the letter.
dialog.Text: I see. But I can't give you the Twisted's stuff.

dialog.Title: Twisted is dead.
dialog.Text: I know. Listen. I know how we'll do. You help me - I help you. I have three of my couriers missing.

dialog.Title: I can find them.
dialog.Text: If these things are so necessary to you, descend on our routes and learn that happened to couriers. One of them went towards Ryabinushka. Another tried to round Vesuvius and to reach camp of scientists. The third left to the direction of Lubech, was going to pass by a burial ground of chemical waste.

dialog.Title: It's a pity.
dialog.Text: Ah. That's not enough! If you're really want to get Twisted's stuff you'll go and figure out what happened with my men!

dialog.Title: Your couriers are dead.|| I've found only those rocks.
dialog.Text: Damn! Get it off me! Are you moron? Those are the arts! The artefacts. The bad ones! With really bad effects, man. Throw that shit away and throw it fast!

dialog.Title: I can't just throw it out!
dialog.Text: Really? You need to speak with our eggheads to solve your problem. Simonov can help you. They're on the other side of Vesuvius. So they can't sell you out quick. You'll have some time. Find Simonov. He's a real kickass egghead. He knows a lot about special artefacts. He'll help you!

dialog.Title: So give me the Twisted's stuff.
dialog.Text: Not now. I need you to burn the couriers' bodies. They were a good men. I don't want to leave their corpses for mutants.
